article.articleHeadline: Casos de ébola en el Congo supera los 7 mil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo exceed 7,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 7,000 confirmed cases, with 7,022 cases and 3,398 deaths reported as of September 10, according to the government’s latest situation report. Recoveries total 1,671. The outbreak has touched 62 health zones across seven provinces, with Ubangi del Sur newly affected after a 23-year-old man with travel history from South Kivu died. Ubangi del Sur does not border the six provinces with prior cases: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, Tshopo, and Lower Uele. Declared in May, this outbreak is the largest and deadliest Ebola epidemic in the DRC’s history and the second-largest globally, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. For more information, refer to the WHO portal.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例数が7000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が拡大し続けており、致死率も高く新たな州への拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 史上最大・最多死者数のエボラ流行であり、新たな州（Ubangi del Sur）への拡大も確認されている。致死率は約48%と非常に高く、WHOも継続的に監視している状況。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتخطى الـ7 آلاف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 7,000.
article.articleSummary: As of Sept 13, 2026, Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 7,000, with 7,022 cases, 3,398 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries. This is the country’s worst outbreak to date and the 17th Ebola outbreak there. The virus is believed to have circulated for weeks before detection. The outbreak began in North Ituri Province and has spread to eastern and northern regions with armed conflict and weak health infrastructure, recently reaching South Ubangi Province near borders with the Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville. Most cases remain in Ituri, including school-linked infections after summer holidays. Public health measures include mandatory handwashing with soap and limiting classes to 30 students. Ebola is transmitted via body fluids and can cause internal and external bleeding and multi-organ failure. The current strain, Bundibugyo, has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment; Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染者数が7000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行(7000人超、死者3398人)で、ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyo株が国境地域まで拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国は国境付近への波及懸念として言及されているのみで、実際の症例発生国はDRCのみと判断。ワクチン・治療法未承認の点は致死率・管理困難性の観点から重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: New invasive tick virus detected in U.S
article.articleSummary: Asian longhorned tick (Haemaphysalis longicornis), detected in 2017, has spread to more than two dozen states, including New York, Massachusetts, South Carolina, Oklahoma, and Missouri. Females reproduce without mating, enabling rapid expansion. In the U.S., the tick has not been linked to Lyme disease or other illnesses, but threatens livestock via bovine theileriosis. In Asia, the same tick transmits multiple pathogens, including Dabie bandavirus (DBV), which can kill up to 30% of patients. Researchers identified Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV); in Chinese hospitals among suspected DBV cases, ALTNV appeared in more than 15% of patients, causing flu-like illness; co-infection with DBV increased respiratory and kidney impairment, with seven deaths among 3,100 co-infected patients. No human transmission has been shown in the U.S.; ticks may carry pathogens if they feed on reservoir hosts. USDA says standard tick treatments are effective; veterinarians should be consulted if livestock or pets are exposed.

triage.headline_ja: 米国で新たな侵入性マダニウイルスを検出
triage.triage_reason: 米国でのマダニ拡大と新規ウイルス(ALTNV)の発見が報告されているが、米国内でのヒト感染事例は確認されておらず、中国での症例データも既存研究の引用と見られ、現在進行中の急性アウトブレイクとは言えないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 主たる発生地は米国（対象国リスト外）だが、記事中で中国におけるALTNV/DBV症例データ（死亡例含む）が言及されているため中国のみ対象国として計上。米国内でのヒト感染は未確認であり、新種ウイルス発見という研究段階の情報である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: "الإنفلونزا" تدفع اليابان إلى إغلاق فصول دراسية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza forces Japan to close classrooms
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Japan prompted classroom closures nationwide: about 3,000 medical facilities reported an average of 3.29 influenza cases per facility per week starting 31 August, up 1.87-fold from the prior week. In total, 12,299 infections were recorded, marking an 11th consecutive weekly increase. Five schools were closed entirely and 162 classrooms were shut, with Okinawa reporting the highest facility-rate at 10.34 cases, followed by Niigata at 6.13 and Kanagawa at 5.87. In Congo, government data show 7,022 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,398 deaths across seven provinces. The outbreak ranks second to West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which involved more than 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths. Earlier officials announced a case in the northwest South Ubangi region, far from the outbreak’s epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: 「インフルエンザ」が日本の学級閉鎖を招く
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（7,022症例、3,398死亡、7州に拡大）が報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的懸念が認められるためフルRRAに進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事は日本の季節性インフルエンザ流行とコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行という2つの独立した話題を含む。日本、シエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴの症例数・死亡者数は西アフリカ2014-2016年流行に次ぐ規模とされており、既存の継続アウトブレイクの可能性が高いが、深刻度からPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le gouvernement annonce le pic dépassé, l'OMS décrit une expansion continue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the government announces that the peak has been surpassed, the WHO describes an ongoing expansion.
article.articleSummary: 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: on Sept 11 the government said the outbreak is under control and that the peak was reached in the third week of August 2026, while the WHO describes ongoing geographic expansion. As of Sept 10, the Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale reported 7,022 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,398 deaths (case fatality 48.4%), with 80 new cases and 49 deaths that day. Of 61 health zones affected, 10 have had no cases for more than 21 days. Nord-Kivu treatment centers operated at 141.4% capacity; 80 cases that day included 43 from Nord-Kivu and 30 from Ituri. WHO’s Sept 7 briefing counted 6,757 cases and 3,267 deaths, noting continued transmission and very high risk. On Sept 10 a western-branch case appeared in Miluna, Gwaka, Sud-Ubangi—the first in the west—after a travel from Kamanyola (South Kivu) via Rwanda and Uganda. Contact tracing identified 24,719 contacts; 85.3% followed; 3,360 not followed. Bundibugyo strain; >70,000 vaccine doses. By Sept 12, none of three thresholds for deeming control had been met.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：政府はピークを超えたと発表するも、WHOは拡大継続を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、新たな地域（西部Sud-Ubangi）への拡大や国境を越えた移動歴が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 政府とWHOで流行状況の評価に相違があり（政府はピーク超え・制御下と発表、WHOは継続拡大と評価）、西部への新規感染拡大（Sud-Ubangi州、ルワンダ・ウガンダ経由の移動歴あり）が報告されている。制御基準の3条件はいずれも未達成。

article.articleHeadline: Tiny RNA Molecule Pushes Schistosome Parasites Toward Self-Destruction
article.articleSummary: Schistosoma japonicum, a major cause of human and animal schistosomiasis in Asia, may be steered toward apoptosis by a single microRNA, sja-miR-2a-3p. In permissive BALB/c mice, parasites flourish; in less-permissive Wistar rats they exhibit higher apoptotic activity. Expression of sja-miR-2a-3p is elevated during 14–28 days post-infection, especially in schistosomula from Wistar rats, with tissue enrichment in the male testis and posterior region and in the female vitellaria. Computational targets include several apoptosis-related genes; functional tests in vitro showed that mimics or inhibitors of sja-miR-2a-3p modulate apoptosis gene transcripts and egg output, with TUNEL staining confirming DNA fragmentation. Findings link host environment, parasite apoptosis, and a regulatory RNA, hinting at new control strategies that disrupt parasite survival by targeting its own gene regulation. Acta Parasitologica; authors Sun and Zhong; Shanxi Agricultural University and Shanghai Veterinary Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences.

triage.headline_ja: 小さなRNA分子が住血吸虫を自己破壊へ導く
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は住血吸虫症の分子生物学的研究に関する学術論文の紹介であり、公衆衛生上の発生事象や異常な流行を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 研究内容は動物実験（マウス・ラット）およびin vitro解析による基礎科学研究であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、地域特定の対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Πάνω από 7.000 κρούσματα Έμπολα, σχεδόν 3.400 θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Over 7,000 Ebola cases, nearly 3,400 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is facing its worst Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri Province, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of 13 September 2026, 7,022 laboratory-confirmed cases, 3,998 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries have been reported, with the epicenter in Ituri and transmission reaching South Ubangi near borders with the Central African Republic and Republic of the Congo. Declared in mid-May, officials say the peak was surpassed in early August, and 10 of 61 health zones have had no new cases for at least 21 days. Infections have even appeared in schools ahead of the new term. Funding gaps hinder isolation and surveillance; WHO estimates a need for 5,000 more health workers. Experimental therapies and vaccines are being tested against the Bundibugyo strain, with no approved regimen yet. The 2018–2020 outbreak in DRC caused about 2,300 deaths in 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱の症例7,000人超、死者ほぼ3,400人
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模のエボラ出血熱流行が継続中で、症例7,000超・死者3,998人に達し、国境地域への感染拡大や医療資源不足が報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 感染は中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国国境付近（南ウバンギ州）にも及んでいるが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内（イトゥリ州中心）の流行として評価。

article.articleHeadline: Screening Nearly 150,000 Migrants Reveals Hidden Tuberculosis Burden in the
article.articleSummary: Five-year national TB screening in the Netherlands (2019–2023) analyzed 149,214 migrants to map active TB and latent infection in a low-incidence setting. Immigrants (87,511) yielded 69 TB cases (79/100k); asylum seekers (61,703) yielded 170 cases (276/100k). Country-level yields exceeded birth-country WHO incidence for asylum seekers, with Sierra Leone (888), Eritrea (704), Somalia (581), Gambia (562) and South Sudan/Sudan (519) top; immigrants’ highest yields were Indonesia (291) and the Philippines (241). Symptom-based detection was weak: of 202 screen-detected pulmonary TB cases, 27.2% reported cough (immigrants 13.8%, asylum seekers 32.6%). About 56.5% of 239 screen-detected TB cases were bacteriologically confirmed; two MDR-TB cases. Treatment outcomes: immigrants 92.8% cured/completed vs asylum seekers 81.2%, with loss to follow-up and cross-border movement driving the gap. A second component analyzed latent infection in >20,000 immigrants, rising with age (0.6% under 12, 4.4% among adolescent). Implications for Europe include radiological screening value and cross-border care continuity.

triage.headline_ja: 約15万人の移民スクリーニングでオランダにおける潜在的結核負担が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: オランダにおける移民スクリーニングの疫学研究報告であり、急性のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。対象国は出身国統計として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はオランダにおける5年間の移民TBスクリーニングプログラムの学術的分析報告。インドネシア・フィリピン・シエラレオネ等は移民の出身国として統計上言及されているだけで、当該国でのアウトブレイク発生を示すものではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Casos na RDCongo passam os 7.000 mas pico terá passado - autoridades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Cases in DR Congo exceed 7,000 but the peak may have passed - authorities.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 7,000 cases, with 7,022 confirmed, 3,398 deaths and 1,671 recoveries since the mid-May start of the 17th outbreak, the worst in the country’s history. The epicenter remains Ituri province (northeast), with spread to Sud-Ubangi in the east-north, bordering Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville. Authorities say the peak occurred in early August, and indicators point to a decline, noting that 10 of 61 health zones have reported no new cases in at least 21 days. Cases have been detected in schools, raising concerns about transmission among children. Responding agencies say funding is insufficient to sustain care and isolation; WHO estimates a need for about 5,000 more health workers. Trials are under way for treatments and vaccines against Bundibugyo virus; no approved vaccine or therapy exists yet.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国の症例数が7,000人を超えるも、ピークは過ぎた可能性 - 当局

article.articleHeadline: India's 2026 H1N1 Surge Driven by Known Seasonal Strain
article.articleSummary: Delhi-National Capital Region faces a 2026 influenza A(H1N1) surge driven by an established A(H1N1)pdm09 lineage, specifically the A/Missouri/11/2025(H1N1)pdm09-like variant, per Indian Council of Medical Research surveillance and New Microbes and New Infections analysis. The surge stems from a familiar strain, enabling use of existing vaccines and antivirals rather than a novel reassortant. The virus, an Orthomyxoviridae member with a negative-sense segmented RNA genome, relies on hemagglutinin for receptor binding and neuraminidase for virion release. Transmission in Delhi NCR is shaped by high humidity, monsoon, winter inversions, indoor crowding, aerosols, and fomites, with a 1–4 day incubation and presymptomatic shedding. Clinically, A(H1N1) ranges from mild upper respiratory illness to severe pneumonia and ARDS, with bacterial superinfections by Streptococcus pneumoniae, Staphylococcus aureus, and Streptococcus pyogenes worsening outcomes. High-risk groups include pregnant women and infants under five.

triage.headline_ja: インドの2026年H1N1流行は既知の季節性株が原因
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザとして既知株による流行であり、既存のワクチン・抗ウイルス薬で対応可能なため国際的な異常事態とは言えないが、デリーでの流行拡大や重症化リスクの情報が限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はインド医学研究評議会(ICMR)のサーベイランスデータに基づく学術的分析であり、既知のA(H1N1)pdm09系統（A/Missouri/11/2025様株）による季節性流行と説明されている。既存の対策で対応可能とされ、パンデミック様の異常事象ではないが、デリーNCR地域における今後の感染動向・重症例数の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية: 7 آلاف إصابة ووفيات قياسية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 7,000 infections and record deaths.
article.articleSummary: 7,022 lab-confirmed Ebola infections and 3,398 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 2026-09-13, the deadliest and most widespread outbreak in the country’s history. The outbreak began in Ituri Province in the northeast, circulating covertly for weeks before formal recognition in mid-May. The geographic spread has extended into eastern and northern areas, including South Ubangi on borders with the Central African Republic and the Republic of the Congo, raising cross-border transmission concerns. About 1,671 people have recovered. Response efforts focus on containing active foci in Ituri, which still reports the highest daily case numbers. Ongoing conflict and weak health infrastructure impede isolation and treatment, complicating containment and risking further regional spread.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: Over 7,000 cases and 3,998 deaths.

article.articleHeadline: Pemprov Papua Pegunungan dorong empat langkah penanganan penyakit ATM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Papua Highlands Provincial Government pushes for a four-step approach to managing Acute Mountain Sickness.
article.articleSummary: Papua Highlands Provincial Government, via the local Health Department, pushes a four-step strategy to tackle AIDS, tuberculosis, and malaria (ATM) across six districts: Jayawijaya, Mamberamo Tengah, Nduga, Pegunungan Bintang, Yalimo, and Yahukimo. In Wamena, Isak Yando stated the plan: (1) data-driven policy using real-time surveillance to target interventions; (2) cross-sector integration to coordinate efforts; (3) strengthening the Papua Highlands Partnership Forum among government, partners, academia, business, and civil society; (4) concrete regional actions in the six lokus. Programs must be embedded in RPJMD, RKPD, and APBD to ensure sustained funding. The strategy emphasizes integrated ATM prevention and control, with district-level action plans to be developed and implemented to achieve effective outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: パプア山岳州政府、ATM(エイズ・結核・マラリア)対策の4段階アプローチを推進
triage.triage_reason: 既存の慢性感染症（AIDS・結核・マラリア）に対する行政の政策的取り組みを報じるものであり、突発的な公衆衛生上の異常事態やアウトブレイクではない。
triage.notes: 記事は地域保健当局による既存の慢性感染症対策プログラムの発表であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: स्किन टीबी के मरीजों में बढ़ा डीआर-टीबी का खतरा, केजीएमयू के शोध में खुलासा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR-TB risk increased among patients with cutaneous TB, as revealed in KGMU's research.
article.articleSummary: Drug-resistant TB risk is rising among cutaneous tuberculosis patients, per a Lucknow-based study from King George’s Medical University (KGMU). In 54 cutaneous TB cases (ages 20–40) studied between 2019–2022, seven developed drug-resistant TB (DR-TB) and were HIV-negative. Six did not respond to the most effective anti-TB drug and received multidrug-resistant TB (MDR-TB) regimens; one patient showed resistance to another primary TB drug. About a month after treatment initiation, patients improved, with complete skin healing after therapy. The seven cases included manifestations such as lupus vulgaris, scrofuloderma, tubercular abscess, and tubercular chancre. Diagnosis is challenging due to low bacillary loads; CBNAAT and culture are recommended, and whole-genome sequencing may improve future detection. Treatment duration ranges from 9 to 18 months, and early identification of DR-TB is crucial to prevent spread to the chest or CNS.

triage.headline_ja: 皮膚結核患者における薬剤耐性結核リスクの増加、KGMUの研究で判明
triage.triage_reason: 単一医療機関による後方視的研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常なアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2019-2022年の症例研究に基づく学術報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Συναγερμός με πάνω από 7.000 κρούσματα Έμπολα και 4.000 νεκρούς - Εξαπλώνεται στα σχολεία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Alarm over more than 7,000 Ebola cases and 4,000 deaths – spreading to schools.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo—the deadliest in its history—has reached 7,022 lab-confirmed cases and 3,998 deaths, with 1,671 recoveries since mid-May. Originating in Ituri in the northeast, it has spread to South Ubangi near the borders with the Central African Republic and the Republic of Congo. Cases in schools ahead of the school year sparked alarm; Bunia residents and officials have implemented measures like limiting class size to 30 students, handwashing, and avoiding contact, though budgets for surveillance and isolation are reportedly insufficient. Government spokesman Patrick Muyaya says the curve is subsiding, with the peak in early August; 10 of 61 health zones have seen no new infections for at least 21 days. The WHO warns that 5,000 more health workers are needed. Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no approved vaccine or therapy, forces doctors to use experimental regimens in isolated areas amid conflict.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ症例7,000人超、死者4,000人超で警戒 - 学校にも拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続中で死者約4,000人に達し、学校への拡大や国境地域への拡大、WHOによる追加医療従事者派遣要請など、複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はイトゥリ州で始まりサウスウバンギ州（中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国国境付近）に拡大したと述べているが、これら隣国での症例発生は明記されていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。承認済みワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株であることも重症度・管理困難性を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Saiba o que é o vírus do Nilo, que provocou 41 mortes na Itália e já chegou ao Brasil - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Find out what the West Nile virus is, which caused 41 deaths in Italy and has already reached Brazil - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: West Nile virus infections are reported in Italy and Brazil in 2026. Italy has 41 deaths and 594 confirmed cases through September 8, per the ISS weekly bulletin. In Brazil, four confirmed cases in 2026 with one death, affecting São Paulo and Santa Catarina. West Nile virus is a flavivirus first identified in Uganda in 1937 and now circulating across multiple regions. It is transmitted mainly by Culex mosquitoes; birds, especially migratory species, are natural reservoirs. Most infections are asymptomatic; about 20% develop mild illness with abrupt fever, malaise, anorexia, nausea, headache, myalgias, rash, and lymphadenopathy. A small proportion progress to neuroinvasive disease (meningitis, encephalitis, paralysis). No antiviral or human vaccine exists; management is supportive, with hospitalization or ICU as needed. Prevention includes repellents, screens, eliminating standing water, sanitation, and avoiding handling dead animals.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアで41人死亡、ブラジルにも到達した西ナイルウイルスとは何か - Jornal O Sul
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで西ナイルウイルス感染確定4例中1死亡が報告され、同国では比較的稀な事象であり、公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性の両基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリアとブラジルの両方の西ナイルウイルス発生を報じているが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。イタリア（594例・41死亡）は規模が大きいが対象国外のため評価対象外。ウガンダは1937年の初発見地としての歴史的言及のみで、現在の発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 80岁老人被树枝划伤感染破伤风，医生：不只生锈铁钉扎伤，这些情况也会感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An 80-year-old man contracts tetanus after a branch scratch; doctors say it's not just rusty nails that can cause tetanus—these situations can also lead to tetanus.
article.articleSummary: China faces tetanus from minor wounds; an 80-year-old Beijing woman developed tetanus after a branch scratch, and earlier a 70-something patient contracted tetanus from a chicken-peck wound at home. These cases show rusty nails are not required. Clostridium tetani, common in soil, animal feces, and dust, forms spores that germinate in anaerobic wounds. Symptoms include mouth-opening difficulty, lockjaw, a sardonic smile, and back muscle stiffness; generalized spasms and autonomic changes such as high blood pressure and rapid heart rate; in the elderly, arrhythmias and heart failure are possible. Case fatality can reach about 10%. Seek prompt care for deep, narrow wounds to decide on tetanus antitoxin or immune globulin. Vaccination offers protection for 5–10 years; outdoor workers should stay up to date. Beijing Ditan Hospital’s Pu Lin stresses vaccination and early treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 80歳男性が枝でひっかき傷を負い破傷風に感染、医師「錆びた釘だけでなくこうした状況でも感染する」
triage.triage_reason: 個別の破傷風症例に関する啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や集団発生、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性はなく、通常の散発例として報告されている。
triage.notes: 破傷風は環境中のクロストリジウム菌による非伝染性疾患であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。個別症例の医学啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: أسوأ تفشِ.. أكثر من 7 آلاف إصابة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The worst outbreak... more than 7,000 Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 7,022 Ebola virus infections, 3,398 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries, marking the worst outbreak in the country to date. The outbreak began in Ituri Province in the northeast and has spread to remote eastern and northern areas fractured by conflict and weak health infrastructure. A new wave was officially disclosed in mid-May, with most cases concentrated in Ituri, including schools in Bunia after the summer break. Transmission has recently reached Sud Ubangi Province, near borders with Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment currently. Ebola spreads through contact with body fluids and can cause severe hemorrhagic fever and multi-organ failure. Public health measures in schools include soap-washing hands and capping class size at 30, with ongoing awareness efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 最悪の流行…コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染者が7,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,000人超の感染、3,398人の死亡（致死率約48%）という同国史上最悪のエボラ流行であり、国境地帯（中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国国境近く）への拡大も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国、コンゴ共和国は国境付近での伝播リスクとして言及されているが、実際の症例発生地としての記載はなくDRCが主題であるため対象国からは除外。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行で、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、紛争地域での対応の困難さが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: El Nino Triggers Dual Health Crisis in India As WHO Issues High-Risk Alert Over Dengue, Malaria Surge
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-13, WHO raises India to high-to-very-high risk due to El Niño-driven dual crisis: dengue and malaria surges and heat-related illnesses. In Delhi, August dengue cases reached 90—the highest monthly count this year—bringing the seasonal total to 311. Malaria rose to 53 in August, up from 17 in July, with the annual tally at 119 across municipal zones. Authorities attribute extended Anopheles breeding in post-rain puddles to the malaria uptick; dengue incidence accelerates as higher temperatures shorten viral incubation in Aedes aegypti and promote more frequent biting. Heat exhaustion and heatstroke risks increase, stressing outdoor workers, mothers, neonates and children. Distinguishing features: dengue presents high fever, eye pain, rash and platelets drop; heat illness presents with heavy sweating, confusion, rapid pulse. Preventive advice emphasizes water-logging control, repellents, screens, light clothing, hydration, and reporting drains.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョがインドで二重の健康危機を引き起こす：WHOがデング熱・マラリア急増で高リスク警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: デリーにおけるデング熱・マラリアの季節性増加であり、WHOの警告言及はあるが重症度・国際的拡大の明確な根拠に乏しく、情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: エルニーニョによる季節性のデング熱・マラリア増加を報じる記事。WHOの『高リスク警告』は言及されているが、一次情報源や公式声明の確認ができておらず、地域限定（デリー）の月次症例数増加が主内容。死亡数や重症例の具体的記載はなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する情報もない。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला का 17वां प्रकोप काबू में, खतरा अभी भी पूरी तरह टला नहीं : डीआरसी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo under control, danger not yet completely averted: DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains under control but not fully contained. The seventeenth outbreak, declared in May, peaked in the third week of August 2026. Despite overall declines in earlier-hit areas, new locally acquired cases continue and the outbreak has reached seven provinces across 62 health zones. As of September 10, Congo recorded 7,022 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,398 deaths (case fatality 48.4%). Western Ituri remained a focal area with slowed transmission, but vigilance persists; 10 previously affected health zones reported no new cases for at least 21 days. Sud-Ubangi in the North-West reported the first Ebola case on September 10, with a 23-year-old who died after traveling through several provinces and neighboring Rwanda and Uganda. The WHO weekly report described the outbreak as uncontained and heterogeneous. Authorities stress strict contact tracing and surveillance to prevent broader spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、第17次エボラ流行は管理下にあるも危険は完全に去っていない：DRC
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行が7州62保健地域に拡大し、新たな州（南ウバンギ）でも症例が確認され、患者が近隣国を経由して移動するなど国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・ルワンダへの患者の移動歴に言及しているが、これらの国での症例発生は報告されていないため発生地域には含めない。WHO週報は本流行を『uncontained and heterogeneous（未制圧かつ不均一）』と評価しており、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases up by 476 in Coimbatore district this year; 849 cases within city limits alone
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Coimbatore district: 2026 dengue admissions up by 476; 1,801 cases reported so far, including 849 within Coimbatore city limits. Yearly trend shows 2023: 1,336; 2024: 2,400; 2025: 749; current year urban 1,040 and rural 761. Monthly counts: Jan 124, Feb 67, Mar 55, Apr 76, May 72, Jun 82, Jul 157, Aug 171. Outside city limits, hotspots include Karamadai, Gudalur, Annur, Dhaliyur, Periyanaickenpalayam, Somayampalayam, Malumichampatti, Perur Chettipalayam. Preventive measures: intensified mosquito breeding checks, destruction of breeding sources, door-to-door surveys, and removal of over 60 lakh containers; construction-site SOP with Rs 35 lakh in fines; Gambusia fish releases; Operation Shield; Dengue Preventive League; ensure chlorination and adequate DBC workers. Minister Arunraj chaired a meeting; Sowbakya Nagar hotspot reported eight dengue cases. 5,641 fever cases reported this year.

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis A Immunity Stays High in Urban India While Hepatitis E Exposure
article.articleSummary: In urban Vellore, southern India, IgG serology for hepatitis A virus (HAV) and hepatitis E virus (HEV) was measured in two cross-sectional cohorts (2013: n=600; 2022: n=558), ages 1–40. HAV immunity remained highly endemic and uniform across years: seroprevalence >80% among 1–5-year-olds and 100% by age 16+, with no statistically significant year-to-year differences. HEV exposure stayed low in youth and increased gradually with age; among adults 26–40, seroprevalence rose from 18% (2013) to 24% (2022), a non-significant change. Cluster analyses showed HAV seroprevalence was uniformly high across neighborhoods, while HEV exposure was low and heterogeneous, indicating localized risk factors. The estimated effective reproduction number for HAV (Re) was below 1 in both surveys, implying no sustained secondary transmission. Findings reflect a stable HAV-endemic milieu amid urban development and a patchy, slowly accumulating HEV exposure, with surveillance implications.

article.articleHeadline: Congo's worst Ebola epidemic ever passes 7,000 cases
article.articleSummary: Congo's worst Ebola epidemic on record has reached 7,022 cases, with 3,398 deaths and 1,671 recoveries since mid-May. The outbreak began in Ituri province and has spread to eastern and northern regions; South-Ubangi—borders CAR and Congo-Brazzaville—was confirmed as infected last week, marking a seventh province affected. Government figures indicate the peak occurred in the early third week of August, with indicators showing a decline and 10 of 61 health zones reporting no new cases for at least 21 days. Most cases remain in Ituri, including detections in schools after the summer break in Bunia. The epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment, though several therapies and vaccines are being tested. Ebola transmits via contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ史上最悪のエボラ流行、症例数が7,000人を突破

article.articleHeadline: Azithromycin Resistance in Gonorrhea Shifts Genetic Ground, Challenging
article.articleSummary: Azithromycin resistance in Neisseria gonorrhoeae is rising globally, undermining ceftriaxone-azithromycin dual therapy for uncomplicated gonorrhea. WHO classifies this pathogen as high-priority due to rapid resistance evolution and few new drugs in development; ceftriaxone 1 g IM remains first-line, while zoliflodacin and gepotidacin offer limited alternatives. Strains with concurrent ceftriaxone and azithromycin resistance have emerged in several regions, and high treatment costs hinder access in resource-limited settings. In 2022, azithromycin resistance was detected in 46 of 53 countries (87%), with ≥5% resistance in 36 countries. European data (2020–2022) show resistance at 9.4% (up from 8.0% in 2018). In the US, elevated-MIC isolates rose to 4.6% in 2018 and 5.9% in 2019. In the Western Pacific, China reached 16.9% in 2022, while the Philippines remained susceptible.

triage.headline_ja: 淋菌のアジスロマイシン耐性が遺伝的基盤を変化させ、分子サーベイランスに課題

triage.notes: 本記事は特定国での急性アウトブレイクではなく、淋菌のアジスロマイシン耐性に関するグローバルなAMR動向のレビュー。中国は耐性率16.9%と具体的データが示されているが、フィリピンは『susceptible remained』と問題なしの記述のため除外した。米国・欧州データも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: نمایش رسوایی نتانیاهو | علائم سویه جدید کرونا؛ کاسیدا | ترامپ در محاصره دو تنگه
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Netanyahu Scandal Show | Symptoms of the New Coronavirus Strain; Kasida | Trump Trapped Between Two Straits
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infections are rising in Iran, with the Health Ministry reporting the positivity rate crossing the lower alert threshold and urging intensified surveillance and management of acute respiratory infections, especially COVID-19 and influenza. The issue also covers geopolitics and public health context: the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandeb as strategic chokepoints shaping Western Asia dynamics; the 18th BRICS summit in Delhi discussing stronger trade, cross-border payments, energy security, and broader use of national currencies. A Yemen-based group reportedly attempted to use the AI cloud to develop missile guidance software. In the Philippines, a deadly passenger-ship fire left three bodies recovered among 134 aboard. El Niño forecasts warn of strong autumn/winter rainfall and potential floods in parts of the region. The documentary Naza analyzes the mechanics of a mass slaughter, with other health updates summarized.

triage.headline_ja: ネタニヤフのスキャンダルショー｜新型コロナ変異株の症状；カシーダ｜二つの海峡に挟まれたトランプ
triage.triage_reason: イランでの季節性COVID-19/インフルエンザ増加に関する記事であり、対象国（India, Philippinesなど）は地政学的文脈での言及に留まり、感染症イベントの主題ではないため対象国での有意なシグナルとは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイランにおけるCOVID-19陽性率上昇と季節性呼吸器感染症サーベイランス強化の呼びかけ。India（デリー）はBRICSサミットの文脈、Philippinesはフェリー火災事故の文脈で言及されており、いずれも感染症イベントとは無関係。イランは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Bulacan logs 5 leptospirosis deaths as cases rise to nearly 400
article.articleSummary: Five leptospirosis deaths and 394 total cases in Bulacan since January as floods persist in Malolos City and nearby towns. The most recent death was a 38-year-old man from Muzon Proper, City of San Jose del Monte, on August 12; earlier fatalities include a 60-year-old man from Santa Cruz, Hagonoy (July 24); a 47-year-old woman from Pandi (July 3); a 13-year-old boy from Sta. Maria (June 22); and a 53-year-old man from San Miguel (March 23). Symptoms typically appear about two weeks after floodwater exposure. Prophylaxis with doxycycline is being distributed to exposed residents via municipal/city health offices. Sixty-eight flooded barangays with water up to six feet affect Calumpit, Hagonoy, Paombong, and Malolos City; Meysulao in Calumpit is six feet, with 25 of 29 villages at five feet. Affected population totals 154,961 people in 29 barangays; 6,539 residents in 33 evacuation centers. Calumpit and the province are under calamity declarations.

triage.headline_ja: ブラカン州でレプトスピラ症による死者5人、症例数はほぼ400人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の季節性レプトスピラ症でフィリピン国内では毎年見られるパターンだが、死亡者数・被災者数が大きく規模拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は動物由来感染症で人-人感染はなく、洪水による毎年の季節性発生パターンに該当する。地方自治体が予防的にドキシサイクリン配布や避難所運営を実施中であり、外部（国際）支援の必要性は記事内で言及されていない。ただし被災者数15万人超、死者数増加傾向のため引き続き情報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di RD Kongo Menyebar ke 7 Provinsi, Jumlah Kasus Lampaui 7.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Spreads to Seven Provinces, Case Count Surpasses 7,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached seven provinces, with more than 7,000 cases and 3,398 deaths as of Sept 12, 2026—the worst outbreak on record for the country. Official figures show 7,022 cases since mid-May, with 1,671 recoveries. The outbreak began in Ituri province in the northeast and has spread to eastern and northern regions, reaching Ubangi-Sud near borders with the Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville. Authorities say the peak occurred in early week three of August, and all indicators point to a decline, with 10 of 61 health zones reporting no new cases for at least 21 days. Most cases remain in Ituri, including detections in schools after students returned from holidays, prompting reinforced hygiene and class-size measures. Ebola spreads via contact with body fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、7州に拡大 感染者数7,000人超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が近隣国境まで拡大しているためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州発端）のエボラ流行が7州に拡大し、7,022例・3,398死亡（致死率約48%）に達し史上最悪の流行と報じている。中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国との国境地域（ウバンギ・スード州）にも到達しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ピーク後の減少傾向も報告されているが、規模と致死率の高さから引き続き監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: उत्तराखंड के हल्द्वानी में स्वाइन फ्लू का कहर, 10 दिन में तीसरी मौत - third swine flu death at sth haldwani in 10 days
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu wreaks havoc in Haldwani, Uttarakhand; third death in 10 days.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) deaths have reached three in 10 days at Sushila Tiwari Hospital (STH) in HaldwanI, Uttarakhand. A 65-year-old woman—originally from Bageshwar, residing in Lamachaur, and undergoing chemotherapy for cancer—died in ICU on Saturday after referral from a private hospital where she had pneumonia; she was admitted to STH on 2 September. Earlier, a 62-year-old man from Nainital died on 3 September and a 65-year-old woman from Rati Ghat died on 5 September; both had serious preexisting conditions. On Saturday, a 70-year-old woman from Kashipur tested positive and was admitted; a doctor at STH also tested positive and is in home isolation. Two swine flu patients remain hospitalized. Health authorities, led by CMO Dr. Rashmi Pant, say steps are in place to curb transmission, ensure rapid treatment, and monitor cases.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタラーカンド州ハルドワニで豚インフルエンザ猛威、10日間で3人目の死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタラーカンド州で季節性H1N1による死亡が10日間で3件発生し、医療従事者への感染も確認されているが、死亡例はいずれも基礎疾患を有する患者であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: H1N1はインドで季節性に流行する疾患であり、今回の死亡例は全て基礎疾患（がん治療中、既往症等）を有する高齢者。医師1名の感染確認によりヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は示唆されるが、地域当局が対応中であり国際支援の必要性は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: รู้จัก 'ไข้เห็บสุนัข' พบในไทย 53 ราย เสียชีวิต 5 ราย จับตาจีน หวั่นไวรัสอุบัติใหม่ - The Bangkok Insight
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Learn about 'Dog Tick Fever' found in Thailand: 53 cases, 5 deaths; watching China amid fears of a novel virus outbreak - The Bangkok Insight
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 53 cases of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) linked to brown dog ticks (Rhipicephalus sanguineus), with 5 deaths, across all regions as of 2026-09-13. SFTS is caused by viruses in the family Phenuiviridae and genus Bandavirus; patients present with high fever, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, and can progress to multi-organ failure. Older individuals and those with chronic disease are at higher risk of mortality. Transmission occurs via tick bites, and handling or crushing ticks with bare hands poses infection risk. Dogs frequently harbor brown dog ticks; regular anti-tick prevention is advised for households with dogs. Notably, more than 30% of clinically diagnosed SFTS cases did not test positive for the known DBV, suggesting other pathogens. Separately, China reports a novel orthonairovirus with similar symptoms in ticks, underscoring the need for improved differential diagnostics and surveillance for co-circulating tickborne viruses in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 「犬マダニ熱」を知る タイで53例発生、5人死亡 中国の新興ウイルスにも警戒
triage.triage_reason: タイでSFTS(重症熱性血小板減少症候群)53例・死亡5例が確認され、うち3割超が既知の病原体陰性という異常な所見があり、さらに中国で類似症状を示す新規オルソナイロウイルスの報告もあることから、IHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: タイのSFTS(マダニ媒介)53例・死亡5例に加え、臨床診断例の30%以上が既知のDBV陰性であることから未知病原体の関与が疑われる。中国で報告された新規オルソナイロウイルス(Wetland Virus)との関連・鑑別診断の必要性が指摘されており、地域全体でのマダニ媒介ウイルスのサーベイランス強化が求められる。

article.articleHeadline: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 7,000 cases
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 7,000 cases, with 7,022 infections, 3,398 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries reported as of Sept 12–13, 2026. The current outbreak, the country’s 17th, began in mid-May in Ituri and has spread to eastern and northern regions with weak health systems amid armed conflict. A new case was confirmed in South Ubangi Province, bordering the Central African Republic and the Republic of the Congo. Authorities say the peak occurred in the early third week of August, and indicators show a decline, with 10 of 61 health zones having no new cases for at least 21 days. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment; several therapies and vaccines are under investigation. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids and can cause bleeding and organ failure; in Ituri, school clusters were detected after students returned from summer vacation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが7,000症例を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が7,000例・3,398死亡に達し、国境地域(中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国と接するSouth Ubangi州)にも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。承認されたワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株による第17回目の流行で、武力紛争下の脆弱な保健システムが対応をさらに困難にしている。

article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpass 7,000 confirmed cases, with 3,998 deaths and 1,671 recoveries. The 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, centered in Ituri province in the northeast, has now spread to South Ubangi, bordering the Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville, marking the seventh province affected. Officials say the peak was surpassed in the early third week of August, with 10 of 61 affected health zones reporting no new cases for 21 days. Schools reported Ebola infections ahead of the new school year, fueling concerns. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible; there is no approved vaccine or treatment yet, though therapies and vaccines are being trialed. WHO says 5,000 more health workers are needed, and funding gaps jeopardize isolation and patient monitoring. Context: the 2018-2020 outbreak killed about 2,300 of 3,500 cases in DRC.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has surpassed 7,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 7,000 cases, the deadliest in the country’s history, with 7,022 cases, 3,398 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries as of 12 September, per Congolese authorities. article.articleHeadline: പാനൂരിൽ വൈറൽ പനി വ്യാപകം; ആശുപത്രിയിൽ രോഗികളുടെ തിരക്ക് | Panur Viral Fever Outbreak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Fever Outbreak in Panur; Rush of Patients at the Hospital.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, Panur Government Hospital and nearby facilities in Thalassery report a surge in fever cases, with viral fever common and dengue and chikungunya reported in some hospitals. Fever patients are rising at Panur Govt Hospital; daily cases at Thalassery taluk hospital reflect the trend, as do Thalassery city cooperative and private hospitals. Symptoms include prolonged fever, fatigue, cough with phlegm, nausea, body pains, headache and loss of appetite; fever often lasts longer than the usual 2–3 days and may recur, with lingering fatigue delaying return to normal life. Laboratory confirmation and accurate diagnosis are needed. Contributory factors include weather changes, rising mosquito populations, and environmental contamination; health authorities urge cleaning surroundings, removing mosquito breeding sites, and ensuring safe drinking water. Those with respiratory symptoms, severe body pains, persistent vomiting, or marked fatigue should seek care rather than self-medicate. Heightened vigilance in the Thalassery-Panur region is urged.

article.articleHeadline: Climate change, waterlogging fuel vector-borne disease risk in NE: Parliament panel
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, a Parliament Standing Committee report on vector-borne diseases in North East India warns that the North Eastern Region (NER)’s unique geo-climatic, ecological, and socio-economic setting yields high receptivity and perennial transmission of vector-borne diseases (VBDs). Key determinants include environmental and climatic conditions, abundant water bodies, deforestation, shifting cultivation, and unplanned urbanisation. Intense monsoon rains create ideal mosquito breeding habitats, while paddy fields, ponds, blocked drains, and poorly maintained water storage systems boost proliferation. Dense forest cover supports forest-dwelling vectors such as Anopheles dirus and Anopheles fluviatilis, described as highly efficient malaria vectors. The report underscores elevated vulnerability to VBDs in NE India, though no specific case counts or outbreaks are cited in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動と冠水がインド北東部の媒介性疾患リスクを助長：議会委員会報告

triage.notes: 記事は具体的な発生事例ではなく、インド北東部における媒介性疾患(マラリア含む)のリスク要因に関する議会委員会の一般的報告。具体的な症例数・アウトブレイクの言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: പനി മാറിയാലും ക്ഷീണം വിടുന്നില്ല; പാനൂർ-തലശ്ശേരി മേഖലയിൽ പനി ബാധിതർ വർധിക്കുന്നു, ഡെങ്കിപ്പനിയും എലിപ്പനിയും റിപ്പോർട്ട് ചെയ്തതോടെ ആരോഗ്യവകുപ്പിന് ആശങ്ക
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fatigue persists even after fever subsides; dengue fever and leptospirosis cases rising in the Panur–Thalassery area, health department concerned.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, fever admissions are rising in the Panur–Thalassery area, with patients seeking care at Panur Government Hospital and in Thalassery town facilities. Dengue fever and leptospirosis are being reported among fever patients. Prolonged fever lasting several days is common, along with severe cough, body pains, nausea, dizziness, fatigue, headaches, and loss of appetite; fatigue often persists after fever subsides, delaying return to normal life. Daily fever-patient visits have increased at Panur Government Hospital, with similar trends in Thalassery hospitals. Some facilities report dengue and leptospirosis, underscoring the need for laboratory confirmation. Climate shifts, rising mosquitoes, vector breeding, and environmental contamination are cited as transmission aids. Public health guidance emphasizes sanitation, removal of breeding sites, and ensuring clean drinking water. Those with respiratory symptoms or persistent fever should consult health professionals rather than self-medicate. The health department is boosting surveillance in the Panur–Thalassery region.

triage.triage_reason: インドの特定地域(ケララ州パヌール・タラシェリー)でデング熱・レプトスピラ症の季節性増加が報告されているが、重症度や規模の具体的データが不足しており、地域の風土病的流行として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱とレプトスピラ症はケララ州で毎年雨季後に増加する風土病的疾患であり、今回の報告も地域保健当局によるサーベイランス強化の一環と見られる。重症例数や死亡者数などの具体的データが記事にないため、severity等は不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: कानपुर में डेंगू, स्वाइन फ्लू और स्क्रब टायफस के नए मामले, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट पर - kanpur reports new dengue swine flu scrub typhus cases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kanpur, new cases of dengue, swine flu, and scrub typhus; health department on alert.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, Kanpur Nagar district reports dengue, swine flu, and scrub typhus cases. A 44-year-old woman from Barra 3 tested dengue-positive; another swine flu case was detected; a 69-year-old woman from Krishna Nagar has scrub typhus. Overall, 92 dengue, 2 swine flu, and 2 scrub typhus infections have been reported in the district. Deputy CMO Dr. Rajeshwar Singh said intensified sampling is revealing dengue and swine flu in affected areas, with fever clinics and testing expanded. Scrub typhus is transmitted by jiggers (chigger mites) carrying Orientia tsutsugamushi; early symptoms appear within about 10 days of bite and include fever, headache, body ache, and a dark crust at the bite site. Risk is higher in rural areas and fields; district teams are screening slums and other communities.

triage.headline_ja: カンプールでデング熱、豚インフルエンザ、ツツガムシ病の新規症例、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の地域内感染症（デング熱・豚インフルエンザ・ツツガムシ病）の通常規模の発生報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局(Deputy CMO)によるルーティンのサーベイランス対応であり、症例数も少数(デング熱92件、他各2件)。ブラジル(Bahia州)は記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 史上最严重埃博拉疫情　刚果（金）记录逾7000病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadliest Ebola outbreak in history: Democratic Republic of the Congo records more than 7,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has logged over 7,000 Ebola cases—the deadliest outbreak in its history—with about 3,398 deaths and 1,671 recoveries. First detected in mid-May, the outbreak is the DRC’s 17th and is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, spreading from Ituri province in the northeast to eastern and northern regions, with South Ubangi province near the Central African Republic and Republic of Congo also reporting cases. Officials say the peak occurred in the third week of August and indicators show a decline; 10 of 61 health zones have had no new cases for at least 21 days. Ituri, especially Bunia city, remains most affected as schools reopen post-summer with strict hygiene measures. There is no approved vaccine or treatment yet; several therapies and vaccines are under evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最も深刻なエボラ流行:コンゴ民主共和国で7000症例以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の史上最大規模の流行(7000症例超、致死率約48%)で複数州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国及びコンゴ共和国での症例報告についても言及があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認されたワクチン・治療薬はまだ存在しないが、複数の候補が評価中とのこと。ピークは8月第3週で減少傾向にあるが、依然として大規模流行が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Η επιδημία του Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό ξεπέρασε τις 7.000 περιπτώσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpassed 7,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 7,022 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 3,998 deaths and 1,671 recoveries. The epidemic, the worst in the country’s history, began in Ituri province (northeast) and has spread to a seventh province, South Ubangi, which borders the Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville; Ituri remains the epicenter. Officials say the peak was surpassed in early August, with indicators showing a declining trend, including 10 of 61 affected health zones reporting no new cases for at least 21 days. Amid the downturn, infections linked to schools have raised concerns ahead of the new academic year, underscoring ongoing transmission risk despite signs of containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が7,000症例を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が7,000症例・約4,000人の死者に達し、国境を接する中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国方面の州にも拡大しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルリスク評価に進む。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国は国境隣接州への拡大文脈で言及されているが、両国内での症例発生は記載されていないため verified_locations には含めない。学校関連感染の報告があり、新学期を控え感染拡大リスクが懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie im Kongo: Bisher mehr als 7.000 Ebola-Fälle in DR Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Congo: So far more than 7,000 Ebola cases in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 7,000 cases as of 2026-09-13, with 7,022 laboratory-confirmed infections and about 3,400 deaths since mid-May, according to Kinshasa’s national health institute. Currently 837 people are in isolation or treatment. The outbreak has expanded to a seventh province, Sud-Ubangi in the northwest, indicating geographic spread from its eastern origin. In Ituri province, the northeast, authorities report some hotspots showing a slight decline, but transmission remains high. Ebola symptoms include high fever, diarrhea, and bleeding, transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids. There is no specific vaccine or therapy for the Bundibugyo strain involved. Africa CDC notes hopeful signals amid rapid case growth, yet experts warn that official counts likely underestimate the true caseload since only cases since May 15 are included; the situation is ongoing and being updated.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行:これまでにDRコンゴで7,000件以上のエボラ症例
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)が7,000例超・死亡約3,400人に達し、第7州へ地理的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 対象株はブンディブギョ株で特効ワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、既存のザイール株向けワクチンの有効性が限定的である可能性に注意。感染は東部起源から北西部のSud-Ubangi州へ拡大しており、国際的拡大リスクも継続的に監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: "Θερίζει" ο Έμπολα, εξαπλώθηκε και σε 7η επαρχία - Πάνω από 7.000 κρούσματα και 3.998 θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola is ravaging the country, has spread to the seventh province - More than 7,000 cases and 3,998 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has surpassed 7,000 confirmed infections with 7,022 laboratory-confirmed cases, 3,998 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries. The epicenter remains Ituri province in the northeast, but the outbreak has spread to a seventh province, South Ubangi, which borders the Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville. Officials report the peak may be over, noting declines in several health zones since late August, yet infections surfaced in schools ahead of the new term, raising alarm. Funding gaps hinder isolation and surveillance efforts. The World Health Organization estimates a need for about 5,000 additional health workers. Trials are underway for therapies and vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved treatment exists to date.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ:エボラが猛威を振るい、第7州にも拡大 - 7,000人以上の感染者と3,998人の死者
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が7州に拡大し、死者3,998人・致死率が非常に高く、国境地域への拡大や医療従事者不足など国際的懸念が強いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国は国境に接するとの言及のみで、実際の症例発生地としての記載はないため対象国リストにも該当せず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πάνω από 7.000 κρούσματα και σχεδόν 4.000 θάνατοι στη ΛΔ του Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Over 7,000 cases and nearly 4,000 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reports 7,022 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,998 deaths, with 1,671 recoveries, marking the 17th outbreak in the country. Initiated mid-May, the epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, with eastern and northern regions affected amid security challenges. This week the virus appeared in Sud-Ubangi, the seventh province, bordering the Central African Republic and the Republic of the Congo. Authorities say the peak has passed, noting a decline in cases and that 10 of 61 health zones have seen no new infections for at least 21 days. Ituri remains the main epicenter. Schools are a concern as cases emerge ahead of the new term; measures include handwashing, smaller class sizes, and avoiding close contact. WHO estimates a need for about 5,000 more health workers. Trials for Bundibugyo ebolavirus therapies/vaccines are underway; no approved specific treatment yet. The 2018–2020 outbreak caused about 2,300 deaths among ~3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国で7,000例以上、死者はほぼ4,000人に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで第17次エボラ流行が拡大し、致死率約57%、7000例超・死者4000人近くに達し、新たな州（南ウバンギ）にも拡大しているため、IHR基準の複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国は国境地帯として言及されているが、感染確認地としては明記されていないため対象国リストに含まれる同国は除外。WHOは追加で約5000人の医療従事者が必要と推計しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Gov't orders mandatory 21-day quarantine for students travelling from DRC
article.articleSummary: Mandatory 21-day quarantine for students traveling from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) into Uganda to start the third-term academic calendar, aiming to minimize Ebola transmission risk. The policy follows a technical risk assessment; quarantined students will be supervised before reporting to their schools. Announced by Kedrace Turyagyenda, Permanent Secretary in the Ministry of Education, the measure targets cross-border movement amid regional Ebola concerns. The policy does not cite any Ebola cases or laboratory confirmations; it emphasizes precaution to prevent importation of the virus into Uganda's education system and communities. The quarantine applies to imported cases and requires supervision prior to school re-entry, reflecting heightened public health measures as of 2026-09-13.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、DRCから渡航する学生に対し21日間の強制隔離を命令
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)からのエボラ出血熱越境リスクに対し、ウガンダ政府が学生への強制隔離・渡航制限措置を発表しており、IHR基準（国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限）を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事自体はDRC国内での具体的なエボラ症例やラボ確認について言及しておらず、地域的な懸念を踏まえた予防的措置であることに留意。DRCの実際の発生状況については追加情報が必要。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от Ебола в Конго надхвърли 7000 случая и обхвана нова провинция
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpassed 7,000 cases and spread to a new province.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 7,000 confirmed cases and 3,398 deaths, with 7,022 confirmed across seven provinces. The epidemic, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is the largest and deadliest in Congo’s history, surpassed only globally by the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with over 28,600 cases and >11,000 deaths. A confirmed spillover case was detected in South Ubangi province in the northwest: a 23-year-old man who died on Tuesday tested positive after leaving eastern South Kivu on July 10, spending time abroad, and re-entering via South Ubangi. Contact tracing for the first South Ubangi case is ongoing. WHO warns of shortages of trained staff, operational partners, and funding; about 1,400 beds across 59 treatment centers exist, with a need for 1,600 more beds and roughly 9,000 health workers. Running a 50-bed center costs about $500,000.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が7000症例を超え、新たな州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が7000症例・3398人の死者を超え、同国史上最大規模となり新州（南ウバンギ州）へ拡大したため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較対象として言及されているのみで、現行の発生国ではないため除外した。感染者が国外へ渡航後、南ウバンギ州で再入国し死亡した事例が確認されており、国境を越えた拡散リスクが懸念される。
