article.articleHeadline: भोपाल में स्वाइन फ्लू का खतरा बढ़ा: सितंबर में 43 नए केस, 80 साल के बुजुर्ग की मौत - bhopal swine flu first death 43 new h1n1 cases in sept
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu Risk Increases in Bhopal: 43 New Cases in September, Death of an 80-Year-Old Man
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) infections are rising in Bhopal, India. In September, 43 new cases have tested positive, bringing the season's total to 65 cases in the city since January 2026; 232 suspected samples have been tested. An 80-year-old man, Ram Singh of Old Minal Residency, died during treatment, having developed severe respiratory distress syndrome and acute respiratory failure; he had underlying heart disease, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes. Other recent cases include 70-year-old Rajesh Agarwal of Suraj Nagar, Bhadbhada Road, and 66-year-old Govind Das of Gadarpura, Narsinghpur, who are hospitalised. Recovered patients include 13-year-old Srishti Garg of Shalimar Park (Kolar Road), 41-year-old Sandeep Sharma of Patel Nagar (Mandideep), and 40-year-old Piyush Trivedi of Emerald Park City, who have been discharged. Health authorities have ensured beds and medications in major hospitals; residents with fever, cough, high fever, or breathing difficulty should seek testing and avoid crowds if severely ill.

triage.headline_ja: ボーパールでスワインフルの脅威増大：9月に43件の新規感染、80歳男性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド国内で季節性H1N1（スワインフル）の感染増加と死亡例が報告されているが、既知の疾患であり大規模な国際的懸念には至っていないため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザであり、地域的な流行として現地保健当局が対応中。死亡例は基礎疾患を有する高齢者。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、季節性流行として継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 독감 유행주의보까지 떴다...입원환자 1년 새 13배 | 아주경제
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza outbreak warning issued... Inpatient numbers up 13-fold in a year | Aju Economy
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Korea surged in week 36 (Aug 30–Sep 5, 2026), with hospitalizations at 300 in tertiary surveillance—about 1.8× the prior week and roughly 13× the year-ago level. Inpatients aged 65+ comprised 60% of cases. Sentinel outpatient influenza-like illness (ILI) rose to 25.3 per 1000 visits, above the threshold 12.9; last year this was 6.6. By age, 7–12 years had the highest outpatient ILI rate (75.1/1000), followed by 1–6 (49.8) and 13–18 (31.3). On Sep 11, KDCA issued a seasonal influenza warning for 2026–2027, earlier than last season by over a month. The circulating virus is influenza A(H1N1)pdm09; no vaccine-mismatch or resistance mutations detected. Vaccination begins Sep 21 for high-risk groups (two doses for some children and pregnant women), Sep 28 for other children, and Oct 12 for 65+. Japan and China also report earlier or rising influenza activity.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ流行注意報発令…入院患者数1年で13倍に | 亜洲経済
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(A/H1N1pdm09、変異・ワクチンミスマッチなし)の流行だが、例年より早期の警報発令と入院者数の急増(前年比13倍)という異常なパターンが見られるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は韓国の季節性インフルエンザ流行(KDCAが2026-27シーズンの警報を早期発令)。日本・中国への言及は付随的で具体的データがなく主題ではないため、対象国リストの中国も含め verified_locations には含めない。韓国・日本は対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னை மற்றும் புறநகர் பகுதிகளில் காய்ச்சல் பாதிப்புகள் அதிகரிப்பு; மருத்துவர்கள் அறிவுறுத்தல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in fever cases in Chennai and suburban areas; doctors warn.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-13, Chennai and its suburbs report rising fever cases. Of about 2,000 fevers in the last 10 days, 140 are laboratory-confirmed dengue. In August, among 4,500 fever cases, 160 dengue confirmations were recorded. Highest incidence is in Adyar, Anna Nagar, and Valasaravakkam. Doctors warn that influenza A, rhinovirus, and RSV are circulating. A viral fever in a household can spread quickly, so feverish individuals should seek medical advice. To curb transmission, authorities urge eliminating standing water, improving outdoor cleanliness, and keeping homes, buildings, and surrounding areas free of garbage and waste. The outbreak signals a dengue and broader viral fever resurgence in Chennai’s metro region, underscoring vigilance and hygiene measures.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイおよび近郊で発熱症例が増加、医師が注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・インフルエンザA・RSVの増加であり、通常みられる季節的流行の範囲内と考えられるが、症例数増加の推移は注視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱、インフルエンザA、RSVの季節的増加。チェンナイ市内および近郊(Adyar, Anna Nagar, Valasaravakkam)で確認。重症度や死亡例の記載なし。標準的な公衆衛生対応（水たまり除去、衛生改善）が呼びかけられている。

article.articleHeadline: 독감 '겨울 유행' 공식 깨진다... 9월인데 작년 대비 4배 폭증-사회ㅣ한국일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu 'winter surge' breaks the official line... September sees a fourfold surge compared with last year - Society | Hankook Ilbo.
article.articleSummary: Influenza enters an early 2026–2027 season in South Korea as the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency issued an influenza alert on 11 September 2026, earlier than 2025 and 2024. In Week 36 (Aug 30–Sep 5), influenza-like illness at outpatient clinics rose to 25.3 per 1,000, well above the 12.9 threshold and about 3.8 times higher than the previous year. The leading age group is 7–12 years (75.1 per 1,000), followed by 1–6 (49.8) and 13–18 (31.3). Concurrently, COVID-19 hospitalizations are rising (Week 33–36: 57, 61, 115, 193 inpatients; Week 36 last year: 433), raising twin-demic concerns and strain on beds. Japan and southern China report early flu activity; Southeast Asia patterns are noted. Preventive measures are urged. Vaccination begins Sept 21 for children needing two doses, with free vaccination from that date, though uptake is limited by cost (~30,000 won).

triage.headline_ja: インフル「冬流行」の定説崩れる…9月なのに前年比4倍急増－社会｜韓国日報
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は韓国における季節性インフルエンザの早期流行であり、対象国リストの国（中国・日本含む）は比較情報として一文触れられているのみで主題ではないため、モニタリング対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国国内の季節性インフルエンザ流行とCOVID-19入院増加によるツインデミック懸念が中心。日本・南部中国での早期流行の兆候が言及されているが、詳細データはなく主題として扱われていないため対象国として認定せず。

article.articleHeadline: From pandemics to supply shocks, PM Modi pushes crisis-ready BRICS; bloc agrees on disease early-warning system
article.articleSummary: At the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, India, BRICS leaders approved an integrated Early Warning System for infectious diseases and Data Integration Guidelines for disaster management, advancing Modi’s four-pillar agenda: resilience, innovation, cooperation and sustainability. The commitments were welcomed by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who highlighted universal health coverage, resilient health systems, tuberculosis, the health workforce, digital health and traditional medicine within the New Delhi Declaration’s health framework. UN Secretary-General António Guterres urged peace from Gaza and the broader Middle East to Ukraine and Sudan, urging adherence to the UN Charter and international law. The New Delhi Declaration expressed grave concern over Middle East tensions, called for maximum restraint, a Gaza ceasefire and an immediate permanent ceasefire in Sudan, and reaffirmed WHO’s coordinating role. The summit framed pandemics, climate disasters and supply-chain disruptions as interconnected, cross-border risks requiring proactive preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: パンデミックからサプライショックまで、モディ首相が危機対応型BRICSを推進;ブロックは感染症早期警報システムに合意
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、BRICS首脳会議における政策合意・宣言に関する政治的報道であり、公衆衛生上の具体的リスクは記載されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は国際政治サミットの報道であり、結核（Tuberculosis）は健康枠組みの一部として言及されているのみで、具体的な症例数・地域的アウトブレイク情報はない。Gaza, Sudan, Ukraineなどの地名も政治的文脈（紛争・停戦要請）で言及されているにすぎず、対象国リストにも該当しない。Indiaは開催地として言及されているが、感染症発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Bali Kejar Target Bebas Rabies 2030, Koster Sorot Pemilik Anjing, Tegas!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bali Targets Rabies-Free Status by 2030, Koster Highlights Dog Owners, Firm!
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, Bali aims to become rabies-free by 2030. Governor Wayan Koster says pet owners share responsibility with government and veterinarians for prevention, stressing animal health, routine vaccination, and responsible reproduction to lower risk. In Denpasar’s Jayasabha, during an 11 September meeting with the Indonesian Veterinary Association (PDHI) Bali, Koster endorsed a collaborative plan toward Bali Rabies-Free 2030. PDHI Bali outlined strategies including mass public education, expanded vaccination of rabies-transmitting animals, and free sterilization to humanely curb the stray dog population. Koster urged ongoing rabies awareness campaigns. The initiative emphasizes vaccination, population control, and sustained outreach in Bali, Indonesia, to achieve the 2030 rabies-free goal.

triage.headline_ja: バリ州、2030年狂犬病撲滅目標を追求 コスター知事、犬の飼い主に厳格な責任を強調
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病撲滅に向けた政策・啓発活動に関する内容であり、急性の公衆衛生危機や異常な発生は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の新規発生や症例急増を報告するものではなく、バリ州政府による2030年までの狂犬病撲滅計画（ワクチン接種、不妊手術、啓発活動）に関する行政的取り組みの紹介である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Djugu: trois cas confirmés au site de déplacés de la plaine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Djugu: three confirmed cases at the plains displaced persons site.
article.articleSummary: Three confirmed Ebola virus disease cases have been recorded at the Savo plains displacement site in Djugu territory, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The patients, presenting Ebola symptoms, were transferred to Fataki hospital, where laboratory tests confirmed infection. Contact tracing has been launched to identify and monitor people exposed to curb transmission. The Savo plains site shelters over 70,000 displaced people living in extreme overcrowding, with up to five to ten individuals sharing shelters, limited handwashing facilities, and restricted access to basic services, conditions that fuel spread. Patients are evacuated about 20 kilometers to Fataki hospital; MSF and Medair are supporting efforts, but needs remain high. Emmanuel Ndalo, head of the displaced persons committee, called on authorities and partners to bolster the response; meanwhile prevention campaigns continue at the site to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ジュグにおけるエボラ:サボ平原避難民サイトで3例確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例が過密な避難民キャンプ(7万人超)で発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 避難民キャンプでの過密状況・衛生設備不足がヒト-ヒト感染リスクを高めており、MSF/Medairが支援中だが対応能力の逼迫が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: এল নিনিও-র প্রকোপে দেশে বাড়বে ডেঙ্গি: 'হু'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue will rise in the country due to El Niño outbreak: WHO.
article.articleSummary: El Niño-induced warming and altered rainfall in the Pacific are expected to drive dengue and other heat-related illnesses in India, according to the WHO. The climate-driven rise in Aedes mosquito breeding, especially in urban areas, threatens intensified outbreaks as temperatures climb; India’s Meteorological Department is monitoring changes, with El Niño impact weak in June but likely stronger between October and December. In Delhi, dengue cases rose to 90 in August, bringing the total to 311 by August 29; malaria cases increased from 17 in July to 53 in August. WHO notes local climate and health system factors shape outcomes and does not attribute all vector-borne rise to El Niño alone. Public health messages emphasize sanitation, removal of standing water, and heightened precautions for the elderly, children, and pregnant women to mitigate anticipated outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョの影響でインド国内のデング熱が増加する見込み：WHO
triage.triage_reason: デリーでデング熱・マラリア症例数が季節的に増加しているが、WHOも気候要因による通常の季節変動と位置付けており、異常性や重篤性の明確な根拠は限定的。今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はエルニーニョによる気候変動がデング熱・マラリア発生に与える影響についての予測・注意喚起であり、特定の異常な大規模アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。デリーの症例数（デング311件、マラリア53件）は季節性の増加として言及されている。今後の症例数推移や重症化動向を継続的に確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Πάνω από 7.000 κρούσματα και σχεδόν 4.000 νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Over 7,000 cases and nearly 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 7,022 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 3,998 deaths, as the outbreak—centered in Ituri and spreading to South Ubangi—becomes the country’s worst on record. Recoveries total 1,671. The outbreak began in May as the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country, with health authorities now indicating the peak appears to have passed in late August; 10 of 61 affected health zones have had no new cases for at least 21 days. School infections have raised concerns ahead of the new academic year. Funding shortfalls jeopardize patient isolation and surveillance. The WHO estimates a need for 5,000 more health workers to manage the response. Trials are testing treatments and vaccines for the Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed product exists. The 2018–2020 outbreak in DR Congo caused about 2,299 deaths among 3,500 cases, the second deadliest in the country’s history.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：症例7,000人超、死者約4,000人に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模の流行となっており、深刻な公衆衛生への影響と国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性が明確であるためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 同国史上最悪のエボラ流行との報道。学校感染拡大への懸念、資金不足によるアイソレーション・サーベイランス機能の危機、WHOによる医療従事者5000人追加派遣の必要性が指摘されている。ブンディブギョ株には承認済みの治療薬・ワクチンが存在せず、治験段階。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونجو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 7 آلاف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 7,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 7,000, with 7,022 infections and 3,398 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries reported as of 2026-09-13. The outbreak, the seventeenth in the DRC, began mid-May in Ituri province in the northeast and has since spread to other areas facing weak health infrastructure and ongoing conflict. Most cases remain in Ituri, with confirmed transmission expanding to South Ubangi, the seventh province with cases. Authorities warn that Ebola, transmitted via contact with body fluids, can cause severe bleeding and multiorgan failure. The Bundibugyo strain is implicated; there is no vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. Public health measures in schools include handwashing and advising against handshakes to curb transmission, with authorities monitoring clusters in schools reopening after summer break.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数、7,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで7,000人以上に拡大し、複数州への波及、ワクチン未承認株、脆弱な保健インフラと紛争が重なり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 第17次DRCエボラ流行、Bundibugyo株でワクチン・治療薬未承認。イツリ州から南ウバンギ州など7州へ拡大、致死率約48%と高い。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: भोपाल में स्वाइन फ्लू से पहली मौत: 12 दिन में मिले 45 मरीज, कुल केस 65; फिलहाल सिर्फ एम्स में जांच
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First death due to swine flu in Bhopal: 45 patients detected in 12 days, total cases 65; tests currently being conducted only at AIIMS.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) in Bhopal, India: as of 13 September 2026, 65 cases identified, with 45 detected in the last 12 days. The first death is an 80-year-old man, Ram Singh, with heart disease, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes. Severe respiratory symptoms prompted testing for 232 patients; testing is currently conducted only at AIIMS, with Gandhi Medical College not yet offering regular testing. About 95% of influenza cases recover without hospitalization; testing is not required for every cold or fever, and clinicians decide eligibility. High-risk groups—elderly with cardiovascular disease or diabetes—are more likely to develop severe illness or flu pneumonia. Measures include isolation, masks, hand hygiene, rest, and fluids; antivirals should be taken only under medical advice. An influenza vaccine is available, with about 60–70% effectiveness; high-risk individuals should consult a doctor before vaccination, particularly if egg allergy.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールでスワインフルによる初の死亡例：12日間で45人の患者、累計65例；現在AIIMSのみで検査実施
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)による地域的な症例増加と初の死亡例が報告されているが、重症度や規模は限定的で国際的拡大の兆候はなく、地方メディアの報道にとどまる。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの地域的流行であり、高リスク群（高齢者、心血管疾患・糖尿病患者）での重症化が確認されている。検査体制の限定性（AIIMSのみ）が今後の症例把握に影響する可能性があり、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Knowledge Nugget | Foot and Mouth Disease: What is SAT-1 and why is its return matter of concern
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) SAT-1, a serotype traditionally linked to southern Africa, has reappeared in Europe and the Middle East after about six decades. SAT-1 was first identified in 1948; WOAH reports 2025 detections in Iraq, Kuwait, Egypt, and Azerbaijan, with 2026 additions in Israel, Cyprus, Palestine, China and Mongolia. Türkiye, Lebanon and Greece also reported the serotype again after ~60 years. FMD is a highly contagious viral disease affecting cloven-hoofed livestock (cattle, buffaloes, pigs, sheep, goats); signs include fever, blisters in the mouth and on feet, lameness, reduced milk yield. There is no specific antiviral treatment; control relies on vaccination and biosecurity. In India, the NADCP (launched 2019; under LHDCP since 2021) supports large-scale vaccination, vaccine procurement, cold-chain strengthening, and awareness for FMD and Brucellosis control. Human health risk is minimal, though the economic impact includes trade embargo risks and livestock losses.

triage.headline_ja: ナレッジナゲット | 口蹄疫：SAT-1とは何か、そしてその再出現がなぜ懸念されるのか
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT-1血清型が約60年ぶりに複数国・地域で再出現しており、異常性・国際的拡大・貿易制限リスクの3基準に該当するためフルRRAへ回付するが、人体への健康リスクは記事内で「最小限」と明記されている動物疾病である点に留意。
triage.notes: 本記事はUPSC受験対策の教育コンテンツであり、家畜の口蹄疫(FMD)SAT-1血清型が中東・欧州・アジアで約60年ぶりに再出現していることを解説。人間への健康リスクは最小限と明記されているが、家畜の経済的損失・貿易禁輸リスクが強調されている。対象国リスト中、記事本文で発生が明記されているのは中国のみ（インドはNADCPワクチン接種プログラムの文脈での言及であり、インドでの発生報告ではない）。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果（金）埃博拉疫情已波及7個省份 | 國際
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to 7 provinces | International.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has expanded to seven provinces as of Sept 10, 2026, with 7,022 laboratory-confirmed cases, 3,398 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries. The latest expansion adds South Ubangi Province, where a 23-year-old man with travel history to outbreak areas died, marking the first confirmed case in that province. The other affected provinces are Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, Lower Uele, and Tshopo. Africa CDC warns the outbreak is accelerating beyond the core epicenter, with rising cases and deaths in North Kivu and Upper Uele, though Ituri has seen declines. The outbreak began May 15. On Aug 12, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Authorities are boosting surveillance, patient care, and control measures to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、7州に拡大 | 国際
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国7州に拡大し、7,022例・3,398死亡と大規模で、史上2番目の規模とWHOが言及するなど深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が史上2番目の規模と言及し、Africa CDCも拡大を警告している。新州（South Ubangi）への拡大や致死率の高さも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Panika v školách po letných prázdninách. Ebola si v Kongu vyžiadala už takmer 3400 obetí | Info.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic in schools after the summer holidays. Ebola has claimed almost 3,400 victims in the Congo | Info.sk.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 7,022 recorded cases and 3,398 deaths, with 1,671 recoveries as of Sept 12. Ituri province accounts for most confirmed cases, and the virus has expanded this week to Southern Ubangi province. Officials say the peak occurred in early August (week 3), and 10 of 61 zones have had no new cases for at least 21 days. In Ituri, outbreaks reached school settings after students returned from holidays, prompting measures such as mandatory handwashing with soap and classroom caps of 30 students to reduce transmission. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak officially declared in the DRC since May 15, with ongoing transmission in eastern and northern regions affected by conflict and weak health infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: 夏休み明けの学校でパニック。コンゴのエボラ出血熱による死者数はすでに約3,400人に達した｜Info.sk
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが7,022症例・3,398死亡に達し、新たな州や学校への拡大が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRCで2026年5月15日以降17件目のエボラアウトブレイクとされ、Ituri州を中心に北ウバンギ州へ拡大。学校での感染事例が報告され、紛争地域の脆弱な医療体制下で対応が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: ज्याेलीकोट में पीलिया का प्रकोप: 471 की स्वास्थ्य जांच, 50 के लिए सैंपल... पांच नए मरीज भर्ती - jyolikot jaundice outbreak 471 screened 5 new patients admitted
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jyolikot jaundice outbreak: 471 screened, samples for 50 people; five new patients admitted.
article.articleSummary: JyoliKot/Jaundice outbreak in JyoliKot area of Nainital district, Uttarakhand, is a waterborne infection. As of 13 September 2026, 471 residents were screened, 50 blood samples collected, and five new patients admitted; two deaths have occurred in the outbreak. Health teams screened 390 people at field camps and 81 at the Primary Health Centre JyoliKot; a dedicated OPD will run 9:00 AM–3:00 PM on Sunday. Officials, including MLA Sarita Arya, ADM Saurabh Aswal, and CMO Dr. Rashmi Pant, inspected affected areas and directed actions. Water-supply and sanitation interventions are ongoing: Water-Nigam and Jal Sansthan deployed tankers—five tankers reaching 126 families and nine tankers serving areas such as Sardiatal, Bakhrkhod, and Debuvazala for about 85 families; 41 households had their personal tanks chlorinated. Fifteen sampling sites were used; samples were sent to Shri Ram Laboratory, Delhi, with testing also conducted in local labs as staff permitted.

triage.headline_ja: ジョリコットで黄疸(ジャウンディス)の集団発生：471人が健康診断を受け、5人の新規患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: 水系感染症による集団発生で死亡例が2件あり、地域当局が水供給・衛生対策を実施しているため、社会的・行政的関心が高くWPRO基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地はウッタラーカンド州ナイニタール地区ジョリコットであり、Delhiは検体送付先の検査施設に過ぎないため発生地域から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 'أسوأ تفشٍ'.. حصيلة إصابات 'إيبولا' تتجاوز 7 آلاف حالة في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'The worst outbreak'... The Ebola case count has surpassed 7,000 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 7,000 infections, with 3,398 deaths and 1,671 recoveries as of 13 September 2026. It is the worst on record, now affecting seven provinces, with the majority of cases in Ituri Province in the northeast. The outbreak began in Ituri’s North-East and has spread to remote eastern and northern areas amid conflict and weak health infrastructure; the latest transmission has reached South Ubangi Province, bordering the Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville. The disease is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, transmitted through contact with body fluids and can cause severe internal and external bleeding and organ failure; there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. School settings report transmission risk despite measures—handwashing with soap and limited classroom occupancy to 30 students—alongside ongoing hygiene education to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 「最悪の流行」...コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染者数が7000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が7州に拡大し、致死率も高く、ワクチン・治療法未承認の株であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国およびコンゴ共和国は国境地帯として言及されているが、実際の感染拡大・症例発生地はDRC国内（Ituri州及びSouth Ubangi州など）であり、両国は対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法未承認であり、紛争地域での医療インフラ脆弱性も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ludhiana: Health Department steps up dengue surveillance - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Ludhiana district's Health Department intensified dengue surveillance and control, reporting 36 dengue cases this year. During a comprehensive house-to-house drive, 267 areas were covered, 10,846 houses inspected, and 25,258 water-holding containers checked for mosquito breeding. Dengue larvae were found in 45 houses and 49 containers, with immediate actions taken to remove breeding sources. The drive forms part of ongoing surveillance and awareness efforts led by Civil Surgeon Dr Ramandeep Kaur, who emphasized communal responsibility and weekly inspections through the 'Har Shukarvar Dengue te Vaar' initiative. The department has issued 1,301 challans this season for detection of dengue larvae to strengthen outbreak prevention. Residents are urged to participate by routinely inspecting their homes and surroundings and eliminating stagnant water to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ルディヤーナ:保健局がデング熱サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域の季節性風土病であり、本記事は通常のサーベイランス・予防活動を報じたもので、異常な流行拡大や重症化の情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による通常のデング熱媒介蚊対策・監視活動の報道であり、症例数36件は特段の急増を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα: Ξεπέρασαν τα 7.000 τα κρούσματα, σχεδόν 3.400 θάνατοι στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic: Over 7,000 cases, nearly 3,400 deaths in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (17th Ebola epidemic in the country) began mid-May, centered in Ituri province (northeast) and extending to a seventh province, South Ubangi, near Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville borders. As of 13 September 2026, authorities report 7,022 laboratory-confirmed cases, 3,998 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries. The epicenter remains Ituri, with unrest and health-system strain complicating response. Government officials say the peak was surpassed in early August, noting 10 of 61 health zones have had no new cases for at least 21 days. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no approved vaccine or treatment exists for this strain, though therapies and vaccines are being trialed. WHO estimates a need for 5,000 more health workers. Infections have been reported in schools ahead of the new school year, raising concerns about transmission and underscoring ongoing funding gaps for isolation and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:コンゴで感染者7,000人超、死者約3,400人に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が拡大し、7,000人超の確定症例と約4,000人の死亡が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 流行はイトゥリ州を中心に第7州（南ウバンギ）へ拡大し、中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国国境付近に接近しているが、両国での症例発生は明記されていないため対象国リストからは除外。WHOは医療従事者5,000人の追加派遣が必要と推計しており、資金不足も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Число заразившихся Эболой в ДР Конго превысило 7 тыс.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has exceeded 7,000.
article.articleSummary: 7,022 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases and 3,398 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 2026-09-13, linked to the mid-May outbreak of the rare Bundibugyo strain. About 837 people are in quarantine or under treatment. This marks the 17th EVD outbreak in the DRC, with the epicenter in Ituri province in the north-eastern region, and the virus has spread to seven provinces. AFP reports rapid spread among students since the new school year, increasing pressure on medical facilities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染者数が7000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%の大規模アウトブレイクで7省に拡大、学校再開に伴う学生間感染も報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 第17次DRCエボラ流行、稀なBundibugyo株による。7省に拡大し837人が隔離・治療中。学校再開に伴う学生間の急速な感染拡大が医療体制への圧迫を増大させている。

article.articleHeadline: رئيس الوزراء الهندي يعلن نظام إنذار مبكر متكامل داخل بريكس لمواجهة الأوبئة والكوارث
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indian Prime Minister announces an integrated early warning system within BRICS to tackle epidemics and disasters
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-13, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced that BRICS members have reached consensus on an integrated early-warning system to prevent and respond to infectious diseases, plus guidelines to embed early-warning data into disaster management. Speaking at BRICS’ 18th summit hosted by India on 12–13 September, Modi noted recurrent crises such as the COVID-19 pandemic, climate-related disasters, and supply-chain disruptions highlighting the need for cross-border resilience. The plan aims to enhance surveillance, timely detection, and rapid response for infectious disease threats, with mechanisms to integrate warning data into disaster-management processes for more effective crisis handling across BRICS nations. The article emphasizes BRICS’ expanding economic influence and the role of startups and innovation in global growth, but provides no country-specific outbreak counts.

triage.headline_ja: インド首相、感染症・災害対応のためBRICS内で統合早期警戒システムを発表
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの発生を報じるものではなく、BRICS首脳会議における政策・制度発表に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の実害情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19を過去の事例として言及するのみで、現在進行中の感染症イベントを報じていない。政策発表のためトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Naik, Kenali Langkah Penanganannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Cases on the Rise: Learn the Steps to Manage Them.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is driving a renewed surge in Indonesia’s respiratory infections, with official Ministry of Health data showing a sharp October 2025 uptick to about 38% of reported cases, and influenza A as the primary trigger behind acute respiratory infections (ISPA). The rise is echoed in social media reports as of September 13, 2026. Early detection and prompt medical care are emphasized, since influenza A can spread from animal hosts and mutates rapidly, transmitting via droplets and contaminated surfaces. Typical symptoms include dry or productive cough, high fever with chills, headaches, muscle pains, and nausea with possible vomiting, with abrupt onset. PCR testing is recommended for precise diagnosis, capable of identifying up to 19 virus variants and four bacteria, guiding antiviral, analgesic, and antipyretic therapy. Mild cases may recover in 5–7 days with rest, calorie- and protein-rich nutrition, and sustained hydration.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型の症例増加、対処方法を知ろう
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの増加を報じる一般的な健康情報記事であり、新規変異株や重症化・国際的拡大の明確な言及はないが、継続的な監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事は一般向け健康情報記事で、季節性インフルエンザAの増加と対処法の啓発が主旨。保健省データによる10月の割合上昇に言及するが、重症度や新規変異株の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, fever cases on the rise in Chennai; Adyar, Anna Nagar, Valasaravakkam turn hotspots
article.articleSummary: Chennai reports rising fever and dengue with Adyar, Anna Nagar and Valasaravakkam turning hotspots. In August, about 4,500 people reported fever symptoms, with 160 diagnosed as dengue. In the last 10 days, over 2,000 fever cases have been recorded city-wide; dengue has been confirmed in 140 of these. Viruses including Influenza A, Rhinovirus and respiratory syncytial virus are circulating in the city. Health officials caution that viral fever can spread within households. People with fever should seek medical advice rather than self-medicating. Preventive measures to curb dengue transmission focus on mosquito control: keep surroundings clean, avoid water stagnation, and regularly clear garbage from homes and nearby areas.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでデング熱・発熱症例が増加、アディヤール、アンナ・ナガル、ヴァラサラヴァッカムがホットスポットに
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱・呼吸器感染症の増加であり、通常の公衆衛生対応範囲内と考えられるが、症例数増加が続いているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱・インフルエンザA・RSV等の複数病原体が同時流行しているが、地域内の季節性感染症として通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と見られる。重症度や死亡者数の情報は記事に含まれず不明。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα: Ξεπέρασαν τα 7.000 τα κρούσματα, σχεδόν 3.400 θάνατοι στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Over 7,000 cases, nearly 3,400 deaths in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, has surpassed 7,000 laboratory-confirmed cases (7,022) and 3,998 deaths, with 1,671 recoveries. The epicenter remains Ituri province in the northeast, but the outbreak has spread to South Ubangi, a seventh province bordering the Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville. Officials say the peak was surpassed in the early third week of August, with 10 of 61 health zones reporting no new cases for at least 21 days. Infections have reached schools ahead of the new term, raising alarm among parents and health workers. Funding shortfalls threaten isolation and surveillance. The World Health Organization says 5,000 more health workers are needed. Trials of therapies and vaccines for Bundibugyo are underway, with no approved product yet. The 2018–2020 outbreak in the DRC was the second-deadliest, with about 2,300 deaths from 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：コンゴで感染者7,000人超、死者約3,400人に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行が7,000人超の確定症例・約4,000人の死者に達し、新たな州（南ウバンギ）へ拡大、学校でも感染が確認されるなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にCentral African RepublicとRepublic of the Congoが含まれるが、これらは南ウバンギ州の国境隣接国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地はDRC国内のため対象国リストに含まれない（両国とも対象国リストにも該当なし）。資金不足・医療従事者不足によりWHOが外部支援の必要性を明言しており、管理可能性の観点からも懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola salgınında vaka sayısı 7 bini aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 7,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 7,000 cases. Official figures from the DRC Ministry of Health indicate 7,022 confirmed infections and 3,398 deaths as of May 15 in the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak. More than 800 patients remain under isolation and treatment. The epicenter is Ituri province, where post-holiday school reopenings have raised concerns about transmission to children. In response, classes are limited to 30 students, with contact tracing and mandatory hygiene measures implemented. Officials cautioned that there is no officially approved vaccine or definitive curative drug available for the Bundibugyo variant currently circulating. The outbreak remains a significant public health emergency with ongoing containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、症例数が7000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（7,000症例超、致死率約48%）であり、ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ学校再開による感染拡大懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%（3,398/7,022）と非常に高い。Bundibugyo変異株には承認ワクチン・治療薬がなく、学校再開による子供への感染拡大リスクが懸念されている。第17次流行として既に大規模化しており、国際的な支援・監視が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le Sud-Ubangi devient la septième province touchée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: South Ubangi becomes the seventh province affected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo expands as Sud-Ubangi becomes the seventh province affected, with a first confirmed case in Gbulu health zone on Sept 10, 2026, confirmed by INRB and resulting in death. Sud-Ubangi sits far from the six earlier-affected provinces (Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, South Kivu, Bas-Uele); Ituri remains the epicenter, comprising about 80.6% of confirmed cases. Public health measures emphasize handwashing and avoidance of gatherings. On Sept 11 authorities reported the outbreak had peaked and was declining, with over 70,000 vaccine doses received. By Sept 13, three additional cases were confirmed at the Savo Plain displacement site in Djugu ( >70,000 residents). National totals through Sept 9: 6,942 confirmed cases and 3,349 deaths (case fatality ~48%). The outbreak is due to the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists; transmission link from Sud-Ubangi to the east has not been disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：南ウバンギ州が7番目の被害州に
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）が7州目に拡大し、全国で6,942例確認・3,349人死亡（致死率約48%）と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、避難民キャンプでの新規感染確認や承認済みワクチン・治療薬の不在など国際的拡大・対応能力面でも懸念が大きい。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しない点、避難民サイト(Savo Plain, 7万人超居住)での新規感染確認は流行拡大リスクを高める要素。南ウバンギ州から東部への感染経路は未解明。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratik Kongo'da ebola salgını kontrolden çıktı! Vaka sayısı patlama yaptı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo got out of control! Case numbers surged.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) has surged to 7,022 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,398 deaths, with over 800 patients in isolation. The outbreak, first detected on 15 May, has been declared for the 17th time. The Ituri epicenter notes increased pediatric transmission after schools reopened, with measures limiting class sizes to 30, banning physical contact, and enforcing hygiene protocols in schools. Authorities warn there is no approved vaccine or definitive treatment for the Bundibugyo variant currently circulating, and the region’s weak health infrastructure has spurred calls for international humanitarian assistance. No details are provided on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に！感染者数が急増
triage.triage_reason: DRC・イトゥリ州で7,022例・3,398死亡に達する大規模流行が継続し、承認ワクチン・治療法もない中で小児感染拡大や国際人道支援要請が生じており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 17回目の流行宣言、Bundibugyo変異株循環、ワクチン未承認、学校再開後の小児感染増加が報告されている。国際的な越境拡大や渡航・貿易制限に関する具体的記述はないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Jelang World Rabies Day, Mirjawal ajak masyarakat kenali rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of World Rabies Day, Mirjawal invites the public to recognize rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Indonesia: Ahead of World Rabies Day on 28 September 2026, Indonesian veterinary leaders urged the public to recognize rabies dangers, monitor sudden behavioral changes in dogs, cats, and other potential hosts, and seek medical care immediately after bites or scratches. Speaking in Yogyakarta during Vetnovex 2026 at UGM's Gelanggang Inovasi dan Kreativitas, Mirjawal, chair of PDHI West Java V and candidate for PB PDHI leadership, highlighted the need for an integrated One Health approach across veterinarians, health workers, authorities, laboratories, academia, and communities. Although rabies can be prevented with vaccination, once clinical signs appear it is almost always fatal. Immediate wound cleansing for at least 15 minutes, antiseptics, and rapid medical evaluation for antirabies vaccination are essential. Suspect animals may show aggression, excessive drooling, trouble swallowing, staggering or paralysis; avoid handling and report to authorities. PDHI will run a free vaccination program for Bekasi in September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 世界狂犬病デーを前に、Mirjawal氏が市民に狂犬病への理解を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は世界狂犬病デーに向けた啓発・予防啓発活動の報道であり、具体的な症例急増やアウトブレイクの報告はないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の予防啓発・ワクチン接種プログラムの案内であり、実際の発生増加や異常事態の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Cara Menangani Gigitan Hewan Diduga Rabies, Penanganan Cepat Dapat Menyelamatkan Nyawa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to handle animal bites suspected of rabies; prompt treatment can save lives.
article.articleSummary: Rabies exposure after bites or scratches from dogs, cats, monkeys, or other suspected animals requires urgent action in Indonesia. Ahead of World Rabies Day (Sept 28), veterinarian Mirjawal urges immediate first aid and medical assessment rather than waiting for symptoms. If bitten, wash the wound with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes, apply antiseptic, then seek care at a primary health facility (puskesmas) or hospital for evaluation. Health workers may provide rabies vaccination and other indicated treatments. Rabies is preventable but nearly always fatal once symptoms appear, making rapid post-exposure management essential. Suspected rabid animals may become aggressive, drool, have trouble swallowing, stumble, or paralyze, though not all infected animals show such behavior. The guidance was shared at Vetnovex 2026, UGM, Yogyakarta, on Sept 12–13.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病疑いの動物咬傷への対処法、迅速な処置が命を救う
triage.triage_reason: 世界狂犬病デーを前にした一般啓発記事であり、具体的な発生・症例急増などのイベント性がないため見送り。
triage.notes: 啓発・予防に関する一般記事であり、具体的な症例数や発生状況の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 3,998 deaths from 7,022 confirmed cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the worst outbreak in the country’s history, with 7,022 laboratory-confirmed cases, 3,998 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries. Declared in mid-May, it is the DRC’s 17th Ebola epidemic. The northeastern Ituri province is the main center, with transmission spreading to the east and north and new cases in South Ubangi near CAR and Congo-Brazzaville. Government spokesman Patrick Muyaya said the peak was passed in the first half of August and indicators show a decline; 10 of 61 health zones have had no new cases for at least 21 days. Cases have appeared in schools ahead of the new academic year, raising concern. Funding is insufficient to isolate/monitor patients; WHO estimates about 5,000 more health workers are needed. Treatments and vaccines are being tested for the Budibugio strain, but no approved therapy exists. In 2018–2020, the outbreak caused ~2,300 deaths from ~3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：確定症例7,022件のうち死者3,998人
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で死者数が多く、周辺国（CAR、コンゴ共和国）への拡大リスクや医療資源不足が指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州が中心）でのエボラ流行を主題としている。中央アフリカ共和国（CAR）への波及に言及があるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。学校での新規症例発生や資金・人員不足の懸念から、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Quarante-deux jours : ce qu'il faudra pour dire que l'épidémie est finie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Forty-two days: what it will take to declare the epidemic over.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists as of 13 September 2026, with 7,022 cases and 3,398 deaths across 62 health zones in seven provinces. On 10 September, South Ubangi province reported its first case in the Bulu health zone; the index case was a 23-year-old man from South Kivu who left July 10. The World Health Organization end criterion requires no confirmed or probable cases for 42 days (twice the 21-day incubation), counted from the last possible transmission. The start of the countdown depends on case outcomes: if the patient survives, it begins the day after the second negative test; if they die in a treatment center, it begins after secure burial; if buried in the community, it begins after burial. Fifteen zones crossed 21 days without a case and then relapsed since July; by 6 September, nine zones exceeded 21 days. The 2018–2020 North Kivu outbreak serves as precedent, but end declarations do not close the dossier due to possible resurgences (Butembo 2021, Beni 2022).

triage.headline_ja: 42日間：流行終息を宣言するために必要なこと
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,022症例・3,398死亡に及ぶ大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が7州62保健区域で継続しており、新たな州（南ウバンギ州）にも拡大が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模流行の継続報告であり、新たな州（南ウバンギ州）への拡大や複数地域での21日基準超過後の再発が確認されている。致死率も約48%と高く、継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: हरियाणा में लम्पी वायरल का प्रकोप, 150 से अधिक गायों की मौत, पशुपालन विभाग पर सवाल - haryana lumpy viral outbreak 150 cows dead dept questioned
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of Lumpy Skin Disease in Haryana; More Than 150 Cows Dead; Questions for the Department of Animal Husbandry
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease outbreak in Haryana, India, has claimed over 150 cows and left 183 animals infected and under treatment, many at an isolation center near Tigauna Mod, Bhivani, with cases from Charkhi Dadri, Jhajjar, Yamunanagar, Sonipat, and Rohtak. In Haryana overall, about 15,000 cows were affected in 2022; 2,937 cattle died then. The current surge involves Bhivani, Jhajjar, Charkhi Dadri, Sonipat, Yamunanagar, and Rohtak. Officials say 1.461 million animals have been vaccinated, but farmers question vaccine effectiveness and coverage. Transmission is via insects (mosquitoes, flies) and direct contact, contaminated feed, or movement of infected cattle, including imports from Rajasthan, with no curbs on movement yet. Preventive measures include farm sanitation, insect control, nets, neem smoke; isolation of ill animals; treatment emphasizes nutrition and boosting immunity with tulsi, black pepper, turmeric, giloy, jaggery decoctions, neem-water baths, and topical coconut oil.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤーナ州でランピースキン病が発生、牛150頭以上が死亡、家畜局に疑問の声
triage.triage_reason: ランピースキン病は牛のみに感染するウイルス性疾患でヒトへの感染性（人獣共通感染症）はなく、公衆衛生上のリスクは認められないため。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病（LSD）は牛に感染するウイルス性疾患で、ヒトへの感染は報告されていない。2022年にも同地域で流行があり、季節的な再発と考えられる。畜産経済への影響はあるが公衆衛生上の脅威ではないため、本SOPの対象外としてDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : quatre mois après, l'épidémie est " sous contrôle " et la courbe épidémique entre dans sa phase descendante, selon le gouvernement
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: four months later, the outbreak is "under control" and the epidemic curve is entering its downward phase, according to the government.
article.articleSummary: Four months after the Ebola outbreak was officially declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the peak has passed and the epidemic curve is in a downward phase; daily new cases and confirmed deaths are falling. Experts say the outbreak is under control, though vigilance must be maintained. A Kinshasa technical review on 10 September 2026, chaired by Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka, examined response measures and new guidance to strengthen the response. Transmission has decreased across several areas, including former hotspots. Health officials, including Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba and laboratory leads Muyembe and Placide Mbala, emphasize sustained surveillance, prevention, and care. Vaccination continues, with over 70,000 doses of Ervebo received; researchers are exploring cross-protection between Zaïre vaccine and Bundibugyo, plus compassionate vaccination. The program is also testing candidate treatment molecules.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：発生から4か月、政府によると『制御下』にあり、流行曲線は下降局面に入った
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な感染症のアウトブレイクであり、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当するため、経過報告であってもフルRRA対象として継続的にモニタリングすべき。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のエボラアウトブレイク（発生から4か月）の経過報告で、政府は流行が制御下にあり下降局面にあると発表。ワクチン接種（Ervebo 7万回分以上）や治療薬候補の試験も継続中。新規発生ではないが、進行中のエボラアウトブレイクとして継続監視が必要。
