article.articleHeadline: Kenali Beda Influenza A dan B pada Anak Serta Gejalanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Know the Difference Between Influenza A and B in Children and Their Symptoms
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, in Indonesia, pediatric influenza cases have risen, spreading rapidly in public spaces and schools. The article distinguishes influenza A and B. Influenza A transmits widely and can involve animals, carrying pandemic potential (historically linked to the 2009 H1N1 outbreak). Influenza B spreads by human-to-human transmission, remains seasonal but can cause severe pneumonia in children and other vulnerable groups; global seasonal deaths are estimated at 290,000–650,000 annually. Flu is not the same as the common cold: influenza A and B cause abrupt onset fever, cough, muscle aches, headaches, fatigue, and sometimes vomiting or diarrhea in children. Laboratory testing is the definitive method to confirm whether a child has influenza A, influenza B, or a cold. Vaccination is recommended to protect children; parents should monitor for sudden, severe symptoms and seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 小児におけるインフルエンザAとBの違い及びその症状について
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な啓発・教育記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は一般的な健康啓発コンテンツであり、具体的な症例数増加や地域特有のアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、疾患自体は対象国（インドネシア）に関連するが、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Συναγερμός για τον Έμπολα - Πάνω από 7.000 κρούσματα και σχεδόν 4.000 νεκροί, ανησυχία και στα σχολεία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Alarm over Ebola - More than 7,000 cases and nearly 4,000 deaths, concern in schools.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains severe. As of mid-May 2026, 7,022 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,998 deaths, with 1,671 recoveries. The epidemic began in Ituri province in the northeast and has spread to Sud-Ubangi near borders with the Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville. Alarm rose as cases appeared in schools with the new academic term underway. In Bunia, parents worry about protective measures as authorities reduce class sizes, promote handwashing, and limit contact. Health resources are strained, with facilities struggling to monitor and isolate cases, especially where armed conflict and access difficulties persist. The government says peak occurred in early August, and 10 of 61 affected health zones have had no new cases for at least 21 days. WHO urgently seeks 5,000 more health workers; Bundibugyo Ebola has no approved vaccine or specific therapy, leaving clinicians to rely on supportive care and experimental approaches.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ警報 - 7,000人以上の症例とほぼ4,000人の死者、学校でも懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(Bundibugyo型)が大規模流行し致死率約57%と極めて高く、国境地域や学校への拡大、武力紛争によるアクセス困難、WHOによる緊急人員要請など複数のIHR・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にCentral African RepublicとRepublic of the Congoが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当せず、また記事の主題は国境付近への拡大懸念のみであるためverified_locationsからは除外。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo種である点も重症度・管理困難性を高める要因。

article.articleHeadline: ডিআর কঙ্গোতে ইবোলায় আক্রান্ত সাত হাজার ছাড়িয়েছে
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over seven thousand people infected with Ebola in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of September 13, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo is grappling with its worst Ebola outbreak to date, with 7,022 infections and 3,398 deaths and 1,671 recoveries. The outbreak began in Ituri province in the northeast and has spread to South Ubangi and near the Central African Republic border. Ituri accounts for the majority of cases. Officials say the outbreak peaked in August, but several indicators are now declining, with 61 health zones affected and 10 reporting no new infections for at least 21 days. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus is involved; there is currently no licensed vaccine or treatment, though some vaccines and therapies remain in experimental trials. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids, causing severe hemorrhagic fever; authorities have implemented measures such as soap handwashing and class sizes capped at 30 as schools reopen.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ感染者7000人超える
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴ史上最悪規模のエボラ流行(7,022感染、3,398死亡)で国際的拡大リスクがあり、致死率も高くIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国国境付近への拡大が報告されているが、CARは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン・治療薬は未承認で実験段階、致死率は約48%と極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies Bisa Fatal, Mirjawal Ingatkan Pentingnya Penanganan Cepat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Can Be Fatal, Mirjawal Warns of the Importance of Prompt Treatment.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a serious, fatal threat in Indonesia, demanding prompt action after any bite or scratch from dogs, cats, monkeys, or other potential carriers. Ahead of World Rabies Day on 28 September, Mirjawal of PDHI West Java V warns that diagnosis and treatment must not be delayed, as symptoms almost always prove fatal. At Vetnovex 2026 in Jogja (Sept 12–13, 2026) at Universitas Gadjah Mada, a free rabies vaccination program for Bekasi residents was announced for September 2026, with details on Instagram @pdhi.jabar5. First aid includes washing wounds with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes, then seeking evaluation at a public health center (puskesmas) or hospital for anti-rabies vaccination or other indicated care. Do not handle suspected animals; isolate children and other animals and report to animal health authorities. The effort emphasizes a One Health approach, linking vaccination, reporting, surveillance, diagnostics, and cross‑sector collaboration to target high‑risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病は致命的になり得る、ミルジャワル氏が迅速な処置の重要性を訴える
triage.triage_reason: 世界狂犬病デーを前にした啓発・予防接種キャンペーンの案内記事であり、具体的な感染急増や異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病に関する予防啓発・ワクチン接種プログラムの案内であり、具体的な症例数や流行の急増に関する報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Нехватка персонала и проблемы с финансированием препятствуют борьбе с Эболой в Демократической Республике Конго -- НИАТ "Ховар"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Staff shortages and funding problems hinder the fight against Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo — NIAT 'Khovar'
article.articleSummary: Six provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are affected by the Ebola outbreak, with more than 6,000 cases and 3,175 deaths reported. WHO notes that 59 treatment centers have created about 1,400 beds; an additional 1,600 beds are needed to reach roughly 3,000. Staffing shortfalls are acute: about 3,000 beds require around 9,000 health workers, implying the need to recruit and train about 5,000 more healthcare workers. Each time a healthcare worker enters a patient room in full PPE costs roughly $25, and hundreds do so daily. Running a 50-bed treatment center costs about $500,000. The response is further constrained by shortages of international organizations and donor funding cuts, prompting a more decentralized strategy with centers built nearer to newly affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ対策、人員不足と資金問題により難航 ― NIAT『ホヴァル』
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で6州にまたがるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（6000例超、死亡3175例）が継続しており、人員・資金不足により対応能力が逼迫している。公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 致死率は約53%と高く、治療センターの病床・人員不足が深刻。国際的な資金援助削減がさらに対応を圧迫しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases cross 7,000 - Malawi24
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak reaches 7,022 confirmed cases with 3,398 deaths; 837 active cases are isolated in Ebola treatment centers. Vaccination campaigns and contact tracing are ongoing, but containment requires more resources to reach hard-to-access communities. Declared mid-May after cases were detected in Ituri province, the outbreak has expanded to seven provinces, with the latest in South-Ubangi in the northwest bordering the Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville. The majority of infections remain in Ituri, and health authorities have recorded cases in schools there after the summer break, raising concerns for transmission. Limited surveillance in remote areas is believed to have allowed the virus to circulate for weeks before detection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ症例数が7,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例7,022人、死亡3,398人と大規模かつ致死率の高いエボラ流行が7州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 南ウバンギ州は中央アフリカ共和国およびコンゴ共和国と国境を接する地域だが、感染拡大自体はDRC国内での話であり、両国での症例確認は記載なし。地域拡大による越境リスクは今後注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πάνω από 7.000 κρούσματα και σχεδόν 4.000 νεκροί στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 7,000 cases and nearly 4,000 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 7,022 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,998 deaths, with 1,671 recoveries, as of 13 September 2026. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the worst ever recorded in the country, centered in Ituri province (northeast) and extending into South Ubangi, with spillover risks to Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville. Authorities say the peak was surpassed in the early third week of August, but transmission persists across 61 health zones, with 10 zones reporting no new cases for at least 21 days. Infections have occurred in schools ahead of the new school year, prompting reinforced hygiene measures. WHO estimates a need for about 5,000 additional health workers. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with no approved treatment or vaccine yet. The 2018–2020 DRC outbreak (≈3,500 cases, ≈2,300 deaths) remains the second deadliest in the country.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国で7,000人以上の症例、約4,000人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行で7,000人超の症例・約4,000人の死亡、CAR・コンゴ共和国への越境拡大リスクがあり、承認されたワクチン・治療法もないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はCAR・コンゴ共和国への波及リスクに言及しているが、実際の感染確認国はDRCのみであり、両国は対象国リストにも含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。バンディブギョ株による第17次流行で、国史上最悪規模。学校での感染発生、WHOは追加で約5,000人の医療従事者が必要と推計。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 4 élèves testés positifs dans des écoles délocalisées à Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 4 students test positive in schools relocated to Bunia.
article.articleSummary: Four students tested positive for Ebola virus disease in Bunia, Ituri province, as schools relocated to the city begin operating in classrooms. Three cases, including one death, were identified at a relocated school in Djugu territory, while the fourth case was detected at a school in Irumu territory. The pupils developed illness signs at school and were taken to screening centers where tests confirmed Ebola infection. Education and health committees held an urgent meeting to implement new measures. Yvon Muke, provincial senior education inspector for Ituri 1, said the situation is under control and urged students, teachers, and parents to strictly observe barrier measures against Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ブニアに移転した学校で生徒4人が陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な疾患であり、学校という集団環境での複数の陽性例（死亡1名含む）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 既知のDRCイトゥリ州エボラ流行の一環と思われる。学校という集団施設での感染拡大は流行しやすさ・重症度の観点で懸念が高い。追加の疫学情報（感染源、接触者追跡状況など）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'daki Ebola Salgını Durdurulamıyor! Uzmanlardan Aşı Ya da Kesin Tedavisi Yok Uyarısı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo cannot be stopped! Experts warn there is no vaccine or definitive treatment.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 7,022 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,398 deaths in its 17th Ebola outbreak, with more than 800 patients still in quarantine. The Ituri Province remains the outbreak’s epicenter. After holidays, reopening of schools has raised fears of child-to-child transmission, prompting classes limited to 30 students and reinforced contact tracing, movement restrictions, and hygiene measures in schools. Officials warn there is no licensed vaccine or proven cure for the current Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant. The outbreak was declared on May 15, and authorities emphasize ongoing transmission with substantial case load and fatalities. The situation requires continued public health interventions and monitoring for imported/exported cases; no effective vaccine or definitive treatment exists for this variant.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が止まらない！専門家はワクチンも確定的な治療法もないと警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラ流行で7,022例・3,398死亡と極めて深刻な被害が継続し、ワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyo型であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%と非常に高く、学校再開に伴う子供間感染拡大の懸念、ワクチン・治療法未確立の変異株であることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Kanpur News: नहीं थम रही बीमारी, पेट दर्द से एक और युवक की गई जान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kanpur News: The illness shows no signs of abating; another young man dies from abdominal pain.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, Kanpur Dehat district, Uttar Pradesh, is grappling with a worsening outbreak of fever accompanied by vomiting and abdominal pain. A recent death raises the toll to eight fatalities in 40 days, including 35-year-old Harioom Tiwari, who collapsed from abdominal pain after visiting his sister in Jignesh Derapur and died at Akbarpur Medical College; postmortem results are pending. Seasonal weather changes are linked to the surge, with daily patient inflows to both government and private hospitals. In addition to the febrile illness, malaria and dengue are rising, with three dengue cases confirmed in investigations. Health authorities face criticism for inadequate services, pushing patients to private clinics and unregistered providers due to overcrowding. Gazner police have conducted preliminary inquiries, with investigations and the latest postmortem pending."

triage.headline_ja: カンプル・ニュース:病気の流行が収まらず、腹痛によりまた一人の若者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州カンプル・デハト郡で40日間に8人が死亡する原因不明の発熱・嘔吐・腹痛の流行があり、デング熱・マラリアも増加しているため、WPRO基準（重症度・曝露継続・流行しやすさ）を複数満たし、地元メディア・行政の関心も高い。
triage.notes: デング熱・マラリアはインドで季節性・地域流行性の疾患であり、直接的な国際拡大リスクは低いが、原因不明の発熱による死亡が続いており、地元医療体制への批判も強いため注視が必要。剖検結果や病原体特定の続報が待たれる。

article.articleHeadline: "Погибнут многие": "живой Нострадамус" сделал шокирующее предсказание на осень 2026 года -- "беда придет с Севера", а мир ждут война и новая пандемия
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Many will die": the "living Nostradamus" made a shocking prediction for autumn 2026 — "trouble will come from the North," and the world awaits war and a new pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian mystic Atos Salome, labeled the 'living Nostradamus,' foresees autumn 2026 focusing on Arctic developments as melting ice unlocks resources and new shipping routes, potentially heightening great-power rivalry. He warns of non-traditional threats, including large-scale cyberattacks on banking and medical infrastructure. Most alarmingly, Salome posits a dangerous infection could originate in Arctic regions, rapidly spreading worldwide and causing many deaths, with a possibility of artificial modification in laboratory conditions. The predictions are presented as personal conjecture with no scientific confirmation. Salome has previously linked forecasts to major events, such as the 2021 death of Queen Elizabeth II and a looming Israel–Iran confrontation. As of 2026-09-13, no verified data support any Arctic conflict or emergence of a novel infectious agent.

triage.headline_ja: 「多くの人が死ぬだろう」：『生きるノストラダムス』が2026年秋に衝撃の予言――『災いは北からやってくる』、世界は戦争と新たなパンデミックに見舞われる
triage.triage_reason: 神秘主義者による科学的根拠のない予言記事であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 実在の感染症事例ではなく、予言・占いに関する記事のため対象国リストに該当する発生国は存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: Albay under state of emergency due to rise in dengue cases
article.articleSummary: Albay province in the Philippines declared a state of emergency over a dengue surge. Public elementary and high schools will suspend classes Monday–Friday next week; private schools will suspend Thursday–Friday. A province-wide 'search and destroy' campaign targets 720 barangays including schools, on Thursday, with one fogging machine provided to each of 15 municipalities. A 'food for work' program supports livelihoods affected. All government hospitals are on red alert for dengue patients. Executive Order No. 51, Series 2026 reactivates ABKD and barangay dengue brigades to mobilize officials, health workers, volunteers, schools, establishments, civil society, and residents. APHO reports 1,457 dengue cases Jan 1–Sep 2 with 11 deaths, up 27.37% from 1,144 cases and 3 deaths in the same period 2025. State of emergency enables use of disaster and health funds for emergency procurement and public health actions.

triage.headline_ja: アルバイ州、デング熱患者増加で非常事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例が前年比27%増加し死亡者も増加、州が非常事態を宣言し学校閉鎖・病院赤色警報など強い対応を取っており、社会的・行政的関心が高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで季節的に流行する疾患だが、今回は前年同期比27%増・死亡者急増（3→11名）を受けて州レベルで非常事態宣言、学校閉鎖、病院赤色警報など強い公衆衛生対応が取られている点が特徴的。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、地域内での感染拡大・医療逼迫の可能性があるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Khi nào trẻ bị cúm A cần đưa đến cơ sở y tế?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When should a child with Influenza A be taken to a healthcare facility?
article.articleSummary: Influenza A in children is often mild but can progress to severe illness—respiratory failure, pneumonia, hypoxia, meningitis, myocarditis, and secondary bacterial infections—potentially life-threatening. Risk is higher in children under 2 and those with chronic heart, lung, or kidney disease, metabolic disorders, anemia, or immunodeficiency. At home, monitor closely and seek care for red flags: fever ≥39°C not easing; fever lasting >3 days or worsening; seizures; lethargy or confusion; poor intake/dehydration; persistent vomiting; severe or worsening cough; cold extremities or rapid breathing with chest retractions or cyanosis. Prevention includes annual vaccination, hand and respiratory hygiene, avoiding touching eyes/nose/mouth, covering coughs, clean environment, and avoiding self-medication with antivirals or antibiotics. In Vietnam, a 4-year-old girl developed seizures and coma two days after fever and upper respiratory symptoms; throat swab was positive for Influenza A and she was diagnosed with Acute Necrotizing Encephalopathy (ANE) related to influenza A after transfer to the National Children's Hospital, receiving intensive treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 子供がA型インフルエンザにかかった場合、いつ医療機関に連れて行くべきか？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な啓発記事であり、単発の重症例（急性壊死性脳症）の報告に留まる。異常な流行や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報もない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA型に関する予防・啓発記事で、1例の重症小児例（急性壊死性脳症）を紹介している。アウトブレイクや異常な流行拡大を示す情報はなく、通常の季節性疾患管理の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola turpina plosīt Kongo DR - miruši jau gandrīz 3400 cilvēku
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to ravage DR Congo — nearly 3,400 people have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues with 7,022 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 3,398 deaths; 1,671 people have recovered. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, which was initially not detected by conventional tests. Infections began in Ituri Province in northeastern DRC and subsequently spread to unrest-wracked northern and eastern regions. This week, cases were confirmed in a seventh province, South Ubangi, bordering the Central African Republic and the Republic of the Congo. The Ebola virus was first identified in 1976, and over the last 50 years has claimed more than 15,000 lives in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で猛威を振るい続ける — 死者数はすでに約3,400人に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続し死者数が増加、新たな州への拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国との国境地域（南ウバンギ州）にも拡大したが、中央アフリカ共和国自体での感染確認は記載されていないため対象国リストには含めない。稀なブンディブギョ株による流行で、通常検査での検出が困難だった点が異常性を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Surveillance Failures Caused Rapid Spread of Ebola in Ituri - Taarifa Rwanda:
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-13, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Ituri as the hardest-hit province, reached more than 6,800 confirmed cases and over 3,300 deaths nationally, and over 5,400 cases in Ituri alone. National Deputy Iracan Gratien de Saint-Nicolas, speaking in Bunia, blamed rapid spread on failures in epidemiological surveillance and weak early detection, criticizing the system's reporting chain from health areas to the ministry. He called for accountability and for lessons to be learned, noting structural weaknesses and the need for permanent isolation facilities in hospitals rather than ad hoc setups during epidemics. He suggested the virus might have circulated before first detection, possibly as early as January or February, though further research is needed to pin down the timeline. Kinshasa government says the Ebola epidemic has been brought under control.

triage.headline_ja: 監視体制の失敗がイトゥリ州でのエボラ急速拡大を招いた - Taarifa Rwanda
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で6,800人以上の確定患者、3,300人以上の死亡者を出す大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、監視体制の失敗による急速な拡大が指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 国会議員が監視体制の不備と早期発見の失敗を批判。キンシャサ政府は流行が制御下にあると発表しているが、感染規模と致死率の高さから継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Retais Ebolas vīruss plosās ar neredzētu spēku: upuru skaits Kongo tuvojas 3400
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rare Ebola virus ravages with unprecedented force: death toll in Congo nears 3,400.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-13, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak with 7,022 confirmed infections and 3,398 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries. The outbreak began in Ituri Province in the northeast and has spread to northern and eastern remote areas. This week, infections were confirmed in a seventh province, South Ubangi, which borders the Central African Republic and the Republic of the Congo. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant is rare and was not initially detected by conventional tests. Ebola was first identified in 1976, and over the past 50 years, Ebola in Africa has claimed more than 15,000 lives.

triage.headline_ja: 稀なエボラウイルスが猛威を振るう:コンゴの死者数が3400人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で希少なブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる大規模流行が発生し、感染者7,022人・死者3,398人に達し、国境地域を含む7州に拡大しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 希少なブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスは従来の検査法で当初検出されなかったため、診断の遅れによる拡大リスクが懸念される。中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国との国境地域（南ウバンギ州）にも拡大しており、越境感染リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: رقم صادم.. إيبولا يتجاوز 7 آلاف إصابة في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A shocking figure: Ebola surpasses 7,000 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has surpassed 7,000 laboratory-confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 7,022 cases and 3,398 deaths reported as of 11 September 2026. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, began in May 2026 and now extends to Sud-Ubangi in the northwest, the seventh province to record infections. Most cases remain in the east, but spread to new areas raises concern about wider transmission amid population displacement and security challenges that hinder surveillance, treatment, and safe burials. Health authorities describe shortages of frontline workers and funding, hampering response expansion. Efforts include expanding treatment centers, frontline vaccination campaigns, and vaccine trials targeting Bundibugyo. This is the worst outbreak in the DRC's history, underscoring the risk of further spread and the need for stronger support to control the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: 衝撃的な数字：エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で7,000人を超える感染者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪のエボラ流行で7,000例超・3,398人死亡、複数州へ拡大し国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生影響があるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模の流行で、致死率も高く（約48%）、治安・避難民問題によりサーベイランスと対応が困難。国際支援の必要性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bengkalis Waspadai Peningkatan Kasus DBD di Bengkalis Saat Kondisi Cuaca Panas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bengkalis Health Office Warns of Rising Dengue Fever Cases in Bengkalis During Hot Weather
article.articleSummary: Heat-driven dengue fever (DBD) surge hits Bengkalis, Riau, Indonesia. As of 13 September 2026, Bengkalis Dinas Kesehatan reports 850 dengue cases from January–August 2026, up from about 628 in the previous year. The health office orders all Puskesmas and hospitals in the regency to heighten vigilance, launch immediate epidemiological investigations on new cases, and apply preventive measures. Actions include larviciding water containers with Abate around reported cases, mandatory insecticide spraying on bedsheets (sprei anti-nyamuk), and focused fogging in affected neighborhoods, along with intensified dengue education. Abate stock is limited; those who can afford may purchase privately. The 2026 outbreak is the highest in five years; June recorded 173, July 165, and August 159 cases. Community measures emphasize eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites by closing water-holding containers, weekly water disposal, and continued cleaning of potential habitats.

triage.headline_ja: ブンカリス保健局、猛暑時のデング熱（DBD）症例増加を警戒
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ブンカリス県での季節性デング熱増加（5年間で最多）だが、地方レベルの対応で管理されており国際的拡大の兆候はない。継続的な動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は死亡数や重症例の詳細を報告しておらず、症例数増加のみに焦点。Abate（幼虫駆除剤）の供給不足に言及があるが、外部支援要請の記載はない。デング熱は同地域の風土病であり、季節性の増加自体は毎年見られる現象。

article.articleHeadline: RDC. Ebola: près de 3.400 décès sur 7.022 cas confirmés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC. Ebola: nearly 3,400 deaths out of 7,022 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 3,398 deaths among 7,022 confirmed cases, with 1,671 recoveries, per authorities. Declared mid-May in Ituri province (northeast DRC), the Bundibugyo virus outbreak has spread to six provinces, notably in the east and north, with insecurity complicating response efforts. This week the outbreak extended to a seventh province, South Ubangi, a border area with the Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville. Reports of Ebola cases have appeared in schools days after the new academic year began, raising concern about transmission in communities and institutions. The update underscores regional spread and ongoing challenges in outbreak control amid insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ、確認症例7,022例中約3,400人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内で7,022例・死者3,398人に達し、7州に拡大、学校での感染例や周辺国との国境地域への拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国およびコンゴ共和国（Congo-Brazzaville）との国境地域への拡大が懸念されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo suma más de 7.000 casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records more than 7,000 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: 7,022 Ebola cases have been registered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), marking the worst outbreak in the country’s history. The outbreak began in mid-May in Ituri province (northeast) and now affects eastern and northern regions, with the epicenter still Ituri. This week it expanded into Ubangi Sur, a seventh province bordering the Central African Republic and the Republic of the Congo. Of the total cases, 3,398 have died and 1,671 recovered since the start. Reports of Ebola in schools in Ituri have raised concerns among parents and officials about transmission. Funding is far short of needs for patient tracing and isolation, according to response organizations. The World Health Organization estimates 5,000 additional health workers are needed. Treatments and vaccines are being tested against Bundibugyo ebolavirus; as of now no approved vaccine or treatment exists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の症例が7,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行が発生し、致死率も高く7州に拡大、国際支援が必要とされているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国は国境を接する地域として言及されているが、症例発生国としては明記されていないためverified_locationsには含めない。承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しない点も懸念材料。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Bhopal Records First Swine Flu Death Of Year; 80-Year-Old Succumbs To H1N1, 45 Cases In 12 Days
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) death in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh: an 80-year-old man, Ram Singh, died of severe respiratory illness complicated by H1N1. As of 13 September 2026, 65 H1N1 cases have been detected in Bhopal, with 45 cases in the past 12 days (~70% of total). A total of 232 patients with severe symptoms have been tested; testing is currently at AIIMS, with routine testing not yet started at Gandhi Medical College. Dr. Lokendra Dave says about 95% of influenza patients recover without hospitalization; elderly individuals and those with heart disease, hypertension and diabetes are at higher risk of complications such as pneumonia. Guidance: isolate, wear masks, rest, fluids; avoid self-medication; antiviral medicines only on medical advice. An influenza vaccine offering 60-70% protection is available; high‑risk individuals may consider vaccination after consulting their doctor.

triage.headline_ja: ボーパールで今年初のスワインフルー死亡例、80歳男性がH1N1で死亡、12日間で45件の感染例
triage.triage_reason: H1N1インフルエンザによる季節性の局地的流行で、重症化・死亡例はあるが国際的拡大や異常性を示す根拠はなく、社会的関心の高まりも不明であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: インド・マディヤ・プラデーシュ州ボーパールにおける季節性H1N1流行の報告。高齢者や基礎疾患保有者の重症化リスクが指摘されているが、地域的発生であり国際的な拡大リスクの記載はない。続報でケース数の増加傾向や公的対応の強化があるか注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: В Демократической Республике Конго от вируса Эбола умерли уже почти 3400 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, almost 3,400 people have already died from the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 7,022 Ebola cases, 3,398 confirmed deaths, and 1,671 recoveries. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, which initially evaded standard diagnostic tests. It began in Ituri province in the northeast and subsequently spread to remote northern and eastern areas affected by armed conflict. This week, cases were confirmed in a seventh province, South Ubangi, which borders the Central African Republic and the Republic of the Congo. Ebola, first identified in 1976, has caused more than 15,000 deaths across Africa over the past five decades. Ongoing surveillance remains essential in managing the outbreak; ongoing monitoring of imported/exported cases and regional spread is critical given cross-border dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスにより約3,400人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者3,398人）で複数州に拡大し国境地域にも波及しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国は国境に近い南ウバンギ州への拡大に関連して言及されているが、感染発生国としては明示されていないため対象国リストにも含まれず除外。武装紛争地域での流行拡大とまれなブンディブギョ株による診断遅延が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: CHDC Congo tuyên bố qua đỉnh dịch song vẫn tiềm ẩn nguy cơ lây lan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: the Democratic Republic of the Congo declares that the outbreak has passed its peak, but remains at risk of transmission.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo peaked in early week 3 of August and remains at risk of transmission, despite government claims it is 'under control.' As of 10 September, 7,022 cases and 3,398 deaths (CFR 48.4%) have been reported across 62 districts in 7 provinces, making it the largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history and the second largest globally after West Africa (2014–2016). Ituri province remains the epicenter, with transmission slowing in some areas but warnings to maintain vigilant contact tracing as new foci emerge and the outbreak spreads to a seventh province (Sud-Ubangi). The first Sud-Ubangi case, a 23-year-old man who died after traveling through multiple provinces including Rwanda and Uganda, underscores cross-border transmission risk. WHO, in a 8 September update, stated the outbreak is not yet under control and shows uneven spread, while officials caution against equating regional declines with national control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：コンゴ民主共和国、流行はピークを過ぎたと宣言も感染拡大のリスクは依然潜在
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行が7州62地区に拡大し、致死率48.4%、国境を越えた伝播（ルワンダ・ウガンダ経由）も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行が主題。ウガンダ・ルワンダは死亡患者の渡航経路として言及されているのみで、両国での発生は確認されていないため対象国リストにはDRCのみを記載（ウガンダ・ルワンダは対象国リスト外）。WHOは9月8日時点で流行は制御下にないと評価。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتجاوز حاجز الـ7 آلاف | أهل مصر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpass 7,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 7,000 cases, with 7,022 infections, 3,398 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries reported as of 2026-09-13. This is the worst outbreak in the country’s history, the seventeenth since the disease first emerged there, which began in mid-May. Originating in Ituri province in the northeast, the outbreak has expanded into eastern and northern regions and recently reached South Ubangi Province, near borders with the Central African Republic and the Republic of Congo. Ongoing transmission is evident, including confirmed cases in schools after the summer break, alarming parents and healthcare workers. The large toll underscores severe health and logistical challenges in containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が7000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪のエボラ出血熱流行が継続しており、感染者7000人超・死者3398人と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、複数州・国境地域への拡大も見られるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国は国境付近として言及されているが、感染確認地域として明示されていないため対象国リストに含めていない（そもそも対象国リスト外）。

article.articleHeadline: Туристов предупредили о новой волне Covid-19 на главном курорте Таиланда
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tourists warned about a new wave of COVID-19 at Thailand's main resort.
article.articleSummary: Phuket, Thailand, is third in national COVID-19 incidence, behind Bangkok and Chonburi province, as of 2026-09-13. Local authorities report a sharp uptick in coronavirus infections, with tens of new cases recorded in a major Phuket clinic over the past week. Many patients are severe, featuring high fever, migraines, and intense muscle pains. Bangkok confirms another epidemiological wave affecting the country. The outbreak is spilling over to travelers, including Russian tourists and remote workers, who report vacations disrupted by nighttime fevers and heavy sweating. Officials urge avoiding large crowds, maintaining mask use in indoor spaces, and close self-monitoring of symptoms. The article does not provide laboratory confirmation figures or detailed transmission sources but emphasizes vigilance amid the renewed wave.

triage.headline_ja: タイの主要リゾート地でCOVID-19新規感染拡大、観光客に警告
triage.triage_reason: プーケットでのCOVID-19感染急増が報告され、行政当局が注意喚起を行っており、地域内で継続的な感染拡大（流行のしやすさ・長期曝露）とメディア・政府の関心の高さがWPRO基準を満たすため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討する。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患で季節的な流行波と考えられるが、重症度や検査確定数など詳細情報が不足しており、続報の確認が必要。プーケット・バンコク・チョンブリでの感染増加が中心的話題であり、ロシア人観光客への影響も言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: 澎湖今年首例登革熱境外移入　赴越南旅遊返國確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Penghu's first imported dengue fever case of the year, diagnosed upon returning from a trip to Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Penghu County Health Bureau reports the year's first imported dengue fever case in Penghu: a woman in her 20s who traveled to Vietnam. She returned on Sept 6 and developed fever the same day. Dengue NS1 rapid test was positive, and dengue was confirmed by PCR on Sept 11. Public health teams traced contacts and, by Sept 12, carried out emergency vector-control measures, including fogging and space fumigation at affected venues to prevent community transmission. Nationally, as of Sept 10, dengue cases included 10 locally acquired and 154 imported, with imports mainly from Vietnam, Indonesia and the Philippines. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. Authorities urge residents to follow the four-pronged approach: search for, drain, clean, and scrub breeding sites; fines for non-compliance range NT$3,000–NT$15,000. Travelers returning from Southeast Asia should seek medical care if fever or other symptoms appear and disclose travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 澎湖県、今年初の輸入デング熱症例　ベトナム旅行から帰国後に確定診断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾澎湖県における通常の輸入デング熱単発症例であり、地方保健当局による媒介蚊対策等の通常対応で完結しているため、フルリスク評価の必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 台湾（澎湖県）自体は評価対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染はベトナム旅行中に生じたと推定されるためVietnamのみ計上。フィリピン・インドネシアは台湾全国統計上の輸入元として言及されているのみで、本症例とは直接関係しないため除外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: 上海多个班级通知全班居家隔离 甲流影响校园生活
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shanghai: Several classes were notified to quarantine the entire class at home; H1N1 influenza affects campus life.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-13, Shanghai families face school quarantines after influenza spread; several classes were shut Sept 11–14, with about half of feverish students diagnosed in Hangzhou's primary grades. Pediatric flu visits have risen in Zhejiang, and flu hospitalizations account for roughly one-third of pediatric flu cases. The circulating strains are A/H3N2, with co-circulating influenza B Victoria lineage, mainly affecting preschoolers and lower-grade elementary students. China CDC's 2026–2027 influenza vaccination guidelines recommend vaccination for all 6 months and older without contraindications, prioritizing healthcare workers, seniors ≥60, people with chronic diseases, residents and staff in elderly facilities, young children and their caregivers, school and childcare populations, and pregnant women. For 6 months–9 years receiving inactivated vaccine for the first time, two doses are needed at least 4 weeks apart; previously vaccinated individuals need one dose. For live attenuated vaccine, one dose suffices; protection typically develops 2–4 weeks after vaccination; best by October, but vaccination can occur anytime during the season.

triage.headline_ja: 上海の複数のクラスで学級閉鎖・自宅隔離を通知、季節性インフルエンザ（甲流）が学校生活に影響
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（A/H3N2、B型ビクトリア系統の共流行）による学校での通常の流行であり、中国国内での季節的なパターンの範囲内で異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行に伴う学級閉鎖であり、毎年見られる典型的な冬季パターン。小児の入院例が一部あるが重篤性の急激な増加は報告されておらず、フルRRAへの移行は不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: পুজোর আগে রাজ্যে থাবা বসাচ্ছে ডেঙ্গু, হটস্পট বেছে বেছে নজরদারি চালাচ্ছে স্বাস্থ্যদপ্তর
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue tightens its grip in the state ahead of Puja, with the health department conducting targeted surveillance at hotspots.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases exceed 5,000 across West Bengal ahead of Puja, prompting intensified surveillance. The health department designates 85 blocks, 278 gram panchayats, and 29 municipalities as hotspots and is conducting targeted testing, including at Puja pandals in coordination with organizers. Prevention efforts focus on eliminating standing water from dry containers, ice-cream cups, tea tumblers, and coconut shells; ensure lids on tanks and buckets or cover with nets; monitor rooftop plant pots, discarded containers, wells, and stagnant water bodies; larvicides to be used per guidelines. Hotspot criteria: villages with more than 5 cases, gram panchayats with more than 10, blocks with more than 30, and urban wards with more than 5. State-wide infections exceed 5,000, led by Murshidabad, with Kolkata second. In Kolkata, Sealdah, Barabazar, Tollygunge, Kasba, Dakuria, Sinthi, and Pikpara are hotspots; Bhanga-1 and Bhanga-2 blocks in South 24 Parganas also see rising cases. Testing is being conducted regularly at primary health centers, medical colleges, and Ayushman Arogya Mandirs.

triage.headline_ja: プジャ前に州内でデング熱が猛威、保健局がホットスポットを選定して監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州で季節性のデング熱症例が5,000例を超え行政が監視を強化しているが、重症度や死亡者数などの詳細が不明であり、例年見られる季節性流行の範囲を超える異常性も確認できないため、続報の注視が妥当。
triage.notes: 西ベンガル州（コルカタ含む）における例年の季節性デング熱流行と考えられ、保健当局による標準的なサーベイランス・防蚊対策の一環。重症度（入院数・死亡数）に関する情報がなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 澎湖今年首例登革熱境外移入 赴越南旅遊返國確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Penghu's first imported dengue fever case this year; diagnosed after returning from a trip to Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Penghu's first imported dengue fever case this year: a woman in her 20s, Taiwanese, returned from Vietnam on Sept 6; fever onset the same day. Dengue NS1 rapid test was positive, with PCR confirmation on Sept 11. Health authorities began contact tracing and undertook emergency vector control, including thermal fogging and space spraying at affected sites by Sept 12 to prevent community transmission. Nationwide dengue figures as of Sept 10 show 10 locally transmitted cases and 154 imported cases, with import sources mainly Vietnam, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus; residents are urged to follow the four 'inspect, drain, clean, scrub' principles to eliminate breeding sources, with penalties of NT$3,000–15,000 for noncompliance. Returnees from Southeast Asia should seek medical care if fever or symptoms and disclose travel history to clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: 澎湖県で今年初の輸入デング熱症例、ベトナム旅行から帰国後に確診
triage.triage_reason: 台湾・澎湖における単発の輸入デング熱症例であり、地域的にコントロールされている通常の公衆衛生対応事案。対象国での新規発生や異常な流行を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（対象国外）における輸入デング熱症例。ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンは感染源国として言及されているのみで、これらの国自体での新規流行や異常事態を報じるものではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。台湾国内では既に媒介蚊対策（燻煙・薬剤散布）が実施済みで、地域拡大のリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: चेन्नई में बुखार और डेंगू के मामलों में तेज बढ़ोतरी, डॉक्टरों ने सावधानी बरतने की दी सलाह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sharp rise in fever and dengue cases in Chennai; doctors have advised caution.
article.articleSummary: Chennai and its suburbs are witnessing a sharp rise in fever cases, with dengue confirmed in 140 of over 2,000 fever patients in the last ten days. August recorded about 4,500 fever cases, including 160 dengue cases, indicating dengue numbers are nearing last month’s total in a short span. Adyar, Anna Nagar, and Valasaravakkam zones are hotspots. Health facilities report fever, body aches, and cough, among other symptoms. Respiratory viruses circulating include Influenza A, rhinovirus, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Authorities urge residents to seek medical advice and undergo tests rather than self-medicating, as delays can worsen dengue. Preventive measures focus on eliminating mosquito breeding sites around homes—pots, tires, containers, and rooftops—covering stored water and cleaning containers. Also recommend nets, repellents, and protective clothing during morning/evening hours. Seek immediate care for persistent fever, vomiting, fatigue, or bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイで発熱・デング熱患者が急増、医師らが注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱及び呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザA、RSV等）の季節的増加が報告されているが、地域的な流行であり国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は見られないため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年季節的に流行する疾患であり、チェンナイ地域における局地的な増加事例。インフルエンザA、RSVも併発しているが重症度や死亡例の記載はなし。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は現時点で低い。

article.articleHeadline: Jumlah Kasus Influenza A dan B Meningkat Drastis, Ini Saran Dokter Spesialis Paru dan Pernapasan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of Influenza A and B Cases Has Increased Dramatically, Here Are the Recommendations from a Pulmonologist and Respiratory Specialist
article.articleSummary: Influenza A and B are affecting patients in Surabaya, Indonesia, with many presenting cough, fever, and severe headache. As of 2026-09-13, over the past week there have been more swab-positive cases for both influenza A and B at RSUP Surabaya; one influenza B case progressed to pneumonia. Pulmonologist dr. Harman Prayitno urged continued mask use in public and avoidance of crowds, plus home rest for the unwell to cut transmission. Differences between influenza A, B, and common cold are explained: A infects humans and animals, mutates easily and can drive pandemics; B transmits mainly person-to-person and remains high risk for young children, the elderly, and immunocompromised; common cold is usually rhinovirus/adenovirus. Pediatrician dr. Mesty Ariotedjo recommends annual vaccination from six months, shown to lower influenza B hospitalization risk; adults around 67% reduction per CDC data. Emphasize vaccination, hand hygiene, cough etiquette, and ventilation.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型・B型の症例数が急増、呼吸器内科専門医からのアドバイス
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・スラバヤで季節性インフルエンザA/B症例が増加しているが、季節的な流行の範囲内とみられ、異常性や国際的拡大の証拠は明確でない。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA/Bの増加を報じる一般的な健康記事で、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す具体的な症例数・死亡数データは記載されていない。医師によるワクチン接種・予防策の啓発が主旨。

article.articleHeadline: चेन्नई में बुखार और डेंगू के मामलों में तेज बढ़ोतरी, डॉक्टरों ने सावधानी बरतने की दी सलाह - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sharp rise in fever and dengue cases in Chennai; doctors advise taking precautions.
article.articleSummary: Chennai and its suburbs are experiencing a sharp rise in fever, with dengue cases increasing. In the last 10 days, more than 2,000 people presented with fever; 140 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases indicate rising vector-borne transmission. In August, about 4,500 fever cases were reported, of which 160 were dengue. Adyar, Anna Nagar, and Velachery zones are among the hardest-hit areas. In addition to dengue, circulating viral infections include Influenza A, rhinovirus, and respiratory syncytial virus, contributing to cough and fever, especially in crowded households. Health authorities advise seeking medical consultation rather than self-medication, as delays can worsen dengue. Preventive measures include eliminating mosquito breeding sites around homes and workplaces: cover stored water, remove standing water from pots, tires, and containers, and keep surroundings clean. Use mosquito nets, repellents, and protective clothing in morning and evening. Seek immediate care for ongoing fever, severe body pain, vomiting, fatigue, or bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイで発熱・デング熱症例が急増、医師が注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性ではあるがチェンナイでの発熱・デング熱症例数が短期間で急増し、複数の呼吸器系ウイルス（インフルエンザA、RSV等）も同時流行しており、住民への継続的曝露・拡大の可能性から公衆衛生当局が注意喚起している。
triage.notes: チェンナイ（タミル・ナードゥ州）における季節性のデング熱・呼吸器感染症の増加。国内当局によるベクター対策・受診勧奨が行われているが、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点で認められない。続報でのケース数推移や重症例の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Houseplants can be dengue breeding grounds if not careful: Doctor explains
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, transmitted by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, has caused a high number of fatalities in India this year, with Kerala particularly affected. The daytime-biting, small black-and-white striped mosquito thrives in water-holding containers around homes. A commonly overlooked source is houseplants; pots with hardened soil can hold standing water that supports mosquito breeding as eggs hatch and larvae develop. To counter this, homeowners are advised to pour out water from flower pots at least once a week, aligning with Kerala's 'Dry Day' concept (often Fridays–Sundays). Standard prevention remains: insect repellents, protective clothing, keeping doors closed, treating water sources, and fogging where appropriate. Weather patterns with alternating rain and sun can fuel breeding, so ensure no stagnant water exists in any home or neighborhood to reduce dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 観葉植物がデング熱の繁殖地になり得る:医師が解説
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケララ州における季節性デング熱の一般的な予防啓発記事であり、異常な増加や新規性、国際的拡大リスクは示されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は毎年発生する季節性デング熱に対する一般的な予防啓発内容であり、具体的な患者数・死亡者数の急増や異常事態を示すデータは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid rise in fever and dengue cases in Chennai; doctors have advised caution.
article.articleSummary: Fever and dengue cases are rising in Chennai and its suburbs. Over the last 10 days, more than 2,000 people reported fever, with 140 dengue confirmations, as the city sees a surge in mosquito-borne infections. In August, about 4,500 fever cases were recorded, including 160 dengue cases. Adyar, Anna Nagar, and Valasaravakkam are among the areas reporting higher numbers. Health authorities warn that respiratory viruses such as influenza A, rhinovirus, and RSV are circulating alongside dengue. Residents are urged to seek medical advice rather than self-medicating, as delays can worsen outcomes. Preventive measures focus on eliminating mosquito breeding sites: remove standing water from pots, tires, containers, roofs, and open spaces; keep stored water covered and containers clean. Use nets, repellents, and protective clothing, especially morning and evening. Anyone with persistent fever, severe body pains, vomiting, fatigue, or bleeding should go to hospital immediately.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイで発熱・デング熱症例が急増、医師らが注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: チェンナイでの季節性デング熱・インフルエンザ様疾患の症例増加であり、例年見られる蚊媒介感染症の流行パターンの範囲内と考えられるが、症例数の急増は続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年季節性に流行しており異常性は低いが、フィーバー症例2000件超・デング確定140件という規模、複数呼吸器ウイルス(インフルエンザA・RSV)の同時流行が報告されている点から経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand Medical Specialist Warn of SFTS Virus Outbreak With 53 Infections and 5 Deaths
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 53 human infections and five deaths from Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS), a tick‑borne illness highlighted by Prof. Yong Poovorawan of Chulalongkorn University. The virus (Phenuiviridae, genus Bandavirus) poses severe risk to elderly and immunocompromised individuals. In Thailand, SFTS is linked to the brown dog tick Rhipicephalus sanguineus; in China, infections have been associated with Haemaphysalis longicornis. SFTS can present with high fever and thrombocytopenia, often with leukopenia, potentially progressing to organ failure and death. Diagnostic challenges arise as SFTS can resemble dengue and other febrile illnesses, with more than 30% of clinically diagnosed cases lacking detectable virus, suggesting other pathogens may cause similar syndromes. China reports an emerging tick‑associated Orthonairovirus; Thailand plans expanded diagnostic testing and retrospective retesting of stored samples. Dog owners should avoid handling ticks with bare hands; continue tick prevention and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: タイの医療専門家、SFTSウイルスの流行を警告 感染53例・死亡5例
triage.triage_reason: タイでSFTSにより5名の死亡を含む53例の感染が報告され、重症化・診断困難という新興感染症的特徴を持つため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は主にタイでのSFTSアウトブレイク（53例・死亡5例）を報告。中国のダニ種や新興オルソナイロウイルスの言及は背景情報であり、具体的な中国国内の症例数・死亡数は示されていないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。診断上デング熱等との鑑別が困難である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola no Congo passa os sete mil casos mas pico terá passado - Renascença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 7,000 cases, but the peak may have passed.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 7,000 cases, with 3,398 deaths and 1,671 recoveries since onset. Declared mid-May, it is the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak, originating in Ituri (northeast) and now affecting eastern and northern regions, including Sud-Ubangi near the Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville. As of Sept 13, 2026, 7,022 cases, 3,398 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries have been recorded, up from 6,843 cases and 3,310 deaths in previous tallies. Officials say the peak occurred in early August, with indicators pointing to a decline; 10 of 61 health zones reported no new cases for at least 21 days. Ebola cases have appeared in schools after classes began, raising concern. The WHO estimates a need for about 5,000 more health workers. Trials are testing treatments and vaccines for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved therapy exists yet.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ、7,000症例を突破もピークは過ぎた可能性
triage.triage_reason: 致死率が高く大規模なエボラアウトブレイク（7,000症例超、死亡3,398人）で、国境を越えた地域への拡大と学校での症例発生が確認されており、国際支援も必要とされている。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国、コンゴ共和国は発生地域として記載されているが、記事内では感染拡大の懸念地域として言及されているのみで、実際の症例発生国として確認できるのはDRCのみ。周辺国への越境リスクは監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: चेन्नई में बुखार और डेंगू के मामलों में तेज बढ़ोतरी, डॉक्टरों ने सावधानी बरतने की दी सलाह | Sharp rise in fever and dengue cases in Chennai; doctors advise caution.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sharp rise in fever and dengue cases in Chennai; doctors advise caution.
article.articleSummary: Chennai and its suburbs report a sharp rise in fever cases, with dengue confirmed in 140 of over 2,000 patients in the past 10 days, signaling increasing dengue transmission. In August, about 4,500 fever cases were recorded, with 160 dengue positives. Areas with rising cases include Adyar, Anna Nagar, and Valasaravakkam zones. Health officials note circulation of multiple respiratory viruses, including Influenza A, rhinovirus, and RSV, alongside viral febrile illnesses. Citizens are urged to seek medical evaluation promptly rather than self-medicating, as delaying treatment can worsen dengue. Preventive measures emphasize mosquito control: eliminate standing water in pots, tires, containers, rooftops, and other areas; cover stored water; clean containers regularly. Maintain surroundings by removing trash from residential complexes, construction sites and nearby areas. Use nets, repellents, and protective clothing in morning and evening. Seek hospital care for persistent fever, severe body pains, vomiting, fatigue, or bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイで発熱とデング熱の症例が急増、医師らが注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱および複数の呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザA、RSV等）の季節的増加が報告されているが、季節性感染症の通常範囲内である可能性が高く、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。継続的な症例数の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: チェンナイ（タミル・ナードゥ州）での季節性デング熱・呼吸器感染症の増加報告。地方レベルの公衆衛生対応で管理可能とみられ、重症度や死亡数についての具体的情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: പനിയും ചുമയും വ്യാപകം; ഈരാറ്റുപേട്ട കുടുംബാരോഗ്യ കേന്ദ്രത്തിൽ കിടത്തി ചികിത്സയില്ല, രോഗികൾ ദുരിതത്തിൽ. കുട്ടികളിൽ രോഗവ്യാപനം രൂക്ഷം; സർക്കാർ ആശുപത്രികളിൽ മാത്രം ദിവസേന 300ലേറെ പേർ ചികിത്സ തേടുന്നു. രാത്രി ഡോക്ടറുടെ സേവനമില്ല; ഗുരുതര രോഗികളെ മറ്റ് ആശുപത്രികളിലേക്ക് മാറ്റേണ്ട സ്ഥിതി. ആർ.എസ്.വി, ഇൻഫ്ലുവൻസ വൈറസുകൾ രോഗത്തിന് കാരണമെന്ന് ഡോക്ടർമാർ; ദിവസങ്ങളോളം നീളുന്ന ചുമയും പനിയും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever and cough widespread; inpatient care not available at Erattupetta Family Health Center, patients in distress. Disease spread among children is severe; more than 300 people seek treatment daily only at government hospitals. There is no doctor on duty at night; serious patients must be moved to other hospitals. Doctors say RSV and influenza viruses are responsible for the illness; cough and fever lasting for days.
article.articleSummary: Fever and cough are widespread in Erattupetta, Kerala, with pediatric cases driving a surge of over 300 children seeking care at government hospitals. Erattupetta Family Health Center lacks inpatient facilities, and there is no doctor on duty at night, forcing serious cases to be referred elsewhere, worsening distress. Doctors attribute the illness to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and influenza A and B circulating among children in the hilly areas around Erattupetta. Symptoms include fever and dry cough lasting days; parents report initial relief with medicines only to have symptoms recur after about a week. Since August, pediatric cases have surged again in the hill regions; attendance at schools and Anganwadis may fuel transmission. The Erattupetta FH has been urged to be upgraded to a taluk hospital by the State Minority Commission and Kerala High Court; UDF and the municipal chairperson submitted a memorandum to Minister K. Muraleedharan two months ago.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱と咳が蔓延；エーラットゥペッタ家族保健センターでは入院治療ができず、患者が困窮。小児の感染拡大が深刻化；政府病院だけで一日300人以上が受診。夜間の医師不在で重症患者は他院へ搬送せざるを得ない状況。医師はRSVとインフルエンザウイルスが原因と指摘；数日続く咳と発熱
triage.triage_reason: 国際的な健康危機基準（IHR）には該当しないが、WPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に複数該当し、地元住民・行政（州少数派委員会・高等裁判所・大臣）の関心も高いため、フルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 季節性のRSV・インフルエンザA/Bによる小児の呼吸器感染症の地域的増加であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念というより、地元医療インフラ（夜間医師不在・入院設備不足）の問題が中心。死亡例の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | أكثر من 7 آلاف إصابة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Akhbarak Net | More than 7,000 Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 7,000 cases, marking the country’s worst outbreak to date. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment, has caused 7,022 infections since the outbreak began, with 3,398 deaths and 1,671 recoveries reported. The outbreak originated in Ituri Province, northeastern DR Congo, and has spread to remote eastern and northern areas amid ongoing conflict and weak health infrastructure. Earlier this week, transmission was confirmed in South Ubangi, a border area near Central African Republic and the Republic of Congo (Congo-Brazzaville). Most cases remain concentrated in Ituri, including infections detected in schools after the summer break, heightening parental and healthcare worker concerns. Transmission occurs via contact with body fluids and can cause severe internal and external bleeding and multi-organ failure. The outbreak’s apparent spread occurred weeks before detection.

triage.headline_ja: アクバラク・ネット | コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染者7000人超
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による過去最悪規模の流行(7022例、死亡3398例)で、国境地域への拡大や致死率の高さからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国は国境地帯として言及されているが、感染発生地は主にDRCのイトゥリ州・南ウバンギ州であり対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。ワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株である点、紛争地域での脆弱な医療体制、学校での感染確認など複数の懸念材料あり。

article.articleHeadline: کانگو میں ایبولا کی خطرناک وبا، کیسز 7 ہزار سے تجاوز اور 3,400 کے قریب اموات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous Ebola outbreak in Congo, cases exceed 7,000 and about 3,400 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo faces the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history, with 7,022 cases, 3,398 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries as of 13 September 2026. The epidemic has spread to seven provinces, led by Ituri where most cases have occurred, and recently reaching South Ubangi, which this week confirmed Ebola presence as the seventh province affected. It originated in May in Ituri and later extended into other war-affected areas. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible; there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids, and severe disease can involve internal and external bleeding and organ failure. Containment efforts are hampered by shortages of trained healthcare workers, aid partners, and funding, but authorities and WHO continue treatment and protective measures in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで危険なエボラ流行、症例数7000人超、死者約3400人に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が7州に拡大し、死者数も多く承認されたワクチン・治療法がないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 紛争影響地域への拡大、医療人材・資金不足による対応の困難さが指摘されており、国際支援の必要性が高い。フルRRAでの詳細評価を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'Ouganda impose une quarantaine de 21 jours aux élèves en
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Uganda imposes a 21-day quarantine on students.
article.articleSummary: Uganda imposes a 21-day supervised quarantine on students arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo before entering or rejoining Ugandan schools. The Ministry of Education directive, cited by Radio Okapi on 12 September 2026, requires identity and health-status verification; entrants must be asymptomatic and have no high-risk exposure. After quarantine, a final medical assessment and written clearance from health authorities are mandatory, and no school can admit a student without this attestation. Daily cross-border students from the DRC are also affected and cannot attend Ugandan schools while Ebola transmission is active, unless authorities decide otherwise. Schools should reserve places for these students, uphold confidentiality and non-discrimination to prevent stigma, enhance in-school health surveillance, and promptly report suspected cases. Non-compliance is a serious public-health violation aimed at preventing Ebola spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダがコンゴ民主共和国からの生徒に21日間の検疫を義務化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ出血熱がウガンダとの国境を越えた学生の移動制限・検疫措置を引き起こしており、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ側の検疫措置を報じているが、感染源であるエボラ出血熱の活動的な伝播はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で発生しているとされる。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Örülhetnek az állattartók: hamarosan itt rettegett kór elleni újabb vakcina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pet owners can rejoice: another vaccine against the dreaded disease will be here soon.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, Pro-Vac ASF, a one-dose, live-attenuated African swine fever vaccine developed by Komipharm (South Korea) based on a U.S.-developed strain, could bolster ASF defenses in Southeast Asia. Following successful field trials, export licensing for the Philippine market is expected this year, with market introduction anticipated in 2027. Trials are also underway in Vietnam, where authorities are approving large-scale tests. At the IPVS Congress in Ho Chi Minh City in June, Philippine farm data showed a significant drop in mortality, with no vaccination fever or adverse effects in growing pigs or pregnant sows. Earlier work reported ASF antibodies in piglets from vaccinated sows’ colostrum. If approved, the Philippines would host its second foreign ASF vaccine after Vietnam-produced AVAC ASF Live gained approval earlier in September; another regional entrant, CAVAC, also secured export clearance this year.

triage.headline_ja: 畜産農家に朗報：恐れられている疾病に対する新たなワクチンがまもなく登場
triage.triage_reason: ASFワクチン開発・承認に関する動物衛生分野の産業ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な流行拡大を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は豚コレラ（ASF）ワクチンの商業開発・承認状況に関する産業ニュースであり、動物疾病であり人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの影響は言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis in the Philippines Snapshots
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases surge across the Philippines in 2026 amid widespread flooding from typhoons and monsoon rains. Bulacan (Jan 1–Sept 5): 394 suspected, 232 in the last two weeks; 4 confirmed deaths; cases exceed alert threshold by >5x. Pampanga’s JBLMGH in San Fernando reports 353 cases with >10 deaths as floods persist; towns heavily affected include Masantol, Macabebe, Santo Tomas, Minalin, Apalit, San Luis, Candaba and San Simon. Cordillera Administrative Region (DOH-CAR): 196 cases Jan–Aug, up 15% from 2025; ages 1–85 (median 29); majority male (153) and 57 farmers. Baguio City: 28 cases Jan 1–Aug 29, up 22% from 2025; four deaths (one laboratory-confirmed; others with clinical symptoms; one also dengue). Iloilo Province: 121 cases, 13 deaths (Jan 4–Sept 5), deaths up 62.5% from last year; fast-lane referrals established in hospitals. Quezon City: 812 cases as of Wednesday, 40% above last year; fatalities 48 vs 97 previously (down overall).

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンにおけるレプトスピラ症の状況スナップショット
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常/予想外」の2基準に該当し、複数州で前年比大幅増・死亡者多数を伴うレプトスピラ症の流行が報告されている。
triage.notes: 台風・モンスーンによる洪水を背景に、ブラカン州、パンパンガ州、コルディリェラ行政区、バギオ市、イロイロ州、ケソン市など複数地域で前年比増加や死亡者数増加が報告されている。人獣共通感染症でヒト-ヒト感染はないため流行しやすさは低いが、環境曝露の継続と重症度の高さからWATCHではなくPICKUPと判断。
