article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu And Dengue Cases | शहरात 590 घरांमध्ये डेंग्यू डासांची उत्पत्ती!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu and Dengue Cases | Dengue Mosquitoes Breeding in 590 Houses in the City!
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-13, Nashik city faces a surge of H1N1 swine flu and dengue ahead of Ganesh festival. In the first 11 days of September, 84 new swine flu cases raised the total to 231, with five deaths (two in the city limits, three in rural areas). Dengue added 30 new cases in the same period, bringing the total to 131; dengue had 56 cases Jan–July and 45 in August, with 30 more in early September. The rainy spell has sustained transmission risk for dengue, malaria, and influenza-like illness. Health teams have screened about 83,000 residents across ~20,000 households; 28,000 water-storage containers were checked, with dengue larval sites found at 590 locations. 83 medical squads detected 156 fever cases; authorities are enforcing penalties for stagnant water sources and boosting door-to-door dengue awareness, fever screening, and vector control to prevent outbreaks during the festival.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフルーとデング熱の症例｜市内590軒でデング蚊の発生確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1スワインフルーとデング熱がインド・ナシックで増加し死者も出ているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、地域の季節性流行としての性質が強い。
triage.notes: ガネーシュ祭前のインド・ナシックにおける季節性のH1N1スワインフルーおよびデング熱の増加。死者5名（スワインフルー）報告あり。地方自治体による水源管理・啓発活動が実施中で、地域内対応が進行中。国際的な懸念には至らないが、症例増加傾向は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: У ДР Конго кількість випадків Еболи перевищила 7 тисяч, померли майже 3,4 тисячі інфікованих
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, the number of Ebola cases has surpassed 7,000, with nearly 3,400 infected people dead.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 7,022 Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases and 3,398 deaths, with 837 people isolated or under treatment. This week, infection was confirmed in the seventh province, South Ubangi, in the northwest, bordering the Central African Republic and the Republic of Congo. The largest number of cases are in Ituri province; after schools reopened, Ebola was detected in schools there, with reinforced sanitation measures and class sizes limited to 30. This is the 17th outbreak in the DRC, which began in Ituri in the northeast and spread to eastern and northern areas where armed groups operate. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no approved vaccines or medicines; candidate treatments are in trials. Transmission is via contact with infected bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数が7,000人を超え、死者はほぼ3,400人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際拡大リスク）に加え、WPRO基準も全項目該当。第7州への拡大、学校での感染確認、承認済みワクチン無しなど重大な懸念事項が複数存在する。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行。イトゥリ州で始まり、武装勢力が活動する東部・北部へ拡大。今週新たに南ウバンギ州（中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国との国境地帯）で感染確認。原因ウイルスはBundibugyo ebolavirusで承認済みワクチン・治療薬なし（治験中）。致死率約48%と非常に高い。中央アフリカ共和国は国境地帯として言及されているが、感染確認の主体ではないため対象国リストから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola infections top 7,000 in Democratic Republic of Congo, government data show
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, Democratic Republic of Congo reports 7,022 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases, per the latest government situation report cited by the public health institute. The outbreak has expanded into a seventh province, South Ubangi, located in the northwest of the country. The report does not provide a death toll. No further details are given on case timelines, transmission chains, or infection sources. The update underscores ongoing transmission and geographic spread of Ebola within the DRC, indicating continued public health concern as authorities monitor the outbreak across multiple provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数が7,000人を超える－政府データ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例が7,000例を超え、第7州へ拡大するなど継続的な人-人感染と地理的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 死亡者数や感染経路の詳細は報告されておらず、続報での確認が必要。第7州（South Ubangi）への拡大は国内での地理的拡大を示す重要な情報。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : le professeur Muyembe appelle à transformer l'expérience en résultats - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Professor Muyembe urges turning experience into results.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, North-East Democratic Republic of the Congo, saw Professor Jean-Jacques Muyembe urge turning the DRC’s Ebola response experience into concrete results. After visiting the Ituri provincial laboratory in Bunia, he noted that the President places trust in the country and the world watches, stressing the need to demonstrate on the ground the Republic’s extensive Ebola expertise. During his mission, Muyembe met the outbreak response coordination, the World Health Organization, care and research teams, and staff of the Ituri Provincial Public Health Laboratory. He said response effectiveness depends on all actors working in a unified direction and fully embracing their responsibilities, transcending institutional lines. The remarks were conveyed through an INRB press release cited by ACP. The call reinforces leveraging coordinated, cross-institutional effort to end the Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: イツリのエボラ出血熱：ムイエンベ教授、経験を成果へ転換するよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する政府・WHO関与の報道であり、重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の観点から高懸念病原体であるため、社会的・政治的関心も高くフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラ出血熱の新規発生報告ではなく、既存のアウトブレイク対応における関係者間の連携強化を呼びかける内容。ただしエボラは高致死率・高リスク病原体であり、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kambala : 63 jours sans cas positif malgré la persistance des alertes - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kambala: 63 days without a positive case despite persistent alerts - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Kambala, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo: The Kambala health zone in Mahagi has recorded no positive Ebola cases for 63 days, while alerts persist. Dr. Guy Ndjango, medical chief of the Kambala health zone, confirmed the last positive case was 63 days ago. This suggests a favorable evolution of the epidemiological situation, but ongoing surveillance is required to quickly identify any suspected case. The health zone continues to manage alerts in collaboration with surveillance and response partners, maintaining capacity for early detection and rapid response to any potential new case. This vigilance helps safeguard residents and informs ongoing regional risk assessments.

triage.headline_ja: カンバラのエボラ出血熱：警報継続も63日間陽性症例なし - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 既知のDRCエボラ流行地域における経過報告であり、63日間新規陽性例なしと改善傾向を示しているが、警報は継続しており引き続き監視が必要。新たな異常事態や国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラ流行地域（イトゥリ州マハギ、カンバラ保健区）における経過観察報告。新規陽性症例は63日間確認されていないが、警報（アラート）は継続中であり、サーベイランス体制の維持が強調されている。新規発生や状況悪化の兆候はないため、フルRRAへの移行は現時点で不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia reports anthrax outbreak, Dozens of animals and people affected
article.articleSummary: Zambia reports suspected anthrax outbreak under investigation in Nabwalya Chiefdom, Mpika District, centered on the Munyamadzi Game Management Area and Munyamadzi River area. Since July 2026, authorities have recorded deaths of 46 hippopotamuses, 5 buffaloes, 1 crocodile and 8 elephants. About a dozen human cases displaying signs consistent with anthrax have been reported in Nabwalya, linked to consumption of meat from animals found dead in the Munyamadzi River area. The outbreak source and full geographic extent are not yet established; comprehensive surveillance and laboratory investigations are ongoing. Reports of illegal mining around Mukungule are being investigated for potential impacts on rivers, water quality, habitat and wildlife; no causal link to the suspected outbreak has been established. Public advised not to touch, transport, sell or consume animals found dead; unexplained animal deaths should be reported to authorities.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビアで炭疽アウトブレイク発生、多数の動物とヒトに影響
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（カバ・バッファロー・ゾウなど）の大量死とヒトへの感染疑い例（約12例）が報告されており、公衆衛生上の懸念と異常な動物大量死という特徴から、WPRO基準複数該当かつ当局の関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 野生動物（カバ、バッファロー、ワニ、ゾウ）の大量死が2026年7月以降続いており、死骸肉の摂取を介したヒトへの感染疑い例が約12件報告されている。人-人感染のリスクは低いが、動物大量死の規模と継続的な曝露リスクから注視が必要。違法採掘との因果関係は未確認。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola case detected in north-western province far from epicentre, official says
article.articleSummary: Ebola case detected in north-western Democratic Republic of Congo’s South Ubangi province, in the town of Gwaka, where a man who died on Tuesday tested positive. The patient had travelled from South Kivu in eastern Congo via Rwanda and Uganda before re-entering Congo and arriving in South Ubangi, which borders the Republic of Congo and the Central African Republic. Jean-Jacques Muyembe confirmed the laboratory-confirmed Ebola case. Authorities fear a large number of contacts due to the patient’s road and river transport, with risk extending to neighboring provinces and countries. The outbreak—the DRC’s 17th—has infected 6,942 people and caused 3,349 deaths, according to latest government data, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. The new case is distant from the current epicentre.

triage.headline_ja: 北西部の州でエボラ感染確認、震源地から遠く離れた地域－当局者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国の大規模エボラ流行（史上2番目の規模、感染6,942人・死亡3,349人）が震源地から遠く離れた新たな州に拡大し、患者が複数国境地帯を移動していたため、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 患者はSouth Kivuからルワンダ・ウガンダ経由でSouth Ubangi州に移動しており、接触者の追跡が困難であることが懸念される。ルワンダ・ウガンダ・中央アフリカ共和国・アンゴラは経路・近隣国として言及されているが、症例発生の確認はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: У ДР Конго кількість випадків Еболи перевищила 7 тисяч померли майже 34 тисячі
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the number of Ebola cases exceeded 7,000; nearly 34,000 have died.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola cases have reached 7,022 with 3,398 deaths; 837 patients are in isolation or treatment as of 2026-09-13. Latest cases were confirmed in South Ubangi Province in the northwest, bordering the Central African Republic and the Republic of Congo. Ituri Province remains the epicenter; after schools reopened, infections appeared in classrooms, with sanitation measures tightened and class sizes limited to 30. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, the largest, beginning mid-May in Ituri and now spreading to eastern and northern districts. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there are no approved vaccines or therapies yet, though clinical trials are underway in Ituri. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. Over 50 years, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 in Africa; the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak alone claimed over 11,325 lives.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴでエボラ感染者数が7000人を超え、死者は約3万4千人に達した
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける過去最大規模のエボラ流行（第17次）で症例7,000人超、死亡多数、地理的拡大とワクチン未承認という状況からIHR基準複数該当し、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国との国境地帯（南ウバンギ州）での症例確認は国際的拡大リスクを示唆するが、同国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。死亡数34,000人という記述は感染者数7,022人と比較して極めて不自然であり、誤記の可能性が高い（累計死者数として過去のアウトブレイクを含む可能性、または本文中の3,398人が正しい値と推測される）。続報での数値確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ابتلای هفت هزار نفر به ابولا در کنگو؛ سرایت به هفتمین استان
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven thousand people infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; spread to the seventh province.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has spread to the seventh province of the Democratic Republic of Congo, with cases now concentrated across a northwestern district. The National Institute of Health in Kinshasa reports more than 7,022 laboratory-confirmed infections since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026. Death toll stands at 3,398, with 837 people in quarantine or under treatment. The outbreak originated in the eastern DRC and has now reached Sud-Ubangi in the northwest, the first reports from that province. Ituri province in the northeast remains a major hotspot, while Africa CDC notes a modest decline in cases at several main foci and a reduction in deaths, possibly due to earlier patient presentation. Ebola symptoms include high fever, diarrhea, and bleeding; transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids. Notably, for Bundibugyo ebolavirus there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment available.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者7千人に、第7州へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,000人超の確定感染、3,398人の死亡という大規模かつ致死率の高いエボラ流行が第7州まで拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirusによる流行で、当該株にはワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないと記載されている点が重大なリスク要因。感染は東部から北西部Sud-Ubangi州へ拡大しており、Ituri州が主要な感染集中地域として継続。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Sirmour: पांवटा साहिब में स्वाइन फ्लू के 3 मामले, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sirmour: 3 swine flu cases in Paonta Sahib, Health Department on alert.
article.articleSummary: Three swine flu cases confirmed in Paonta Sahib and surrounding areas in Sirmaur district, Himachal Pradesh, triggering health department alert. Over the past four days, patients with high fever, cough, and breathing difficulties were tested at Civil Hospital Paonta Sahib; lab reports confirmed infection in all three. One patient is admitted to the hospital's isolation ward, while the other two are stable and under home isolation with treatment. Swine flu is caused by H1N1 influenza A virus and spreads mainly through droplets from coughing or sneezing. Symptoms include high fever, cough, sore throat, breathing trouble, headaches, and body pains. Preventive measures: wear masks in crowded places, wash hands regularly, cover coughs and sneezes, and maintain distance from the unwell. Seek medical evaluation promptly rather than self-medicating.

triage.headline_ja: シルモール:パオンタ・サーヒブでスワインフル3例確認、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の局地的な小規模クラスター(3例)で、重症例は1例のみ。既知の病原体であり公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大の証拠は乏しいが、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H1N1(スワインフル)はインドで季節性に繰り返し発生している既知の疾患。当該地域では保健部局が警戒を発しているが、地域限定の小規模事例であり現時点でフルRRAの必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: AP minister takes action to contain infectious diseases, proposes dry day on Friday
article.articleSummary: AP Minister Satya Kumar Yadav announced intensified measures to contain infectious diseases, warning that rains are likely to raise Dengue and Malaria transmission. In Amaravati, he instructed authorities to monitor areas with rising infections and to take action, including a second round of insecticide spraying in malaria hotspots. Target districts include Alluri, Polavaram, and Vizianagaram, with additional spraying planned in Parvathipuram Manyam and Eluru. Nearly 6 lakh mosquito nets will be distributed to eligible beneficiaries as part of vector-borne disease control. As of end-August, malaria cases total 7,895, a 27.9% increase from last year. A Dry Day program is proposed every Friday for participation by residents, ASHA and health workers, and secretariat staff. Officials were also asked to establish an alert system to trigger on any spike in infections.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラプラデシュ州保健相、感染症対策を強化 金曜日の「ドライデー」導入を提案
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の雨季に伴うデング熱・マラリアの増加に対する州政府の通常の媒介動物対策であり、国際的な異常性や拡大リスクは認められないが、症例数増加（前年比27.9%増）のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱・マラリアは同地域で季節的に発生する風土病であり、州政府が殺虫剤散布・蚊帳配布・アラートシステム構築などの対策を主体的に実施している。国際的な支援の必要性や渡航・貿易制限の兆候は記事中に見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Chennai sees sharp rise in fever, dengue cases; doctors urge caution
article.articleSummary: Chennai and its suburbs report a sharp fever spike with dengue confirmed in 140 of over 2,000 patients in the past ten days. August saw about 4,500 fever cases, including 160 dengue diagnoses, signaling a rising dengue cluster in the city. Infections involve dengue transmission by mosquitoes; circulating respiratory viruses include Influenza A, Rhinovirus, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Areas with higher case counts include Adyar, Anna Nagar, and Valasaravakkam. Common symptoms: fever, body pain, cough; additional warning signs include persistent fever, vomiting, unusual tiredness, or bleeding. Medical professionals urge timely consultation and diagnostic testing instead of self-medication. Preventive measures focus on eliminating mosquito breeding: remove stagnant water from pots, tyres, containers, and outdoor spaces; keep stored water covered; use nets, repellents, and protective clothing, especially dawn and dusk. No imported/exported case details provided.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイで発熱・デング熱症例が急増、医師らが注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: チェンナイでのデング熱・季節性ウイルス（インフルエンザA、RSV）の増加が報告されているが、季節的な流行の範囲内であり、IHR基準の該当は確認できない。地域限定の公衆衛生事象として継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱および季節性呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザA、RSV）の同時流行がチェンナイで報告されているが、毎年見られる季節的パターンの範囲内と考えられ、重症度・死亡例の明記はない。地域内での媒介蚊対策や受診推奨などの一般的な公衆衛生対応にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Chuvas fora de época aumentam risco de dengue e chikungunya, alerta SES-GO - O Maior Portal de Notícias de Notícias de Goiânia - Goiás
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Out-of-season rains increase the risk of dengue and chikungunya, SES-GO warns - The Largest News Portal in Goiânia, Goiás
article.articleSummary: Rains in Goiás, Brazil, combined with high temperatures, are boosting Aedes aegypti breeding and potentially advancing transmission of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. The Goiás State Health Secretariat (SES) warns of rising arboviral activity. In 2026, Goiás has 158,461 dengue notifications and 103,213 confirmed cases, up 16% from the same period in 2025, with 81 deaths confirmed and 31 under investigation. Dengue serotype DEN-3 now accounts for 53.8% of positive samples analyzed in 2026, ahead of DEN-2 at 45.8%, raising concerns that immunity to other serotypes could leave many susceptible to DEN-3 and more severe disease. Chikungunya also rising, with 13,317 notifications and 11,223 confirmed cases in 2026, up 356% year over year and five confirmed deaths. SES urges household vector control: eliminate standing water, cover rainwater containers, and inspect gutters and yards after rain.

triage.headline_ja: 季節外れの雨がデング熱・チクングニア熱のリスクを高める、ゴイアス州保健局が警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ゴイアス州でデング熱死亡81名・確認例10万超、チクングニア熱が前年比356%増と急増しており、優勢血清型のシフト（DEN-3化）による重症化リスクも指摘されているため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 地域は州都保健当局(SES-GO)からの公式警告に基づく記事であり、州内の流行状況が中心。国際的拡大や渡航制限への言及はないが、症例数・死亡数の規模と血清型シフトによる重症化懸念からフルRRAでの評価が妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Új, kullancs által terjesztett vírust találtak: nagy a baj
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New tick-borne virus found: a major problem.
article.articleSummary: Chinese researchers identified a novel nairovirus, ALTNV (Asian longhorned tick nairovirus), in Haemaphysalis longicornis ticks and human cases in China. In a study of over 3,100 patients with fever and thrombocytopenia resembling severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) but negative for the known pathogen, 10.4% showed ALTNV evidence; among SFTS-negative cases, 15.1% were ALTNV-positive. Some ALTNV infections involved thrombocytopenia and liver or tissue injury markers, yet ALTNV-only infections fully recovered. Co-infection with the Dabie bandavirus was associated with more respiratory symptoms and kidney dysfunction. Researchers tested over 47,000 ticks across 15 Chinese provinces and found ALTNV in 1.3% of ticks, especially in Asian longhorned ticks, which laboratory data suggest can transmit the virus. The findings imply overlapping geographic and vector ranges with SFTS and suggest ALTNV should be considered in future diagnoses.

triage.headline_ja: 新種のマダニ媒介ウイルスが発見される：大きな問題
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規のナイロウイルス（ALTNV）がヒト感染例とマダニから発見され、SFTSと類似した症状を呈する患者の一部で確認された。新興病原体としての異常性と流行の可能性があり、社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国の研究者による新規ナイロウイルス（ALTNV）の発見に関する学術研究報告であり、急性のアウトブレイクではないが、SFTSと地理的・媒介動物域が重複し、ヒト感染例も確認されているため今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Инфекционист назвал симптомы двух новых штаммов гриппа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An infectious-disease specialist described the symptoms of two new influenza strains.
article.articleSummary: Modified strains of Hong Kong flu A(H3N2) and swine flu A(H1N1) may emerge in Russia in autumn 2026. Infectious-disease specialist Morad Shakhmardanov of the Pirogov Russian National Medical University notes that these variants are currently spreading in the Southern Hemisphere: A(H3N2) rising in South America, and A(H1N1) with 2009 pandemic potential in the Asian region. Clinically, both strains present with very similar symptoms: high fever, severe headache and muscle pains, weakness, dry cough, and sore throat. Distinguishing the exact strain is important for epidemiological surveillance but is not critical for treatment decisions. The article, published by Parliamentary Gazette, indicates that the full material will be available there later.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症専門医が2つの新型インフルエンザ株の症状について解説

triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ株(A(H3N2)香港型、A(H1N1)豚由来)に関する専門家の一般的な症状解説であり、南半球（南米・アジア）での流行動向に言及しているのみ。ロシア・香港・中国での具体的な発生報告ではなく、Bluedotが付与した発生地域は記事の主題と一致しない。対象国での実際の発生事例は確認できないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ASF puts Isabela hog raisers' livelihoods at risk
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) is spreading in Isabela, Philippines, threatening the livelihoods of hundreds of hog raisers. The outbreak has reached 18 towns and 85 villages, already affecting 120 raisers across Isabela. Provincial authorities have intensified containment with 24/7 quarantine checkpoints at entry and exit points and immediate laboratory examination of suspected cases at the Animal Disease Diagnostics Laboratory. AVAC ASF LIVE vaccines are being administered to eligible fatteners and piglets, while disinfectants are distributed to LGUs, along with flame disinfection and intensified field monitoring and information campaigns. Hog raisers are urged to tighten biosecurity: restrict movement of people, animals, feeds, equipment, and other materials; promptly report sick or unusually dying pigs; and avoid moving, selling, or slaughtering suspected infected animals. Governor Rodolfo T. Albano III appeals for public cooperation to protect Isabela's hog industry and prevent further livelihood losses.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱がイサベラ州の養豚業者の生計を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: 動物（豚）のみに影響するアフリカ豚熱の発生で人への健康影響は報告されていないが、地域内で拡大が継続しており経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ASFは人に感染しない動物疾病であり、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低いが、養豚業への経済的影響と地域拡大が継続しているため、畜産分野のモニタリング対象として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Terburuk dalam Sejarah, Wabah Ebola di Kongo Sudah Renggut 3.400 Nyawa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The worst outbreak in history: the Ebola outbreak in the Congo has claimed 3,400 lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 7,022 confirmed cases and 3,398 deaths as of 10 September 2026, with 1,671 recoveries (case fatality rate 48.4%). Declared in May, this is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history and the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. The outbreak now affects 62 health zones across seven provinces. Sud-Ubangi is the newest province affected after a 23-year-old man with travel history from South Kivu tested positive and died. Sud-Ubangi does not border the six previously affected provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, and Bas-Uele. triage.headline_ja: 史上最悪：コンゴのエボラ流行は3,400人の命を奪った
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大・最悪規模のエボラ流行（7,022例、3,398死亡、CFR48.4%）で、これまで隣接していなかった州にも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Assam: Over 50 fall ill after consuming fruits served as prasad in Kaliabor
article.articleSummary: Over 50 people in Kaliabor, Assam, fell ill after consuming fruits served as prasad during a Shani Puja at Haribhanga, Ambagan. The Saturday night ceremony involved distributing fruit offerings to devotees, after which many developed fever, vomiting and dysentery. By Sunday, more than 50 patients were admitted to the Kaliabor Sub-Divisional Civil Hospital in Jakhalabandha for treatment. The illness source remains undetermined; food poisoning is a possibility, but there is no laboratory confirmation or identified causative agent reported. Health authorities are actively investigating and awaiting additional information. The incident highlights potential foodborne illness linked to ceremonial offerings and may prompt closer monitoring of fruit prasad distributions in the region.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州:カリアボルでプラサドとして提供された果物を食べた後、50人以上が体調不良に
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒の疑いで50人以上が発症し入院しているが、原因物質は未特定であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大の可能性は低い単発的な集団食中毒事例とみられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 原因は食中毒が疑われるが検査結果未確定。地域の集団発生であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは考えにくいが、原因物質判明まで経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Nova Prata do Iguaçu inicia fiscalização contra dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nova Prata do Iguaçu begins dengue surveillance
article.articleSummary: Nova Prata do Iguaçu, Brazil, launched dengue surveillance with the Health Surveillance Service and Municipal Health Secretariat, in partnership with the Secretariat of Industry, Commerce and Tourism. The first inspection at Lago Paineira found Aedes aegypti breeding sites and a broader effort to monitor the Lakes region. The program aims to identify and eliminate conditions that promote mosquito proliferation to prevent dengue transmission, with ongoing checks planned. Officials urged community participation, noting that the situation at Lago Paineira is easily addressed with simple daily prevention measures. Recommendations include eliminating standing water from containers, plant pots, and gutters; keeping water tanks and drums sealed; and covering pools when residences are unoccupied. The integrated interdepartmental approach also considers the movement of residents and visitors in the Lakes region to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ノヴァ・プラタ・ド・イグアス、デング熱対策の監視を開始
triage.triage_reason: 地方自治体による通常の蚊対策・監視活動の報道であり、症例数や重症例、異常な流行状況の記載がなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介対策としての通常の予防的サーベイランス活動を報じるもので、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo.- RDC confirma tres casos de ébola en un campamento de...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo - DRC confirms three Ebola cases in a camp of....
article.articleSummary: Three Ebola cases were confirmed in a displacement camp in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The patients from the Savo camp in Djugu territory were transferred to a hospital where laboratory tests confirmed the diagnosis. The camp shelters about 70,000 people living in dire conditions, prompting an intensified contact-tracing effort to break transmission. Since May, the outbreak has grown to over 7,000 infections and roughly 3,400 deaths. The INSP bulletin lists 7,022 confirmed cases and 3,398 deaths, with 1,671 recovered and 837 hospitalised; the case fatality rate is 48.4% and contact follow-up is 87.6%. Ituri remains the epicenter (78.9% of cases), with cases documented also in North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, and Ubangi Sur. This outbreak is the deadliest in DRC history and could surpass West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic, per WHO. DRC has long Ebola experience, dating to 1976's Yambuku; Kasai outbreak ended December 2025.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ - コンゴ民主共和国、イトゥリ州の避難民キャンプでエボラ出血熱3例を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、避難民キャンプという脆弱な集団での新規感染確認により、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 致死率48.4%、感染者7,022例・死者3,398例と極めて深刻。西アフリカ2014-2016年流行を超える可能性がWHOにより指摘されており、避難民70,000人が集住するキャンプでの発生は感染拡大リスクを増大させる。

article.articleHeadline: पशुपालक हो जाएं सावधान! चुपचाप पशुओं से इंसानों तक पहुंच रही खतरनाक बीमारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Livestock owners, beware! A dangerous disease silently spreading from animals to humans.
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis, a bacterial zoonosis, poses a risk to livestock workers in India, especially those caring for cows, buffaloes, and goats. Infected animals can silently transmit the disease to humans, with abortion-related materials (placenta and discharges) identified as key exposure sources. Humans can contract via contact with contaminated wounds or eyes, and through consuming raw or inadequately heated milk or dairy products. Symptoms include fever, extreme fatigue, headaches, and muscle and joint pains; fever can be prolonged. At Karauli MCH Hospital, General Medicine specialist Dr. Shailendra Gupta confirms Brucellosis is caused by Brucella and primarily affects animals but can spread to people. Senior veterinarian Dr. Brahm Pande notes that post-abortion placenta and discharges are significant infection sources, and exposure via skin lesions or eye contact increases risk. Preventive guidance: boil milk before consumption and avoid touching contaminated material with bare hands; seek veterinary advice if exposure is suspected.

article.articleHeadline: Capaian Vaksinasi Melebihi Target, Namun Kabupaten Badung Bali Catat Ada 33 Kasus Rabies Tahun 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination Coverage Exceeds Target, but Badung Regency, Bali Records 33 Rabies Cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination coverage in Badung Regency, Bali has reached 78.5% of the dog population, above the 70% minimum target, yet the district recorded 33 rabies cases in 2026. The Badung Agriculture and Food Service (Dinas Pertanian dan Pangan Badung) is intensifying mass vaccination of rabies-transmitting animals, primarily dogs, to prevent transmission to humans. A total of 115,000 vaccine doses are allocated—75,000 from the Badung Regency government and 40,000 from the Bali Provincial government—aimed at about 95,000 dogs. Vaccination campaigns run for four months, April–July 2026, with field teams surveying and vaccinating in areas with high dog populations; the program continues through the end of 2026 to address emergencies, including dog bites. Cases are suspected to involve stray dogs.

triage.notes: 地方自治体主導のワクチン接種プログラムが目標を上回って実施されているが、野良犬による狂犬病発生が継続していることが報告されている。人への感染例数や死亡者数の記載はなく、重症度の評価は不明。

article.articleHeadline: उज्जैन में स्वाइन फ्लू से दूसरी मौत, जांच में अब तक 14 पॉजिटिव मिले, सभी स्वस्थ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second swine flu death in Ujjain; 14 have tested positive so far, all healthy.
article.articleSummary: Second swine flu death reported in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh: a 75-year-old woman from Alaknanda Nagar was admitted on September 1 to a private hospital on Indore Road; swine flu was confirmed after testing. The sample was sent to RD Gardi Medical College, which confirmed influenza A (swine flu). She died around 11:45 PM on September 11 in the ICU at Avanti Hospital and was placed in an isolation ward after confirmation. Four family members who visited her at the hospital between September 1–11 were in contact, and four additional household members were exposed at home. Health department teams surveyed 57 people across 14 households; none developed cold, cough, or fever symptoms. So far, 14 people have tested positive for swine flu in Ujjain, all reportedly asymptomatic, with authorities continuing outbreak surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ウッジャインでスワインフルによる2人目の死亡、これまでに14人が陽性、全員回復
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のスワインフル（インフルエンザA/H1N1）による死亡例が確認されているが、インドでは毎年発生する疾患であり、地域的な発生にとどまっているため、経過観察が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: スワインフル（H1N1）はインドで季節性に発生する疾患であり、今回の事例はマディヤ・プラデーシュ州ウッジャイン県における局地的な発生。2人の死亡と14人の陽性者が報告されているが、接触者57人中発症者はなく、感染拡大の兆候は限定的。保健当局によるサーベイランスが継続中で、国際的な懸念や渡航制限の必要性は現時点で確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Gubernur Koster minta PDHI bantu edukasi lebih masif ke masyarakat terkait rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Governor Koster asks PDHI to help educate the public more extensively about rabies.
article.articleSummary: Bali Governor Wayan Koster has asked the Indonesian Veterinary Doctors Association (PDHI) Bali to bolster public education on the dangers of rabies and its control. He says rabies issues require shared responsibility beyond authorities, especially from dog owners, stressing that owners must ensure animal health, vaccination, reproductive control, and safety to prevent environmental risk. Through a meeting with PDHI, Bali Province aims to accelerate rabies control toward Bali becoming rabies-free by 2030. PDHI Bali plans to intensify education, expand vaccination of rabies-transmitting animals (HPR), and humane sterilization of stray animals. Governor supports World Rabies Day (WRD) 2026 on September 27 at Bajra Sandhi Field, Renon, Denpasar, featuring free sterilization and vaccination, pet-friendly activities, and educational programs. Emphasizes responsible pet ownership and prompt medical care for bites, calling for multisectoral collaboration among government, PDHI, veterinarians, animal welfare groups, and the public.

article.articleHeadline: Maceió alerta para baixa adesão à vacina BCG e reforça proteção contra formas graves da tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maceió warns of low uptake of the BCG vaccine and reinforces protection against severe forms of tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Maceió, Brazil, warns of low uptake of the BCG vaccine and reinforces protection against severe tuberculosis forms. The free, safe BCG vaccine is targeted at children living within 1 km of confirmed TB cases as part of a focused immunization effort. Routine BCG is indicated from birth and can be given up to age 5, with a single-dose schedule funded by the Brazilian Unified Health System (SUS). Although BCG does not fully prevent infection by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, it substantially reduces the risk of severe disease such as miliary tuberculosis and tuberculous meningitis in young children. Availability is through public health units; parents are urged to consult the nearest service to verify vaccine access and keep vaccination records updated. The campaign emphasizes vaccination as a key strategy to prevent disease and reduce TB‑related hospitalizations and deaths.

article.articleHeadline: Lembra dessa tragédia? Toxoplasmose matou atriz de Senhora do Destino durante a novela icônica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Remember this tragedy? Toxoplasmosis killed an actress from the telenovela Senhora do Destino during its iconic run.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian actress Miriam Pires died on 7 September 2004 at age 77 from complications of toxoplasmosis that had affected her brain. She had been hospitalized for about two months earlier in July 2004 at Clínica Bambina, in the Botafogo neighborhood of Rio de Janeiro. The clinic noted comorbidities including hypertension, diabetes, and kidney problems at the time of death. Pires had a long career spanning theatre, television, and cinema, including extensive work with Globo telenovelas; her illness influenced the on-screen departure of her Senhora do Destino character, Clementina, as a tribute rather than a tragic on-screen ending. The article provides no details on laboratory confirmation or the infection source, and it does not describe an outbreak or imported/exported cases. Overall, the piece highlights the impact of toxoplasmosis on an elderly patient with multiple chronic conditions in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Cases Top 7000 With Nearly 3400 Deaths
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 7,022 cases and 3,398 deaths, with 837 patients in isolation or treatment. The outbreak's seventh province, South Ubangi in north-west DR Congo, reported confirmed cases this week, while Ituri remains the epicenter with the highest caseload. After schools resumed, transmission was detected in educational settings; sanitary measures were tightened and class sizes limited to 30. This is DR Congo's 17th Ebola epidemic, identified in mid-May and the largest in the country’s history, with experts suggesting undetected spread weeks earlier. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, for which there are no approved vaccines or medicines; clinical trials for vaccines and treatments are underway in Ituri. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. The outbreak differs from most previous ones due to the lack of approved vaccines against this strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ症例数が7000人を超え、死者は約3400人に

triage.notes: 史上最大規模の第17次エボラ流行で、7州に拡大し学校での感染も確認。ブンディブギョ株には承認ワクチンがなく治療選択肢が限られる点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: اكتشاف فيروس يهدد البصر.. ما علاقته بالمأكولات البحرية؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Discovery of a virus that threatens vision... what is its connection to seafood?
article.articleSummary: CMNV, a virus known to infect aquatic animals, is linked to a human emergent anterior ocular disease POH-VAU, causing recurrent inflammation and sustained elevated intraocular pressure that risks optic nerve damage and vision loss if not diagnosed and treated early. A Nature study by collaborators from China, Australia, and Singapore analyzed 70 patients with this eye condition, finding viral infection signatures in ocular tissues and immune indicators consistent with CMNV exposure. Transmission is most often via direct contact with aquatic animals during seafood cleaning/processing or consumption of raw seafood, together accounting for about 71.4% of cases; increased exposure intensity correlates with higher risk. Preventive measures include gloves and protective gear when handling seafood, thorough handwashing, and avoiding undercooked products. Prompt ophthalmology consultation is advised for redness, pain, blurred vision, or recurrent inflammation to mitigate serious complications.

triage.headline_ja: 視力を脅かすウイルスの発見...海産物との関係は？
triage.triage_reason: 新規に報告されたウイルス(CMNV)とヒトの眼疾患(POH-VAU)との関連を示す科学研究の紹介記事であり、現時点でのアウトブレイクや急性公衆衛生事象ではないが、新規病原体・ヒト感染の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は中国・オーストラリア・シンガポールの研究者による共同研究（Nature誌掲載）の紹介であり、患者がどの国で発生したかは明記されていない。中国は研究協力国として言及されているのみで、発生国と断定できないため verified_locations には含めなかった。アウトブレイクではなく新知見の報告のため、続報（患者発生地域・規模の明確化）を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 广东8月新冠、流感、手足口病病例均大幅回落_南方网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In August, Guangdong saw sharp declines in COVID-19, influenza, and hand, foot, and mouth disease cases.
article.articleSummary: Guangdong Province reports declines in COVID-19, influenza, and hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) for August 2026. From August 1–31, 35,782 new COVID-19 infections were reported with no deaths, down 49.9% from July. Influenza reached 233,996 cases with 1 death, down 45.6%; HFMD 19,494 cases, down 64.8%. Overall, 351,809 statutory infectious disease cases were reported in August, with 119 deaths; Class A recorded no cases or deaths. Class B had 75,617 cases and 118 deaths; the top five were COVID-19, hepatitis B, syphilis, tuberculosis, and gonorrhea, accounting for 94.81% of Class B. Class C reported 276,192 cases and 1 death; the top three were influenza, other infectious diarrhoeal diseases, and HFMD, making up 99.72% of Class C. Several diseases such as visceral leishmaniasis, echinococcosis, and filariasis had no reported cases or deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省、8月の新型コロナ・インフルエンザ・手足口病の症例が大幅減少
triage.triage_reason: 定例の月次感染症統計報告であり、いずれの疾患も前月比で大幅減少しており、異常性・重篤性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le Gouvernement renforce le réseau des laboratoires pour accélérer la riposte aux épidémies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Government Strengthens the Network of Laboratories to Accelerate the Response to Epidemics.
article.articleSummary: DRC strengthens public health surveillance by progressively establishing a network of provincial public health laboratories in Kisangani, Kananga, Mbandaka, and Bandundu-Ville, with Bunia’s provincial lab already operational in Ituri. The policy aims to bring diagnostic capabilities closer to communities and shorten confirmation times for suspected diseases during outbreaks by avoiding sending samples hundreds of kilometers to Kinshasa. In Kisangani, the Type 2 provincial laboratory will house clinical biology, hematology, biochemistry, immunoserology, microbiology and molecular biology, reinforcing epidemiological surveillance in Tshopo. In Bandundu-Ville, local analyses will cover poliomyelitis, measles and Mpox, which previously required Kinshasa confirmation. The expansion is part of the Health Emergency Preparedness, Response and Resilience (HEPRR) project, supported by the World Bank. Beyond infrastructure, the program includes training for biologists and technicians to ensure sustainable operations and high-quality diagnostics, enabling earlier threat detection and faster outbreak response.

article.articleHeadline: Língua eletrônica detecta gripe aviária em seis minutos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Electronic tongue detects avian influenza in six minutes.
article.articleSummary: Six-minute detection of antibodies against H5N1 avian influenza achieved by a multichannel electronic tongue developed at the University of São Carlos (USP) Institute of Physics (IFSC). The platform uses renewable-protein coatings—zein from corn, jacalin from jackfruit, and concanavalin A from beans—to modify gold nanoparticles, forming four sensors that generate an electrical fingerprint when antibodies bind to H5N1. Coupled with machine learning, it differentiates H5N1-positive samples from healthy and other avian diseases with 98.6% accuracy. The device targets clinical and veterinary contexts, enabling rapid surveillance to map regions and species exposure and aid early containment of outbreaks. Although promising, calibration sensitivity and sensor wear pose challenges for commercialization. The approach offers a low-cost, rapid alternative for detecting avian influenza antibodies and could be adapted to other viral targets.

article.articleHeadline: Memorial em Porto Alegre resgata a história do primeiro hospital gaúcho contra a tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Memorial in Porto Alegre brings to light the history of the first hospital in Rio Grande do Sul to fight tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul, will inaugurate the Belém Sanatorium Memorial on Sept 17, 2026, at Casa da Memória Unimed Federação/RS, preserving the state’s first hospital devoted to tuberculosis. The Belém Sanatorium began admitting patients on May 15, 1940, with an official opening on Oct 12, 1943, in a ceremony led by Getúlio Vargas. Conceived as one of South America’s most modern TB facilities, it spurred the region’s tisiology network, giving rise to the Sanatório Partenon (1951) and the Pavilhão Pereira Filho (1965). After public-health policy shifts in the 1970s, it became Hospital Parque Belém in 1975, continuing service until operations ceased in May 2017. The memorial assembles images, videos, early 20th‑century theses, medical equipment, and rare books—such as the institution’s Golden Book—curated by José Francisco Alves and Salus Loch, with support from Nilson Luiz May and Luiz Augusto Pereira.

Clustering near Lockgate Road, Karim Box Row and Lala Babu Lane signals possible local mosquito breeding sources. About 20 wards reported no dengue. Dengue virus is transmitted to humans via infected female Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, which become infected from viremic individuals. The response emphasizes source reduction and community participation to curb transmission, with no details on imported/exported cases. article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le pic atteint, l'épidémie "sous contrôle" mais la vigilance s'impose (par Héritier Matenga) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DRC: the peak has been reached, the epidemic "under control" but vigilance is required (by Héritier Matenga) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Four months after the official Ebola virus disease outbreak declaration in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, signals are green: the epidemic curve has turned downward and the outbreak appears under control, though vigilance remains. In Kinshasa, Prime Minister Judith Suminwa chaired a technical review as response teams report declines in daily cases and deaths, including in former hotspots. The outbreak centers on Ituri Province with the Bundibugyo strain declared in May; Kisangani (Tshopo) also shows the peak passed, with authorities urging continued precautions. Vaccination has reached over 70,000 Ervebo doses, though officials are evaluating cross-protection against Bundibugyo since Ervebo targets Zaïre. Leadership emphasizes consolidation, sustained hygiene and safer funeral practices, and completion of clinical trials to declare the end of the outbreak soon. The Ituri outbreak has caused over 6,800 cases and more than 3,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ピークを超え、流行は「制御下」にあるが警戒は継続（エリティエ・マテンガ執筆）- ACP

article.articleHeadline: 广州一女子在绿化带拍到巨型蜗牛，外壳大小已超过成年男性拳头，专家提醒：别摸别吃，其寄生虫可致脑膜炎__新快网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Guangzhou, a woman spotted a giant snail in a green belt; its shell is larger than an adult man's fist; experts warn: do not touch or eat it, as its parasite can cause meningitis.
article.articleSummary: Giant African snail spotted in Guangzhou; shell larger than a fist. Achatina fulica, an invasive species introduced from Africa to China in the 1930s, is a major pest. In Guangdong (Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Jiangmen) infection rates of Angiostrongylus cantonensis (rat lungworm) in these snails range 27%-41%, with each carrying more than 150 parasites. Humans acquire meningitis from the parasite via eating raw or undercooked snail meat, contact with contaminated produce, or exposure to snail slime or feces. The snail also harbors bacteria such as Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Salmonella, E. coli, and Listeria. It reproduces rapidly (30-700 eggs). Guidance: do not touch or eat; wash produce; if contact occurs, wash with soap for 3 minutes and disinfect wounds; seek care if fever, headache, vomiting, or rash within 72 hours. Disposal: wear gloves, move snail with tongs into lime/salt container, seal and discard; keep damp areas dry for 48 hours.

triage.headline_ja: 広州で女性が緑地帯で巨大なカタツムリを発見、殻の大きさは成人男性の拳を超える大きさ、専門家は「触らない・食べない」と注意喚起：寄生虫が髄膜炎を引き起こす可能性

article.articleSummary: Dehradun reports rising swine flu (H1N1) and dengue outbreaks. On Sunday, 83 samples were tested with 31 positives for H1N1—23 in Dehradun and 8 in other districts. Cumulatively, 1,293 samples have been tested, yielding 484 infections; 398 patients have recovered and 84 remain active. Infected individuals include 227 women and 257 men. Across 29,092 tests, 162 dengue positives have been confirmed; 140 recovered, 22 still hospitalized. Vector-control efforts by ASHA workers and volunteers include door-to-door surveys: 946,202 homes surveyed and 5,938,155 containers checked, with larvae found in 22,286 containers.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in fever and dengue cases in Chennai; doctors have advised to exercise caution.
article.articleSummary: In Chennai, India, fever cases and dengue are rising in the city and surrounding areas. Over the last 10 days, more than 2,000 people exhibited fever, with 140 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases, signaling growing mosquito-borne transmission. In August, about 4,500 fever cases were reported, including 160 dengue identifications. Adyar, Anna Nagar, and Valasarakkam zones show comparatively higher incidence. Health officials note circulation of respiratory viruses such as influenza A, rhinovirus, and RSV. They warn that viral fevers spread among households and stress prompt medical consultation rather than self-medication, as delays can worsen outcomes, especially for dengue. Preventive measures emphasize eliminating mosquito breeding sites: avoid standing water in pots, old tires, containers, roofs; cover standing water; regular cleaning; keep surroundings free of trash. Use nets, repellents, protective clothing, especially mornings and evenings. Seek hospital care for persistent fever, severe pain, vomiting, fatigue, or bleeding.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BRICS countries will create a system to respond to infectious disease outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: BRICS nations agreed to create an integrated BRICS system to respond to infectious disease outbreaks and to issue early warnings, announced by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the BRICS+ summit in New Delhi. The plan aims to coordinate rapid response, surveillance, and information sharing across BRICS and BRICS+ partners. The backdrop includes the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which the World Health Organization reported as causing 796 deaths; on May 17, WHO declared the Congo–Uganda Ebola situation an emergency and a threat to other countries. The New Delhi summit coincided with leaders such as Vladimir Putin, Xi Jinping, Cyril Ramaphosa, and Abiy Ahmed, and produced a declaration opposing unilateral sanctions. BRICS accounts for roughly 40% of world GDP and nearly half of the global population.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases cross 5,000 mark in West Bengal
article.articleSummary: Dengue in West Bengal crossed 5,000 cases by Sept 11 this year, with 5,002 positives from data collected since Aug 6. Murshidabad is the worst-affected district with 1,072 cases, followed by Kolkata with more than 500, North 24 Parganas (450), Nadia (more than 400), South 24 Parganas (366), and Malda (around 400). Other districts report: Howrah 325, Hooghly 325, Purba Bardhaman 256, Paschim Bardhaman 154, Purba Medinipur 126, Paschim Medinipur 104, Jhargram 54. A total of 6,826 dengue tests were conducted. The number of cases more than doubled in about a month, rising from 2,410 on Aug 6 to 5,002 by Sept 11, indicating a sharp upswing in this vector-borne disease outbreak across multiple districts of the state.

article.articleSummary: Surabaya's Health Office reports a slight uptick in fever and influenza cases amid recent weather changes, though numbers remain within normal range. Dinkes head Dr. Billy Daniel Messakh says the combination of shifting weather and increased activity may affect health. Rumors that Surabaya hospitals are full due to influenza type A are unfounded; services at hospitals and puskesmas remain normal. Inpatients are those requiring further medical management, such as severe respiratory distress; most fever or influenza cases are treated on an outpatient basis. The office emphasizes hospital preparedness, continuous coordination with hospitals and clinics to monitor bed occupancy and staff, and advises seeking care at the nearest puskesmas for complaints while avoiding unverified information.

article.articleHeadline: The US Is Paying to Keep Ebola Patients Out of America, While Cutting the Programs That Stop Outbreaks at the Source
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in Central Africa expanded in 2026; US strategy prioritized preventing infected or exposed travelers from reaching U.S. shores, including a Kenya-built, 50-bed bio-isolation unit for asymptomatic Americans exposed in Congo or Uganda. By May, Washington imposed travel restrictions and expanded airport screening; CDC reported four U.S. airports conducting screening, over 230 staff engaged, and an emergency fund of $107 million activated on June 18 for domestic and international response. Do-not-board orders required Congo travelers to complete 21 days in a third country before flying home. Reuters noted 14 American citizens were quarantined at a New York military base for four days after Congo return. Public accounting of monitored travelers and activated hospitals remained unclear. CDC asserts stopping Ebola at its source with Congo/Uganda offices. Critics argue USAID cuts and firing thousands of CDC staff reduced preparedness; Washington funds containment abroad while restricting entry domestically.

triage.headline_ja: 米国は自国内へのエボラ患者流入を防ぐために資金を投じる一方、発生源での流行阻止プログラムを削減している
triage.triage_reason: 中央アフリカ（コンゴ/ウガンダ）でのエボラ流行拡大が続き、米国が渡航制限・検疫措置を実施するなど国際的対応が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ（DRC）とウガンダでのエボラ流行に関する米国の対応策を中心に報じている。ウガンダ・ケニア・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの流行状況自体の詳細（症例数・致死率など）は本文に記載がなく不明な点が多い。

article.articleHeadline: 甲流爆發 上海、杭州多校要求全班居家隔離
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 influenza outbreak prompts several schools in Shanghai and Hangzhou to require full-class home quarantine.
article.articleSummary: An H1N1 influenza outbreak in Shanghai and Hangzhou prompted several schools to order full-class home quarantine. As the new term began, clusters of fever led many primary, secondary, and kindergarten classes to suspend in-class activity; some classes reported about half the students absent. In Hangzhou, a class of about 40 students had around 10 with fever, roughly half diagnosed with influenza; quarantine was imposed Sept 11-14, with return Sept 15. Hangzhou Children's Hospital Chaohui Campus reported rising pediatric flu visits; infectious diseases head Qi Zhenghong said flu admissions rose within two to three days of school start, now about one third of beds occupied by flu patients, with around 10 flu inpatients daily. The current season centers on influenza A H3N2, with influenza B Victoria lineage also circulating; younger students are most affected. Shanghai parents posted about swift class quarantines on social media, reflecting widespread concern.

triage.headline_ja: 甲型インフルエンザ流行、上海・杭州の複数校で全クラス自宅隔離を要請
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H3N2/H1N1/B)による学校クラスターで、学級閉鎖・入院増加が見られるが、通常の季節性流行の範囲内であり国際的な異常性は確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H3N2主体、B型Victoria系統も混在）による学校でのクラスター発生。小児科病床占有率上昇や学級閉鎖が報告されているが、例年の流行シーズンの範囲内とみられ、続報で重症度や拡大状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 甲流爆发 上海、杭州多校要求全班居家隔离
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 influenza outbreak: Several schools in Shanghai and Hangzhou require the entire class to quarantine at home.
article.articleSummary: H1N1 influenza outbreak in Shanghai and Hangzhou, Zhejiang, prompting multiple primary, secondary schools and kindergartens to implement full-class home quarantine as fever cases rise. In Hangzhou, one class of over 40 students has about 10 absent due to fever, with roughly half diagnosed with influenza, leading to 9/11–9/14 class suspensions and a return on 9/15. At Hangzhou Women’s and Children’s Medical Group Chaohui Campus (Hangzhou Children’s Hospital), pediatric influenza visits have surged; flu admissions now occupy about one third of pediatric beds, with around 10 flu inpatients daily. The current wave is dominated by influenza A(H3N2), with influenza B Victoria lineage infections also detected; kindergarten and primary-school children are the main affected group. No infection source, laboratory confirmation details, or imported/exported case information is provided. Published 2026-09-13.

triage.headline_ja: 甲型インフルエンザ流行拡大：上海・杭州の複数校で学級閉鎖・自宅隔離要請
triage.triage_reason: 上海・杭州で季節性インフルエンザ(H3N2主体、B型Victoria系統も検出)による学級閉鎖・入院増加が報告されているが、既知の季節性株であり異常性は低く、感染源や重症度の詳細情報も不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H3N2主体)の学校クラスターであり、既知病原体・国内事象にとどまる。重症度・感染源・検査確定情報が記載されておらず、続報の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola epidemic passes 7,000 cases
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola epidemic surpasses 7,000 cases: 7,022 cases, 3,398 deaths, 1,671 recoveries since the outbreak began in mid-May in Ituri province, with spread to eastern and northern regions amid conflict and weak health infrastructure. The outbreak's latest confirmation occurred in South-Ubangi, bordering the Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville, earlier this week. Authorities say the epidemic has likely peaked, with the peak reached in early week 3 of August and 10 of 61 health zones reporting no new cases for at least 21 days. Most cases remain in Ituri, including school clusters after the post-summer holiday return. Ebola is transmitted through contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment; several therapies and vaccines are under evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、7,000症例を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が7,000症例・3,398死亡と大規模化し、周辺国（中央アフリカ共和国、コンゴ共和国）との国境地域にも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国は対象国リストに含まれないため、国境付近での症例確認は言及するがverified_locationsには含めない。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株による流行であり、致死率が高く懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Govt. intensifies efforts to fight rising vector, food-borne diseases
article.articleSummary: Rising vector- and food-borne diseases in Andhra Pradesh are being tackled with intensified surveillance and preventive measures. As of August 30, malaria reached 7,895 cases (up 27.9% from 6,172 last year); dengue stood at 1,475 (up from 1,410); scrub typhus reported 941 cases. Food- and water-borne illnesses in Srikakulam surged to 408 this year from 34. Malaria increases are reported in Alluri Sitarama Raju, Polavaram and Vizianagaram districts, while scrub typhus is rising in Alluri Sitarama Raju and Parvathipuram Manyam. Health Minister Satya Kumar Yadav directed intensified indoor residual spraying, distribution of mosquito nets, removal of breeding sites, and identification of waterlogged areas to bolster vector control. A Dry Day every Friday will be observed to eliminate stagnant water, with ASHA workers, health staff, local government personnel and residents participating. Measures aim to curb ongoing outbreaks across the state.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、増加するベクター媒介・食品媒介疾患対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: アンドラプラデシュ州でマラリア・デング・つつが虫病等の季節性ベクター媒介疾患が増加しているが、既存の対策で管理されており国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 州政府が自主的に対策を強化している国内の季節性感染症の増加であり、地方自治体レベルで対応可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Number of dengue affected in West Bengal this year crosses 5,000
article.articleSummary: West Bengal reported 5,002 dengue cases in the current calendar year as of September 11, surpassing August’s total of under 2,500 and marking a surge of over 2,500 new infections in a month. District-wise, Murshidabad leads with 1,072 cases, followed by Kolkata (500) and North 24 Parganas (450). In response, the Health Department issued a Standard Operating Procedure on Sept 2 emphasizing door-to-door monitoring and immediate blood testing for dengue-symptomatic individuals; officials credit the rise to diligent adherence to these guidelines and note no underreporting of dengue as an unknown disease this year. Authorities have ordered a district-wide campaign through Oct 15 to test people with dengue symptoms, with daily reporting on fever cases and testing. The focus remains on enhanced surveillance and prevention in West Bengal.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州、今年のデング熱感染者数が5,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州でデング熱症例が月間2,500件超増加し5,000件を超えており、政府が特別対応（SOP発令、戸別調査）を実施するなど社会的・行政的関心が高いため、スクリーニング基準とともにPICKUPと判定した。
triage.notes: デング熱は西ベンガル州で季節性・地域流行性の疾患であるが、今年は症例数が急増（月間2,500件超増加）しており、保健当局が戸別調査・即時血液検査等のSOPを発令するなど積極的な対応を行っている。死亡例や重症例の詳細は記事に記載なし。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点で認められない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : de Bunia à Bandundu, les laboratoires provinciaux au cœur de la riposte aux épidémies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: From Bunia to Bandundu, the provincial laboratories at the heart of the response to epidemics.
article.articleSummary: DRC is expanding its provincial health laboratories to shorten the time from alert to diagnosis to outbreak response. The Ituri provincial laboratory in Bunia already reduces Ebola detection and confirmation delays, with over 3,000 samples analyzed across Bunia, Mongwalu, and Aru. Plans are to equip finalization in Kisangani, Kananga, Mbandaka, and Bandundu-Ville, enabling local analyses of epidemic-potential diseases—polio, measles, and mpox—without routing specimens to Kinshasa. The HEPRR project supports equipment, staff training, and durable lab capacity across the provinces. The strategy aims to build a nationwide diagnostic network that supports epidemiological surveillance and rapid response to emerging threats, ensuring earlier detection, faster confirmation, and swifter outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:ブニアからバンドゥンドゥまで、流行対応の中核を担う州立検査機関
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はDRCにおける検査体制強化・インフラ整備に関する報道であり、新規の感染症発生や異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はHEPRRプロジェクトによる州立検査機関の拡充・能力構築を報じたものであり、エボラ・麻疹・ポリオ・サル痘等の既存疾患監視体制の強化に関する内容。新規アウトブレイクの発生や異常な公衆衛生事象の報告ではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis cases rise in Bulacan
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases rise in Bulacan, Philippines, driven by widespread flooding from typhoons and the southwest monsoon. From Jan 1 to Sept 5, 2026, 394 suspected leptospirosis cases were recorded, more than double the 158 cases in the same period last year. Twenty leptospirosis-related deaths have been reported, all adult males from Hagonoy, Malolos, Bocaue, and Malolos City. Gov. Daniel Fernando ordered strict preventive measures to curb further increases. The Provincial Health Office is vigilantly monitoring flood-affected areas and evacuation centers, coordinating with municipal disease surveillance units to conduct active case finding and ensure prompt treatment in public hospitals. Additional supplies, including doxycycline and athlete’s-foot ointments, have been distributed to city/municipal health offices, government hospitals, and institutions. Approximately 70 barangays in Malolos, Calumpit, Hagonoy and Paombong remained flooded as of Sept 12, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ブラカン州でレプトスピラ症の症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: 洪水を背景にレプトスピラ症の症例・死亡者数が例年比で倍増し、州政府が対策を発令するなど行政の関心も高いため、WPRO基準（重症度・曝露継続）とローカルな社会的関心の両面から該当。
triage.notes: 洪水後の季節性レプトスピラ症増加であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大の懸念はない。州レベルで抗生物質配布等の対応が行われており、外部（国レベル・国際）支援の必要性は現時点で示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: How Bhutan eliminated dog-transmitted human rabies -- and what India can learn
article.articleSummary: Bhutan has eliminated dog-transmitted human rabies as a public-health problem, becoming the first country in WHO's South-East Asia Region to achieve this milestone. WHO validated the achievement on September 4, 2026, after confirming no human deaths from dog-mediated rabies since June 2023. The elimination was driven by sustained vaccination, dog sterilisation, surveillance, and free treatment for bite victims. India has the same tools and a 2030 deadline, but rising dog bites, unreliable data, and uneven local implementation have hindered progress toward the milestone. This Bhutan achievement underscores the impact of coordinated vaccination, sterilisation, surveillance, and accessible treatment in interrupting dog-mediated rabies transmission at the national level.

triage.headline_ja: ブータンはいかにして犬媒介の狂犬病を排除したか -- インドが学べること
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブータンが狂犬病の排除に成功したという達成報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブータンの狂犬病排除成功の報告であり、対象国リストに含まれるインドについては課題を指摘する文脈で言及されているが、インド国内で新たな発生や流行が報告されているわけではない。ブータンは対象国リストに含まれないため、いずれも該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية: 3398 وفاة جراء فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: 3,398 deaths due to Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, centered in Ituri Province in the northeast and now reaching South Ubangi Province along the border with Central African Republic and Republic of Congo. Since mid-May, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, with 7,022 cases and 3,398 deaths and 1,671 recoveries reported to date. Authorities warn transmission may have occurred weeks before detection. The current strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccine or approved therapy exists. In Ituri, school-based detections have raised concern after summer holidays, prompting measures such as mandatory handwashing and efforts to keep classrooms around 30 students. Ongoing public health efforts aim to contain spread across eastern and northern regions; investigations continue into the outbreak’s origins and transmission dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラウイルスによる死者3,398人
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（7,022症例、死者3,398人）であり、新たな州への拡大や学校での検知など公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国との国境地域への拡大が懸念されているが、記事時点で両国での症例発生は明記されていないため対象外とした。承認されたワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による流行であり、検出前数週間の伝播が疑われるなど、感染制御上の重大なリスクが継続している。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 7 آلاف حالة - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpass 7,000 cases - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding, with official authorities reporting 7,022 confirmed cases and 3,398 deaths, along with 1,671 recoveries, since the outbreak began. As of 13 September 2026, seven provinces are affected, with a recent spread into Sud-Ubangi in the western part of the country, signaling a widening outbreak. The development makes this the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history, surpassing the impact of the 2018–2020 epidemic previously the worst. The report relies on Congolese government data; no further details on laboratory confirmation, transmission sources, or clinical symptoms are provided in the article. The figures highlight ongoing transmission and a severe toll, underscoring the need for intensified public health response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が7,000人を超える - Urdu Point
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC史上最悪の規模に拡大し、致死率が高く、7州へ拡大するなど国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%と非常に高く、7州に拡大しSud-Ubangiへも波及。DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行とされ、国際的な支援強化が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يسجل أسوأ تفشٍّ في تاريخ الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola records the worst outbreak in the history of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the worst in the country's history, with 7,022 infections and 3,398 deaths reported, and 1,671 recoveries as of 2026-09-13. Official data show a rapidly expanding outbreak surpassing the 2018–2020 surge. Seven provinces are affected, with the western Sud-Ubangi region newly impacted, signaling potential regional spread. The figures reflect ongoing transmission since the outbreak’s start, but the report does not specify clinical symptoms or laboratory confirmation details in the summary. No infection source, import/export cases, or travel-linked cases are noted in the provided data. The situation underscores the need for intensified surveillance, case management, and public health interventions to curb transmission across affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ」、コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪の流行を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC史上最悪の流行となり、7000人超の感染・3000人超の死亡、7州に拡大しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 新たにSud-Ubangi州へ拡大していることが報告されており、史上最悪規模の流行として国際的な支援・監視強化が必要と考えられる。臨床症状や検査確定情報は記事中に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu Claims First Victim In Bhopal, 65 Tested Positive In City So Far
article.articleSummary: An 80-year-old man died of H1N1 swine flu in Bhopal, marking the first fatal swine flu case in the city this year. The death follows a surge in H1N1 positives over the past 12 days. In September, 43 confirmed H1N1 cases were reported in Bhopal, with 12 cases in the last week of August. Since January, 232 H1N1 tests have been conducted in Bhopal, 65 testing positive. Cases are also reported in other Madhya Pradesh cities such as Ujjain and Katni, indicating wider spread in the state. AIIMS Bhopal is conducting H1N1 testing as other facilities lack kits. Officials say the situation is being closely monitored and there is no need to panic. H1N1 presents with fever, cough, sore throat, and body aches.

triage.headline_ja: ボーパルでインフルエンザ（豚インフルエンザ）による最初の死亡例、市内で65人が陽性
triage.triage_reason: H1N1感染者数がここ12日間で急増し、複数都市に拡大、初の死亡例も出ているため、地域内での感染拡大リスクと重症度の観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体だが、ボーパル及びマディヤ・プラデーシュ州内の他都市（ウッジャイン、カトニ等）で症例増加が報告されており、州内での拡大状況を注視する必要がある。死亡例は80歳の高齢者であり、基礎疾患の有無など重症度の詳細情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uele : interdiction de la vente d'aliments dans une école à Isiro - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: ban on the sale of food in a school in Isiro - ACP
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak persists in Haut-Uele, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompting a ban on selling food to pupils at Kinkole Primary School in Isiro. On 13 September 2026, school authorities, after awareness sessions led by the Ebola response teams before the new school year, prohibited mothers from selling meals to students during recess to reduce contacts and exchanges of objects that could spread infection. Students are urged to observe hygiene measures; teachers stressed keeping pupils in class from day one, with parents urged to send children to school as attendance is essential. The 2026-2027 academic year is described as timid in several schools due to the ongoing Ebola threat in Haut-Uele. No case counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：イジロの学校における食品販売の禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRC・オー・ウエレ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関連し、学校での感染防止措置が取られている。重症度が高く人-人感染のリスクがある疾患であり、既存の公衆衛生上の懸念事案として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は継続中のDRCエボラアウトブレイクに関する続報で、新規発生ではなく学校での予防措置についての報道。具体的な症例数の言及なし。既存のアウトブレイクとして既にRRA対象になっている可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Già hóa dân số kéo theo bài toán bảo vệ người cao tuổi trước bệnh truyền nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Population aging poses the challenge of protecting the elderly against infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam’s aging population, combined with immune senescence and chronic diseases, increases vulnerability to infections among older adults. RSV is highlighted as a key threat: a five-year model projects 4.6 million RSV-related acute respiratory infections among people aged 60 and older, with 200,000 hospitalizations and 18,000 deaths from RSV-related lower respiratory infections. The risk is higher for those with COPD, cardiovascular disease, or other chronic illnesses. Data presented at an RSV in elderly conference organized by the Vietnamese Gerontology Association in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City underscores the burden. International guidelines from GOLD and the US CDC stress vaccination to protect high-risk elderly. In practice at Bach Mai Hospital and the Institute of Tropical Medicine, vaccination counseling is integrated into routine care, with clinicians reviewing history and tailoring vaccines (influenza annually, pneumococcus, herpes zoster, RSV) by age. Influenza and shingles add to the burden, reinforcing immunization to prevent severe outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 高齢化が進むベトナムで、感染症から高齢者を守る課題が浮上
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、高齢化と慢性疾患によるRSV等の脆弱性やワクチン接種の重要性を説く一般的な啓発・予測モデル記事であり、緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は疫学的アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、高齢者向けワクチン接種推進のための啓発記事および将来予測モデルの紹介。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : décès communautaire d'un élève enregistré dans une école à Bunia - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: community death of a student enrolled in a school in Bunia - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, Ebola Virus Disease activity has been reported in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, following the community death of a six-year-old first-grade pupil at Saint-Luc Primary School, located on the Kigonze displaced persons site in Bunia. A total of ten contacts have been pre-listed and await laboratory results. This is the first case recorded at Saint-Luc since the 2026-2027 school year began. Health teams continue to follow up the identified contacts and strengthen surveillance as part of the response. Authorities are enhancing risk communication and preventive measures in Bunia’s schools amid heightened vigilance for Ebola. No laboratory confirmation details are provided beyond pending results, but the incident underscores the need for rapid investigation, isolation, and ongoing school-based prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: イツリでのエボラ:ブニアの学校で児童が地域内死亡 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR常時通報対象疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で学校児童の地域内死亡例が報告されヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクがあるため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox vs Covid: Why Clade Ib is different and how concerned should India be?
article.articleSummary: Mpox Clade Ib spreads mainly through direct physical contact and contaminated materials; not airborne as COVID-19, so the general population risk remains low despite wider geographic spread. Clade Ib, a subclade of Clade I first identified in the Democratic Republic of Congo in 2023, has drawn attention for community transmission beyond established areas. Mpox transmission occurs via close contact, including sexual contact and exposure to body fluids; rare aerosol transmission is possible during prolonged talking but not considered airborne in everyday settings. Incubation is typically 1–21 days; symptoms resemble smallpox with fever, headache, fatigue, muscle pain, sore throat, swollen lymph nodes, followed by a deep, painful rash with central depressions that crust. Vulnerable groups include those with severely suppressed immunity, pregnant women, and children; healthcare workers and household contacts are at higher infection risk. India should not panic, as WHO deems the risk low, though surveillance and vaccination discussions continue.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox対COVID：Clade Ibはなぜ異なるのか、インドはどれほど懸念すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はMpox Clade IbとCOVID-19の違いを解説する啓発記事であり、新規の症例発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。WHOはリスクを低いと評価している。
triage.notes: 記事はMpox Clade Ibに関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、DRCでの2023年の初確認は背景情報として言及されているのみ。インドでの新規症例発生は報告されておらず、WHOによるリスク評価（低リスク）が明記されている。実際の発生イベントの報告ではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: India Faces Rising Dengue Threat as El Niño Shifts Weather
article.articleSummary: India may face higher dengue and malaria risk as El Niño shifts weather across South Asia, with WHO warning that altered rainfall, higher temperatures and dry spells could boost mosquito-borne diseases. As of 13 September 2026, Delhi saw dengue rise in August, with malaria up in the same period. El Niño is a climate-related risk factor, not a direct cause of every dengue outbreak. Dengue is transmitted mainly by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, breeding in stagnant water in containers, flowerpots, tyres and blocked drains. Warmer temperatures can speed viral development in mosquitoes; rainfall creates breeding sites, while water shortages may drive storage in uncovered containers. Outbreaks depend on mosquito control, urbanization, movement, sanitation and local weather. Prevention includes removing standing water, covering storage, cleaning gutters, using repellents, wearing long sleeves, and installing screens. Seek medical advice for persistent fever or dengue symptoms.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: Ebola tests for the patient returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo are negative.
article.articleSummary: Ebola tests for a patient returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo were negative, the Israeli Ministry of Health reported. The suspicion arose after the patient was admitted to a hospital on return from the DRC. Tests were performed in accordance with professional standards and internationally approved guidelines for managing high-risk infectious diseases. The ministry stressed that there are no confirmed Ebola cases in Israel to date. It noted that the virus is not airborne and is transmitted through direct contact with an infected person who shows symptoms, or via the infected person's blood, body fluids, or secretions. The report underlines ongoing vigilance and standard isolation precautions.

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : Damien Mama des Nations-Unies plaide pour un accès libre aux humanitaires et la création des Centres de Traitement d'Ebola dans toutes les zone touchées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Damien Mama of the United Nations calls for unfettered access for humanitarian workers and the creation of Ebola Treatment Centers in all affected areas.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola outbreak: Since May, the epidemic curve in North Kivu has risen with a case-fatality rate described as 68 deaths per 100 infections. In Beni on September 11, 2026, UN Deputy Special Representative Damien Mama urged unhindered humanitarian access and the rapid establishment of Ebola Treatment Centers in all 16 affected health zones to shorten distances to care and improve early treatment. He warned the epicenter could shift from Ituri to North Kivu as health zones become affected. The response relies on free movement of medical and humanitarian teams; residents should support response efforts and allow access for aid workers. Ongoing measures include handwashing, social distancing, and safe handling of corpses, among others.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：国連のダミアン・ママ氏、人道支援団体への自由なアクセスと被害地域全域でのエボラ治療センター設立を訴える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で致死率68%とされるエボラ流行が継続・拡大しており、16の保健区域に及ぶ深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため。
triage.notes: エピセンターがイトゥリ州から北キブ州へ移行する懸念が示されており、国連関係者が人道アクセスの自由化と治療センター設置を求めている。5月以降続く流行で致死率が高く、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Assam: Over 50 Fall Ill After Consuming Prasad at Kaliabor Shani Puja
article.articleSummary: Over 50 people fell ill after consuming prasad distributed during a Shani Puja at Ambagan Haribhanga in Kaliabor, Assam, on Saturday night. Affected individuals developed fever, vomiting and dysentery and were admitted to Kaliabor Sub-Divisional Civil Hospital at Jakhalabandha; several others were referred to Tezpur Medical College and Nagaon Medical College for advanced care. The prasad allegedly used various fruits. Medical teams treated patients from Sunday morning and continued monitoring; some cases were sent to Tezpur and Nagaon for higher-level care. Authorities are awaiting further details from investigations into suspected contamination of the prasad and the medical/administrative findings. The incident underscores potential foodborne illness linked to religious gathering in Ambagan Haribhanga, Kaliabor.

article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu In MP: 5 H1N1 Deaths, Nearly 300 Cases Reported; Indore Records 2 Fatalities
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-13, swine flu (H1N1) has caused 5 deaths and about 300 cases in Madhya Pradesh, India, with Indore reporting two deaths and Bhopal, Ujjain, and Dewas one death each. IDSP data show MP's overall toll of 5 deaths from H1N1. In Bhopal, 65 cases have been recorded, with 45 detected in the past 12 days, and the city reports its first H1N1 death this year: an 80-year-old man who had heart disease, hypertension and type 2 diabetes and died after a severe respiratory illness with H1N1. Monsoon and winter seasons are described as favorable for viral respiratory illnesses, including H1N1. The outbreak underscores seasonal risk; ongoing surveillance by IDSP notes the current distribution and burden across MP.
