article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Judith Suminwa enjoint à l'équipe de riposte de redoubler de vigilance et d'efforts afin de maintenir la tendance baissière observée sur le terrain
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Judith Suminwa urges the response team to redouble vigilance and efforts to maintain the downward trend observed on the ground.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo virus is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo since May 2026, with Ituri at the epicenter and spread to seven provinces and over 60 health zones, making it among the country’s most severe and rapid outbreaks. By September 2026 authorities report a downward trend: fewer confirmed cases and deaths, indicating the epidemic is under control and the peak has been reached. Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka chaired a Sept 10–11, 2026, multisectoral evaluation with government ministers, the FARDC, and the national police to review field operations, resources, and partner coordination. A transparency drive includes an interim Treasury-financed report on Ebola response expenditures. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, and control remains challenged by insecurity, population movement, and community trust issues.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行下のDRC：ジュディス・スミンワ首相が対応チームに、現地で観察されている減少傾向を維持するため警戒と努力の強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱がDRCで7州60以上の保健地域に拡大し、同国史上最も深刻・急速な流行の一つとなっている。承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、治安・人口移動・地域社会の信頼問題も絡むため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月以降続くブンディブギョ株エボラ流行。9月時点で症例・死亡数は減少傾向にあるが、承認されたワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、治安・人口移動・コミュニティの信頼問題が制御の課題として残る。首相自らが多部門評価を実施しており、政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bengal dengue cases cross 5,000, Murshidabad worst-hit with over 1,000 infections
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in West Bengal crossed 5,002 this year (as of Sept 11; data from Aug 6). Murshidabad is the worst-hit district with 1,072 infections, followed by Kolkata with more than 500. Districts reporting notable counts include North 24 Parganas 450; Nadia over 400; South 24 Parganas 366; Malda around 400; Howrah 325; Hooghly 325; Purba Bardhaman 256; Paschim Bardhaman 154; Purba Medinipur 126; Paschim Medinipur 104; Jhargram 54. A total of 6,826 dengue tests had been conducted. The number of cases has more than doubled in about a month, rising from 2,410 on Aug 6 to 5,002 by Sept 11, indicating an ongoing dengue outbreak in the state through early September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州のデング熱感染者が5,000人を超え、ムルシダバードが1,000人以上で最多

article.articleHeadline: התקבלו תוצאות שליליות לבדיקות האבולה של החולה שאושפז עקב חשד כי חלה במחלה
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Negative results for the patient's Ebola tests after he was hospitalized on suspicion of having contracted the disease.
article.articleSummary: Negative Ebola test results were reported for a patient in Israel who was hospitalized on suspicion of infection after returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Ministry of Health announced that laboratory testing for Ebola virus disease was negative, and no confirmed Ebola case has been identified in Israel. The hospitalization was precautionary, prompted by travel exposure to a region with Ebola activity. Authorities indicated ongoing monitoring and routine contact follow-up where appropriate, but emphasized that there is currently no domestically confirmed outbreak or imported case. This incident underscores continued vigilance for Ebola among travelers and supports the absence of a national case count as of 13 September 2026.

article.articleHeadline: החשש לאבולה הוסר: בדיקות החולה שחזר מקונגו שליליות
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola scare has been dispelled: tests on the patient who returned from Congo are negative.
article.articleSummary: Tests for Ebola in a patient hospitalized at Hadassah Ein Kerem after returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo were negative. The Health Ministry states there is currently no confirmed Ebola case in Israel, and Ebola is not airborne; transmission occurs only via direct contact with a symptomatic patient or with blood, body fluids, or secretions. The patient was isolated for diagnostic workup; an epidemiological investigation identified contacts, with guidance that those not contacted require no action. Health authorities have prepared medical staff and hospitals, completed PPE stockpiles, and established early detection and laboratory-confirmation procedures for high-risk diseases. The public is urged to avoid non-essential travel to areas with active transmission, notably the DRC. Travelers returning from the DRC who develop fever or unusual symptoms within 21 days should stay home, avoid contact, and call the Kol HaBriut hotline at 5400*.

article.articleHeadline: Lucknow News: डेटिंग ऐप से बने रिश्ते बढ़ा रहे HIV का रिस्क केजीएमयू में हर माह बड़ी संख्या में आ रहे मामले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lucknow News: Dating-app-based relationships are increasing the risk of HIV, with a large number of cases being reported every month at KGMU.
article.articleSummary: Lucknow, India: At King George's Medical University (KGMU) Anti-Retroviral Therapy (ART) Center, HIV risk linked to dating-app–initiated relationships is drawing concern. Doctors report about 10–15 patients annually with infections tied to unsafe sexual activity in new dating relationships formed via apps. Experts stress that dating apps do not cause HIV, but meeting anonymous partners and engaging in unprotected sex without full health history increases transmission risk. The article notes higher risk among LGBTQ communities, with stigma delaying care. Early symptoms are often absent; testing remains the reliable confirmation method. ART has substantially improved prognosis, enabling long, normal lives when started; condom use reduces risk of HIV and other STIs. Before new partners, discuss health status and testing; if exposure suspected, seek medical advice promptly. Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) may help when started soon after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウニュース：出会い系アプリで築かれた関係がHIVリスクを高める、KGMUで毎月多数の症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: 年間10〜15例程度の慢性的なHIV感染に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はHIVの性行動に関する公衆衛生啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常な感染急増を報告するものではないため、地域特定は不要と判断（対象国リストにインドは含まれるが、イベント自体がシグナルに該当しないためverified_locationsは空とした）。

article.articleHeadline: AP Steps Up Disease Surveillance as Rain Raises Infection Risk
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Andhra Pradesh rose to 7,895 cases as of August 30, up from 6,172 last year (27.9% increase), with spikes in Alluri Sitarama Raju, Polavaram and Vizianagaram. Dengue increased to 1,475 cases (1,410 last year), notably in YSR Kadapa (48→128) and Chittoor (73→112), while Kurnool and Anakapalli declined. Scrub typhus reached 941 cases, with Alluri Sitarama Raju (13→44) and Parvathipuram Manyam (15→47) rising. Food- and water-borne diseases surged in Srikakulam (34→408), totaling 930 cases overall. The state distributed 599,367 mosquito nets and plans a second indoor residual spraying round in Alluri Sitarama Raju, Polavaram, Parvathipuram Manyam and Eluru, with additional rounds if needed. A Dry Day every Friday will be monitored via an app, clearing water containers and other breeding sites; fever testing near forest areas and inter-department coordination are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラ・プラデーシュ州、降雨による感染リスク増加を受け疾病サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: マラリア・デング熱・つつが虫病の症例数が前年より増加しているが、季節性（モンスーン期）の予測可能な増加であり、州政府が既存の対策（防虫ネット配布、室内残留噴霧、水溜り除去等）で対応中であるため、直ちにフルリスク評価に進む段階ではないが動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: マラリア、デング熱、つつが虫病、食品・水系感染症の症例増加はモンスーン期の季節性パターンであり、州政府による既存の予防・監視体制（防虫ネット配布、室内残留噴霧、Dry Dayキャンペーン等）で管理されている。重症度（入院・死亡数）に関する情報がなく、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクも見られない。

article.articleHeadline: School IB Geography class: Life on the frontline against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola figures: The article analyzes the DR Congo Ebola outbreak (2026) alongside the 2014 West Africa epidemic, using Figure 1 for estimation: (a) time to reach 4,000 reported cases in DR Congo 2026; (b) the number of West Africa cases 110 days after the first case. It cites UN tallies of healthcare workers who have died in the current epidemic. It offers two reasons the true infection count may be several times higher than official figures: limited surveillance/testing and access constraints in insecure areas. It explains two ways eastern DR Congo displacement could raise diffusion (e.g., movement and crowded shelters) and two ways traditional funeral practices hinder containment. It contrasts priorities for outbreak control between two stakeholders featured in the piece. As of 2026-09-13.

triage.headline_ja: IB地理クラス授業:エボラ出血熱との闘いの最前線での生活
triage.triage_reason: DRCで報告症例4,000人規模のエボラ出血熱流行が継続中であり、医療従事者の死亡、住民移動による感染拡大リスク、監視体制の限界など複数のIHR/WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本記事はIB地理教育教材として2026年DRCエボラ流行を2014年西アフリカ流行と比較分析したものであり、一次報道ではないが、実際の大規模流行（報告症例4,000件規模）を裏付ける内容。アンゴラは発生地域として付与されているが、記事サマリーでは言及されておらず除外した。続報や公式統計での実態確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: החשד לאבולה: משרד הבריאות בעדכון חשוב
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola: Ministry of Health issues an important update.
article.articleSummary: Israel's Ministry of Health announced that Ebola tests on a patient who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo were negative, confirming no confirmed Ebola case in Israel. The patient was isolated at Hadassah Medical Center, Ein Kerem, in good condition. An epidemiological investigation to identify contacts has been completed; those not directly contacted are not required to act. Ebola is not airborne and spreads through direct contact with a symptomatic patient or with blood, body fluids, or secretions. The ministry continues to monitor outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda. It urges avoiding nonessential travel to areas with active Ebola transmission, and returning travelers with fever or symptoms within 21 days should stay home, avoid contact, and call the health hotline. This is the second suspected case ruled out in recent months; authorities will provide updates as needed.

article.articleHeadline: У ДР Конго кількість випадків Еболи перевищила 7 тисяч: скільки інфікованих вже померло
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the number of Ebola cases has surpassed 7,000: how many of the infected have already died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 7,022 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 3,398 deaths and 837 people in isolation or under treatment. The Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak—the 17th Ebola epidemic in the DRC—began in Ituri province in the northeast and has since spread to eastern and northern regions, where armed groups and weak health infrastructure hinder response. This week a laboratory-confirmed case was reported in South Ubangi, the seventh province; South Ubangi borders the Central African Republic and the Republic of Congo. Most cases are in Ituri, including detections in schools after children returned from summer break. Schools have implemented handwashing with soap and reduced class sizes to 30. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola yet; several candidates are in trials. In August 2026, DRC received over 16,000 vaccine doses, with 70,000 expected.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例数が7,000人を突破：感染者のうち死亡者数は
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける大規模エボラ流行（7,022症例、3,398死亡）が7州に拡大し、ワクチン未承認・治安不安定な地域での対応困難があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 南ウバンギ州で新たに検査確定例が報告され、中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国との国境地帯に拡大している点に留意。中央アフリカ共和国自体での症例発生は記事に明記されていないため対象国リストに含めず。致死率約48%と非常に高く、ワクチンは承認前・治験段階である点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число случаев Эболы превысило 7 тысяч: сколько инфицированных уже умерло
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the number of Ebola cases has exceeded 7,000: how many infected have already died.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) has reached 7,022 confirmed cases, with 3,398 deaths and 837 people in isolation or under treatment. The outbreak, the 17th Ebola epidemic in the DRC, began in Ituri province in the northeast and has since spread to seven provinces, including South Ubangi near the Central African Republic and Republic of Congo. Most cases are in Ituri, with transmission detected in schools after students returned from summer holidays, prompting hygiene measures such as handwashing and class sizes limited to 30. Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. For Bundibugyo, no approved vaccine or specific treatment yet, though several candidates are in trials. In August 2026, DRC received over 16,000 vaccine doses (target 70,000). OBOZ.UA reported the outbreak then as the deadliest in the country's history with 2,325 deaths and 4,945 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が7,000人を超える：これまでに何人が死亡したか
triage.triage_reason: DRCで第17次エボラ流行が拡大し、確定症例7,022件・死亡3,398人に達し複数州へ拡大、学校での伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（特にIturi州および周辺7州）でのエボラ流行拡大を主題としており、中央アフリカ共和国は近接地域として言及されているのみで感染例は確認されていないため対象国リストに含めず。致死率約48%と非常に高く、学校での感染拡大やワクチン供給不足（16,000/70,000回分）も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue spike in Bhopal: Cases in Sept surpass last yr's tally for month
article.articleSummary: Seven dengue positives reported in the first 11 days of September 2026 in Bhopal, according to the district malaria office (DMO), with roughly one case every two days as 220 dengue tests were conducted in September. Through 2026, 4,877 dengue tests have been performed with 78 positives; by contrast, September 2025 saw 387 tests with 4 positives, and the cumulative figures at that time reached 7,068 tests and 73 positives. Officials warn that vector-borne infections may rise after the monsoon, with stagnant water promoting transmission, while malaria tests total 2,289 with no positives and chikungunya yields two positives from 68 tests. Residents are urged to prevent water stagnation, use mosquito protection, and seek care for fever, severe headache, or body pains. The report does not mention imported/exported dengue cases.

article.articleHeadline: החשד הוסר: בדיקות האבולה של החולה ששב מקונגו יצאו שליליות - JDN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The suspicion has been cleared: Ebola tests for the patient who returned from Congo came back negative - JDN.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-13, Ebola testing for a patient who returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo was negative, clearing the suspected imported case in Israel. The patient was hospitalized on arrival following the suspicion under professional protocols and international guidelines for managing high-risk infectious diseases. Israel currently has no confirmed Ebola cases. The virus is not airborne; transmission occurs through direct contact with a symptomatic patient or with blood, body fluids, or secretions. The Ministry of Health will continue to monitor and will update the public and healthcare workers as needed. This update aligns with ongoing international reporting and confirms adherence to established protocols.

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 cases in Bhopal: Elderly men among those showing severe signs
article.articleSummary: H1N1 in Bhopal shows an elderly-skewed severity pattern, with IDSP data noting the first death in the current case set and cases spread across the city. Nearly five H1N1 cases per day have been detected in September, totaling 43 positives this month; ages range from 13 to 80 years. The most serious outcomes are among elderly men, including an 80-year-old resident of JK Road–Minal Residency who died after acute respiratory failure and severe ARDS, with underlying coronary artery disease, hypertension and type 2 diabetes. A 66-year-old and a 70-year-old are currently admitted; over the weekend three patients aged 13, 40 and 41 were discharged. Geographically, cases span Bhopal across Kolar, Bhadbhada Road, Suraj Nagar, Minal Residency, Patel Nagar and Emerald Park–AIIMS Bhopal, with one patient from Jawahar Ward in Gardarwada, Narsinghpur district. No neighborhood cluster; severity linked to age and comorbidities; some new seasonal influenza A tests pending.

article.articleHeadline: 100 students fall ill due to suspected food poisoning at Surat hostel
article.articleSummary: Surat, Abrama: about 100 of 2,200 students and staff at the P P Savani hostel fell ill after dinner on Saturday, with vomiting and abdominal pain reported from around 11:30 pm. Around 85 students vomited; 12 were admitted to P P Savani Hospital in Kapodra (9 girls, 3 boys, ages 15–17); four discharged by Sunday, eight remain under care. Dinner reportedly included paneer-mutter, roti, fried rice and buttermilk; hostel authorities noted ~2,000 ate dinner, but only ~100 sick. Some students also consumed prasad at a Ganpati event, which could be a contributing factor. The Surat Municipal Corporation collected six food samples and issued a notice to hostel authorities. Health Minister Praful Pansheriya ordered a state-wide probe; a team is examining food, water, kitchen hygiene, ingredients, and SOP compliance to determine if food poisoning is the cause or another factor, with possible legal action for SOP violations.

article.articleHeadline: CCZ de Pará de Minas realiza ações de prevenção e controle de zoonoses no primeiro semestre de 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pará de Minas Zoonosis Control Center carries out zoonosis prevention and control actions in the first half of 2026.
article.articleSummary: Pará de Minas Zoonosis Control Center (CCZ) reported actions in the first half of 2026 to prevent, monitor, and control zoonoses in Pará de Minas, Brazil. The CCZ conducted 1,198 leishmaniasis tests and 27 sporotrichosis exams, and collected 27 animals with suspected zoonoses found in public spaces. It also collected 4,000 scorpions for monitoring and prevention of accidents and health risks to residents. The activities form part of ongoing surveillance, monitoring of animals and vectors, and disease prevention, aiming to identify focal points and reduce disease circulation in the municipality. The report underscores the CCZ's role in public health protection through diagnostic testing, vector surveillance, and response to animal incidents in public areas. Source: Jornal Panorama via Prefeitura de Pará de Minas.

article.articleHeadline: ദിവസവും ചികിത്സ തേടുന്നത് 200ലധികം പേർ,​ പനിച്ചു വിറച്ച് നാട്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 200 people seek treatment every day, a fever-stricken country.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, Kannur district, Kerala, reports a fever surge with viral fever cases exceeding 200 daily; the past week saw about 5,000 people seek treatment for viral fever, with dengue also widespread in Kannur Corporation limits, Chirakkal, Thalipparambu, and Narath. Symptoms mirror viral illness and include loss of taste, severe fatigue, headache, low blood pressure, and dizziness; most viral fevers resolve in 2–3 days but can last up to two weeks, leaving people fatigued. Over 1,000 sought care yesterday across Thalipparambu taluk hospital, Kannur District Hospital, PHCs, and private hospitals. Authorities warn of stretched services and long waits at primary centers; factors include climate variation, increasing mosquitoes, hygiene gaps, and lifestyle changes. Those with respiratory symptoms, severe body pains, persistent vomiting, or fatigue should consult a doctor. Preventive measures: hand hygiene, avoid close contact, cover coughs, and ensure good ventilation.

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Anthrax Outbreak In Mpika
article.articleSummary: Anthrax outbreak in the Nabwalya area of Mpika District, Muchinga Province, Zambia, with confirmed cases in both animals and humans. About 14 human patients are currently receiving treatment; their condition is stable and responding to therapy. More than 26 wild animals have died from anthrax in the affected area, and authorities are intensifying surveillance and restricting movement and consumption of wild meat to curb spread. Government measures include heightened disease surveillance, community sensitisation, and disposal of infected carcasses; the Ministry of Health, with the Disaster Risk Management Division, is supplying medicines to nearby health centres and distributing information materials about anthrax to local communities. Department of National Parks and Wildlife, with security agencies, is restricting wild meat handling to prevent transmission. The pathogen is Bacillus anthracis; humans can become infected from animals or contaminated meat.

article.articleHeadline: Four test positive for swine flu at Paonta Sahib hospital - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Four patients have tested positive for H1N1 (swine flu) at Paonta Sahib Civil Hospital in Sirmaur district over four days. The patients presented with fever, cough and difficulty in breathing; samples were collected after doctors suspected influenza and subsequently confirmed positive. All four were moved from the general ward to the isolation facility; their condition is stable and under medical observation. Hospital authorities have intensified surveillance of other patients and healthcare workers to prevent transmission, with precautions advised for those attending to influenza-like cases. Dr AV Raghav, Medical Officer In-charge, confirmed the four positive cases and their isolation. Sirmaur Chief Medical Officer Dr Rakesh Pratap urged individuals with persistent fever, cough, sore throat or breathing difficulties to seek prompt medical care, emphasizing extra precautions for the elderly, young children, and those with underlying illnesses.

article.articleHeadline: В ДРК врачи сталкиваются с трудностями в борьбе со вспышкой Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, doctors are facing difficulties in the fight against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in Ituri province in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where residents impede medical teams from examining bodies of deceased patients showing symptoms. Investigators cannot access 42 corpses due to resistance from relatives, hindering lab confirmation and tissue sampling needed to determine Ebola infection and to map transmission chains. The lack of verified data makes it difficult to assess the outbreak’s true scale in the eastern DRC and to understand death-cause patterns and infection routes. For the period August 26–September 1, the DRC recorded 295 deaths, with 210 occurring in communities and 85 in medical facilities. Ongoing data gaps delay focused public health responses and contact-tracing efforts essential to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の流行への対応に医師らが困難に直面
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がDRCイツリ州で進行中で、多数の死亡（295人）と検死拒否による調査困難が報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴う。
triage.notes: 地域住民による検死拒否がラボ確認や感染経路把握を妨げており、実際の流行規模の把握が困難な状況。データギャップにより対応の遅延が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Инфекционист Румянцев: новый вирус ALTNV грозит тяжелым состоянием
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious disease specialist Rumyantsev: the new ALTNV virus threatens a serious condition.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, China identifies a new orthonairovirus ALTNV transmitted to humans via bites from the Asian longhorned tick. In 56 patients with isolated ALTNV infection, all recovered without complications; symptoms include high fever, myalgia, weakness, and gastrointestinal disturbances. A more severe course occurred with co-infection of ALTNV and Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever virus (CCHFV); among 38 studied co-infection cases, seven deaths were reported, though the small sample limits mortality assessment. ALTNV RNA was found in 1.3% of 47,000 ticks examined, with cases predominantly in China. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor is preparing a test system for simultaneous detection of nearly 30 etiologic agents of acute respiratory infections. Additional details are covered in OSN reports.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症専門医ルミャンツェフ氏:新型ウイルスALTNVは重篤な状態を引き起こす恐れ
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規発見されたダニ媒介性オルソナイロウイルス(ALTNV)がCCHFVとの共感染で重症化・死亡例(7/38)を伴っており、異常性と重篤性の両基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ロシアの言及はRospotrebnadzorによる検査体制整備に関するものであり、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。ALTNV単独感染は軽症・回復傾向だが、CCHFVとの共感染例で死亡が報告されている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: São Bernardo amplia vacinação e mantém dose zero contra sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Bernardo expands vaccination and maintains zero-dose against measles.
article.articleSummary: São Bernardo do Campo, in the Greater ABC region of São Paulo, Brazil, reports vaccination expansion with 690,436 doses administered Jan–Aug 2026, up from 636,734 in the same period in 2024 (8.4% rise). The municipality has the highest newborn vaccine coverage in the region and leads in 12 of 16 vaccines for under-1-year-olds. Immunization Director Jéssica de Cássia Santos Soares attributes gains to intensified extramural outreach and regular vaccinator training. Measles measures include a zero-dose for infants 6–11 months (launched July after local cases) and an indiscriminate vaccination campaign for 6 months to 59 years from Aug 3 to Sep 1, which yielded over 217,000 doses and coincided with no new cases. Post-campaign, vaccines remain at UBSs per the National Vaccination Schedule; two additional vaccination points will operate on Sep 26 (Regina Rocco Casa I, Vila São Pedro; Luiz Gushiken, Alves Dias).

triage.headline_ja: サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ市、麻疹に対するワクチン接種を拡大し「ゼロ回接種」対策を継続
triage.triage_reason: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州の一自治体における麻疹ワクチン接種率向上の成功事例を報告する内容であり、現在進行中の集団感染や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年7月に地域での麻疹症例を受けて実施されたゼロ回接種対策とワクチン接種キャンペーン（8月3日〜9月1日）が功を奏し、キャンペーン期間中に新規症例が報告されなかったことを伝える内容。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本記事の主題はワクチン接種行政の成功事例であり、アウトブレイクシグナルとしての性質は低い。

article.articleHeadline: В Южной Корее одобрят вакцину против африканской чумы свиней
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Korea to approve vaccine against African swine fever
article.articleSummary: South Korea’s Komipharm is poised to bring an attenuated live vaccine against African swine fever (ASF), Pro-Vac ASF, to market. Based on a US Department of Agriculture–derived ASFv-G-ΔI177L/ΔLVR strain, it is administered as a single dose. Trials on piglets and pregnant sows show robust protection: vaccinated animals did not develop fever or adverse reactions, and antibodies to ASF appeared in most piglets receiving colostrum from vaccinated sows. Post-vaccination challenges at 8 and 12 weeks demonstrated survival and sustained clinical health in vaccinated pigs, even after repeated exposures. Komipharm plans to certify the vaccine for export by year-end, with testing ongoing in the Philippines and Vietnam under official authorization. Separately, earlier this year another South Korean firm, CAVAC, received a license to export the ASF vaccine Suishot ASF-X.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国、アフリカ豚熱ワクチンを承認へ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はアフリカ豚熱(ASF)ワクチンの商業化・輸出承認に関する内容であり、ヒトの健康への影響もなく、新規アウトブレイクの報告でもないため。
triage.notes: 記事はASFワクチン(Pro-Vac ASF, Suishot ASF-X)の商業展開・輸出承認に関するもので、フィリピン・ベトナムでの言及は臨床試験実施国としてのみであり、当該国での実際のASF発生を報じるものではないためverified_locationsには含めない。動物衛生（家畜疾病）に関する内容であり、ヒト感染症のEBSシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Cataguases vacina 65 bezerras contra brucelose no distrito de Cataguarino
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cataguases vaccinates 65 heifers against brucellosis in the Cataguarino district.
article.articleSummary: 65 heifers aged 3-8 months were vaccinated against bovine brucellosis in Cataguases' Cataguarino district last week by the Municipal Secretariat of Agriculture and Environment (SAMA). This immunization is part of ongoing preventive and sanitary-control efforts to protect the municipality’s herd from brucellosis, an infectious disease that can cause abortions and infertility in cattle. Brucellosis is a zoonosis, so measures also aim to prevent transmission to humans. The vaccination followed sanitary norms, and the municipality targets about 1,000 animals protected per year in Cataguases, with the 65-dose action contributing to that goal. The initiative underscores coordinated efforts to safeguard animal and public health by reducing brucellosis risk in the region.

triage.headline_ja: カタグアーゼス、カタグアリーノ地区で子牛65頭にブルセラ症ワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: 定期的な家畜へのブルセラ症予防接種活動であり、ヒトの症例発生や異常な公衆衛生事象は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 家畜への予防的ワクチン接種activityであり、ヒト感染事例の報告なし。ルーチンの家畜衛生対策のため対象国リストに該当するが、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 7 آلاف إصابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in Congo exceed 7,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 7,000, with the majority of cases in Ituri Province. Cases have emerged in schools after the summer break, triggering concerns among parents and health workers. The outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Across Africa over the last five decades, Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths; transmission occurs via direct contact with infected body fluids and can cause severe internal and external bleeding and multi‑organ failure. The article notes ongoing transmission in Congo but provides no details on laboratory confirmation or exported cases. Highlights the risk to children in school settings and the absence of a widely available medical countermeasure for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が7000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）感染者が7000人を超え、承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しない中、学校を含む地域社会での感染継続が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と流行拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株による大規模流行であり、学校での感染発生は流行拡大・社会的懸念を高める要因。国際的な症例輸出や渡航制限の有無については記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا تتخطى 7 آلاف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections exceed 7,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 7,000 cases, marking the worst outbreak on record. Authorities say the virus likely circulated for weeks before detection, with the latest wave officially identified in mid-May. The outbreak, the 17th of its kind, has caused about 3,398 deaths among 7,022 cases, with 1,671 recoveries reported to date. Most infections are concentrated in Ituri Province, where cases have appeared in schools after the summer holidays, prompting alarm among parents and healthcare workers. In Bunia, the province capital, mothers express fear despite health measures. A Bunia school official notes mandatory soap handwashing and policies limiting class size to 30 students, along with ongoing education urging children not to touch or shake hands and to wash hands regularly. No details on imported or exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者数が7,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が発生し、7,000例超・死亡3,398例と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行として過去最大規模。イトゥリ州で学校集団発生の兆候あり、地域社会の不安が拡大。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する情報は記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue strikes!
article.articleSummary: Dengue strikes in the Philippines, with a dengue outbreak declared in Bohol after Aug 26 as cases reach epidemic thresholds and mortalities are reported. A Cebu-based critical-care clinician recounts a fatal dengue case: a patient arrived in shock with bleeding needing transfusion, but blood products were unavailable, and she died within 12 hours. The Dengue Integrated Program (DIP) of the PPSCV continues to train health-care workers through caravans and seminars, including a workshop at Governor Celestino Gallares Memorial Medical Center in Bohol. Incidence is reportedly lower than the same period last year, but officials caution against complacency in this endemic country aiming for WHO’s 2030 zero-death target. Recommendations emphasize early testing, avoiding aspirin, maintaining rehydration with oral salts, encouraging blood donors, and considering the newer-generation dengue vaccine now licensed in other endemic nations. Dengue can be fatal.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が猛威を振るう！
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・ボホール州でデング熱アウトブレイクが宣言され死亡例も報告されているが、同国では毎年流行する風土病であり、今季の発生数は前年より少ないとされるため、異常性や国際的拡大の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はオピニオン記事であり、医療体制の課題（血液製剤不足等）と啓発活動が主題。デング熱はフィリピンの風土病で季節的流行であり、WHO通報相当の異常事態には該当しないと判断。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يضرب الكونغو بقوة غير مسبوقة.. أكثر من 7 آلاف إصابة والوباء يقترب من الحدود - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola strikes the Congo with unprecedented force... More than 7,000 cases and the outbreak is approaching the borders - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached an unprecedented scale, with 7,022 cases and 3,398 deaths, and about 1,671 recoveries reported as of 13 September 2026. The outbreak began in Ituri in the northeast and has spread to eastern and northern regions, including South Ubangi, affecting seven provinces and raising cross-border risk to the Central African Republic and the Republic of Congo. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment, making containment rely on surveillance, isolation, contact tracing, and infection prevention. WHO warns the outbreak is not under control, with rapid transmission and potential regional spread. UN humanitarian official Tom Fletcher notes a death every 30 minutes and calls for expanded international funding; roughly $300 million has been pledged to a response fund. Cases in schools add social and economic pressure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴを前例のない規模で襲う…7000人以上が感染し、流行は国境に迫る - リビアニュース24
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7000例超・死亡3398例という前例のない規模のエボラ流行が拡大中で、WHOが制御不能と警告し国際支援を要請していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国への越境リスクが言及されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo株であり、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 甲流來勢洶洶！開學沒幾天 上海多班級居家隔離 | 上海甲流 | 半數請假 | 杭州甲流
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 flu surges! Only a few days into the new term, many Shanghai classes are under home quarantine | Shanghai H1N1 flu | Half of the students are absent | Hangzhou H1N1 flu
article.articleSummary: Influenza A(H3N2) outbreaks trigger large-scale school disruptions in Shanghai and Hangzhou as the autumn term begins. In Shanghai, multiple primary/secondary schools and kindergartens in Baoshan and Huangpu report clustered infections, with some classes placed under full-class home quarantine and parents noting about half the students are sick or absent. Shanghai Children’s Hospital records a sharp rise in flu-related visits, and influenza comprises roughly one-third of beds among hospitalized pediatric patients. In Hangzhou, Zhejiang province, a similar pattern emerges: a class of about 40 students experiences illness prompting a school-wide break from September 11–14, with a planned return on September 15. About 10 children have fever, and roughly half of those are diagnosed with influenza. The surge centers on H3N2, with co-circulating influenza B Victoria lineage, prompting local public health responses in schools.

triage.headline_ja: 甲類インフルエンザが猛威！新学期開始からわずか数日で上海の多くのクラスが自宅隔離に | 上海の甲流 | 半数が欠席 | 杭州の甲流
triage.triage_reason: 上海・杭州の学校で季節性インフルエンザ(H3N2)による大規模なクラス閉鎖と入院増加が報告され、地域社会・メディアの関心も高いため、スクリーニング基準に複数該当しフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H3N2、一部B型Victoria系統)による学校クラスターであり、通常の季節性流行の範囲内である可能性が高いが、入院増加や複数校での集団感染が報告されているため経過観察を含むフル評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : la population appelée à redoubler de vigilance face à la propagation d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Population urged to step up vigilance amid Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak prompts heightened vigilance in Tshopo Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. On September 13, 2026, Kisangani authorities urged residents to strictly observe barrier measures to curb transmission, including adherence to preventive practices, prohibition of mass gatherings, and rapid reporting of suspected cases, with ongoing response efforts by health teams and partners. The provincial governor emphasised collective responsibility and discipline to protect the community. Responding to reports of a planned march in Kisangani on September 15, officials warned that sanitary restrictions remain in force and actions jeopardizing containment will be legally sanctioned. The statement reiterates the emergency status in Tshopo and commits to continuing containment actions alongside health authorities to save lives amid the Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ツォポ州：エボラ拡大を受け住民に警戒強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で継続中であり、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ流行に対する地方当局の対応（集会禁止、法的措置警告等）を報じており、非常事態宣言下であることが確認される。感染者数・死亡者数など具体的な疫学データは記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 7 آلاف إصابة بـ"إيبولا" في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7,000 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports Ebola cases exceeding 7,000—the country’s worst outbreak on record—with about 3,400 deaths. Officials say the virus circulated for weeks before it was detected, and the latest wave was officially disclosed in mid-May. The outbreak began in Ituri Province in the northeastern region and has since spread to remote eastern and northern areas marked by armed conflict and weak health infrastructure. Earlier this week, transmission was confirmed in South Ubangi Province, the seventh province affected, bringing the epidemic closer to borders with the Central African Republic and the Republic of the Congo (Brazzaville). This remains the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染7,000人

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتجاوز 7 آلاف إصابة في الكونغو الديمقراطية وسط تفشٍ هو الأسوأ تاريخيًا | سبق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surpasses 7,000 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid the worst outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: As of September 13, 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 7,022 cases and 3,398 deaths, with 1,671 recoveries, in what authorities describe as the country’s seventeenth and worst outbreak. The outbreak began in Ituri Province in the northeast and has spread to seven provinces, including South Ubangi, which borders the Central African Republic and the Republic of Congo-Brazzaville, elevating regional risk. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe internal and external bleeding, organ failure, and death. The surge has occurred amid armed conflict and weak health infrastructure, with outbreaks observed in schools after the summer break; health authorities continue surveillance and cross-border preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が7,000人超の感染者、史上最悪の流行に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数(深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク)に該当し、致死率が高く隣国への越境リスクもある史上最悪規模のエボラ流行であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国は隣接国として越境リスクの文脈で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス種であり、武力紛争下で医療インフラが脆弱な地域での流行拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: PIC D'EBOLA FRANCHI EN RDC : La nécessité de maintenir la vigilance - Editions Le Pays
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola peak surpassed in the DRC: The need to maintain vigilance - Editions Le Pays
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo reached its peak by September 11, 2026, but vigilance is essential. As of September 10, 2026, the outbreak reported 7,022 confirmed cases, over 833 in isolation or hospital, and 3,398 deaths (case fatality rate 48.4%), with 1,671 recoveries. Declared May 15, 2026, the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC became the fastest and deadliest in the country’s history, surpassing 2018–2020 figures of about 4,300 cases and 2,000 deaths within three months. The capital Kinshasa has not been affected. The Bundibugyo strain, described as rare and for which no specific vaccine or approved treatment exists, remains a concern in the East. International support, including WHO and UN agencies, has yielded tangible gains, but authorities warn against complacency. Ongoing adherence to health measures and accelerated development of vaccines or treatments are deemed imperative to prevent a resurgence.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行のピークを超える：警戒維持の必要性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における第17次エボラ流行は同国史上最速・最悪規模（確定症例7,022人、死亡3,398人、致死率48.4%）であり、稀なブンディブギョ株で有効なワクチン・治療法もないため深刻性・異常性が高い。
triage.notes: 首都キンシャサは影響を受けていないと記載。ピークを越えたとされるが再燃防止のための継続的対策が強調されており、東部地域では希少株（ブンディブギョ株）に対するワクチン・治療薬が未確立である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Bikin Tegang, Tonton 7 Film Korea Tentang Bencana Alam Hingga Wabah Penyakit Ini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: That Will Put You on Edge: Watch 7 Korean Films About Natural Disasters Up to This Disease Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Seven Korean films center on natural disasters and disease outbreaks across South Korea. The Flu (2013) follows a deadly influenza-like virus threatening the nation. Tidal Wave depicts a quake-triggered tsunami hitting Busan, as a woman and her partner strive to survive. Sinkhole combines disaster with lighthearted elements around a massive ground collapse. Concrete Utopia shows Seoul after a major earthquake, with residents of a single apartment complex sheltering in place, featuring Park Seo-joon, Park Bo-young, and Lee Byung-hun. Emergency Declaration follows a pilot forced to declare an emergency to land amid a deadly onboard virus, inspired by a real Korean aviation incident. Exit portrays Seoul beset by a mysterious gas driving two leads to seek safety. Ashfall dramatizes Baekdu Mountain eruption threatening Korea, prompting mass evacuation.

triage.headline_ja: 手に汗握る！韓国の自然災害・疫病アウトブレイク映画7選
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、韓国映画を紹介するエンターテインメント記事であるため、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は映画紹介コンテンツであり、実際の感染症流行に関する情報は含まれていない。発生地域として付与された韓国・中国は誤検出であり、対象国リストにも該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: کانگو میں ایبولا کی خطرناک وبا، کیسز 7 ہزار سے متجاوزاور 3,400 کے قریب اموات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Ebola outbreak in Congo, cases exceed 7,000 with around 3,400 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 7,022 Ebola cases, 3,398 deaths, and 1,671 recoveries, in what authorities describe as the deadliest outbreak yet in the country. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment is available. Originating in May in Ituri province, the outbreak has spread to seven provinces, with confirmation of Ebola in South Ubangi this week, making it the seventh province affected. The World Health Organization says response efforts face shortages of trained healthcare staff, humanitarian partners, and funding, complicating containment.

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتجاوز 7 آلاف إصابة في الكونغو الديمقراطية وسط تفشٍ هو الأسوأ تاريخيًا - ستاد الأهلي

article.articleHeadline: Two free meal poisoning victims from N. Sumatra treated in Jakarta - Archipelago - The Jakarta Post
article.articleSummary: Two victims of suspected food poisoning linked to the ill-managed free nutritious meal program in Karo regency, North Sumatra, have been transported to Jakarta for treatment at Dr. Cipto Mangunkusumo National General Hospital (RSCM). Agnesia Paruliana boru Silitonga and Febiona boru Purba were flown to Jakarta after Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka visited Friday and requested direct treatment. RSCM officials say the patients are receiving care, though privacy prevents disclosure of their condition. North Sumatra Governor Bobby Nasution confirmed the transfer was at the VP’s request; he noted Medan’s medical team is capable, but the vice president sought direct oversight. The report concerns suspected food poisoning from the free meal program; no laboratory-confirmed details are provided. Details are current as of 2026-09-13.

triage.headline_ja: 北スマトラの無料給食による食中毒被害者2名、ジャカルタで治療中
triage.triage_reason: 感染症ではなく食中毒(疑い)による個別事例であり、国際的拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 感染症事例ではなく、政府の無料給食プログラムに関連した食中毒疑いの事例。副大統領の訪問により政治的関心は高いが、病原体・感染性の情報はなく感染症危機管理の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: مخاوف من فيروس جديد مرتبط بقراد في الولايات المتحدة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concerns about a new virus linked to ticks in the United States
article.articleSummary: A new virus linked to the Asian longhorned tick (Haemaphysalis longicornis), ALTNV (Asian Longhorn Tick Nairovirus), has been detected in China among patients who tested negative for Dabivavirus (DBV). More than 15% of DBV-negative patients were ALTNV-positive and reported influenza-like symptoms such as fatigue and gastrointestinal disturbances. No mortality increase is observed for ALTNV alone, but one death occurred among seven patients co-infected with ALTNV and DBV. In the United States, the Asian longhorned tick has spread to more than twenty states since 2017 and reproduces parthenogenetically. It has not yet been proven to transmit ALTNV to humans in the US; experts emphasize the importance of animal reservoirs and potential pathogen carriage. The tick also poses risks to livestock by transmitting parasites that can cause serious diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 米国でマダニに関連する新たなウイルスへの懸念
triage.triage_reason: 中国でマダニ由来の新規ウイルス(ALTNV)が検出されているが、ヒト-ヒト感染や重症度に関する情報が乏しく、米国での人への感染も未証明であるため、続報の注視が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 米国はマダニの分布拡大が報告されているが、ヒトへのウイルス感染は未確認であるため、対象国リストに含まれる米国は該当なし。中国では患者から新規ウイルスが検出されており、これが主題となっている。

article.articleHeadline: صحيفة: مخاوف بعد اكتشاف فيروس جديد مرتبط بقراد منتشر فى الولايات المتحدة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newspaper: Fears after the discovery of a new virus linked to ticks widespread in the United States - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: ALTNV, a novel virus linked to the Asian longhorned tick (Haemaphysalis longicornis), was detected in China in patients with influenza-like illness who tested negative for DBV. Among DBV-negative patients, ALTNV infection was found in over 15%, causing flu-like symptoms, fatigue, gastrointestinal disturbances, thrombocytopenia, and elevated liver enzymes. ALTNV alone did not show higher mortality, but co-infection with both viruses correlated with more respiratory symptoms and kidney dysfunction, with seven deaths among co-infected individuals. The Asian longhorned tick, established in the United States since 2017, has spread to more than 20 states and reproduces asexually, aiding expansion. It remains unknown whether US ticks transmit ALTNV to humans; tick-borne transmission depends on animals carrying the pathogen. The Chinese finding raises concerns about cross-border spread and the tick’s capacity to carry multiple pathogens, including implications for livestock health due to parasite transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 新聞報道：米国で広がるマダニに関連する新種ウイルスの発見後、懸念が広がる
triage.triage_reason: 中国でマダニ媒介の新規ウイルス（ALTNV）が発見され、重症化例や死亡例も報告されている。同種マダニは既に米国20州以上に定着しており、国境を越えた拡大リスクが指摘されているため。
triage.notes: 米国はマダニの生息域として言及されているのみで、ALTNVのヒトへの伝播は確認されていないため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。中国での患者検出が事実として明記されているため中国を対象国とした。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: સોલા સિવિલમાં અઠવાડિયામાં ડેન્ગ્યુના 130 કેસ આવ્યા: ડેન્ગ્યુ-મેલેરિયાના કેસો વધતાં 5 મોટી ખાનગી હોસ્પિટલોમાં 80થી 90 ટકા બેડ ભરાઈ ગયા
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 130 dengue cases in a week at Sola Civil Hospital: With dengue-malaria cases rising, beds in five major private hospitals are 80 to 90 percent full.
article.articleSummary: 130 dengue cases in a week at Sola Civil Hospital, with 24 malaria and 10 swine flu cases reported; LG Hospital records 115 dengue and 50 malaria. Five major private hospitals are operating at 80-90% bed occupancy due to dengue and malaria, with about 90 beds filled. Dengue and malaria, along with viral infections, are rising citywide, and co-infection with dengue can worsen outcomes due to immune suppression. Dengue presents with abrupt fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, body and joint pains, nausea/vomiting, and rash. Municipal vector-control efforts include fogging, with figures cited as up to 100 crore rupees for dengue/malaria control and an annual cost around 22 lakh. The report highlights ongoing outbreaks and strain on healthcare facilities.

triage.headline_ja: ソラ市民病院で1週間に130件のデング熱症例：デング熱・マラリア症例増加により5つの大規模民間病院で病床の80〜90％が埋まる
triage.triage_reason: インド・グジャラート州アフマダーバードでの季節性デング熱・マラリア症例増加により医療機関の病床逼迫が見られるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限リスクは低く、既知の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方紙（Divya Bhaskar、グジャラート語）によるローカルな医療機関逼迫の報道。季節性のデング熱・マラリア・スワインフルーの複合流行で、インドでは毎年報告される事例。全国的または国際的な関心の高まりを示す情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái 4 tuổi tử vong do bệnh dại sau thời gian thường xuyên chơi, ôm ấp và ngủ cùng mèo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4-year-old girl dies of rabies after regularly playing, cuddling, and sleeping with a cat.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 September 2026, a 4-year-old girl from Gào Commune, Gia Lai Province, Vietnam, died of rabies. She played with and slept with three kittens; two fell ill and died, with no apparent wounds on the child. Onset occurred September 6 with fever, chills, fatigue, and poor appetite; by September 8 she developed agitation, disorientation, vomiting, excess saliva, hydrophobia, aerophobia, fever, and headache. Clinicians diagnosed rabies; she died September 9. Epidemiologic investigation traced exposure to five kittens given in July from a different household. Within a week, two kittens died with similar signs; their bodies were discarded in remote area. The remaining two kittens from that household also died around the same time. The mother cat survived; one kitten remained under observation; the area was disinfected. Health authorities conducted contact tracing and offered vaccination and rabies immunoglobulin to exposed individuals. This is Gia Lai’s fifth rabies death in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 4歳の女児、猫と頻繁に遊び、抱っこし、一緒に寝ていた後に狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで狂犬病による小児死亡例が発生し地域では今年5例目だが、単発の風土病的事例であり国際的拡大リスクは低いため、動物由来感染対策の実施状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Gia Lai省では2026年に既に5例目の狂犬病死亡例であり、動物(猫)由来感染の地域的な継続的リスクが示唆される。人-人感染はないため国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Officials launch door-to-door mosquito alert after ovitrap index hits 64%
article.articleSummary: Macau recorded an ovitrap index of 63.9% in August, signaling elevated risk of mosquito-borne disease transmission. Health officials launched a door-to-door alert, targeting 30,000 residences, as part of a twice-yearly citywide effort to eliminate stagnant water; this campaign was expanded to districts with higher mosquito indices, dense populations, larger elderly populations, and concentrations of low-rise buildings. Intelligent bio-mosquito traps from the mainland are being tested at hospitals and other sites; deployment density and effectiveness are under evaluation. Officials stress an integrated approach with source reduction as the top priority; traps may supplement measures if crowding keeps numbers high in public areas. Residents are urged to clear stagnant water, install window screens, and use outdoor mosquito repellent; Macau hosts 200+ public locations offering shared repellent. Aedes albopictus carries dengue and chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: オビトラップ指数64%到達を受け、当局が戸別訪問による蚊警戒活動を開始
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症症例報告ではなく、蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・チクングニア）リスク上昇を受けた予防的な蚊対策キャンペーンの記事であるため、フルRRAの必要性は低いが季節性動向として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の感染症症例発生ではなく、オビトラップ指数上昇に基づく予防的な蚊駆除・監視活動を報じたもの。マカオは中国の特別行政区のため China (1814991) に統合。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 受甲流影响 上海杭州有学校班级要求居家隔离
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Affected by H1N1 influenza, some school classes in Shanghai and Hangzhou require home quarantine.
article.articleSummary: H1N1 influenza outbreaks trigger home quarantine in Shanghai and Hangzhou as schools reopen. Chinese media report infections among students in multiple primary, middle, and kindergarten classes; Shanghai schools placed entire classes under home isolation per disease-control guidance, and Hangzhou suspended a class for four days, with return on Sept 15. In Hangzhou, a class of 40+ students had about 10 with fever, roughly half diagnosed with influenza. Social media posts from Shanghai parents also note flu infections. National Acute Respiratory Infection sentinel surveillance shows influenza positivity rising since late July: Week 35 (Aug 24–30) at 17.7% and Week 36 (Aug 31–Sep 6) at 18.4%. Influenza A accounts for 67.1% and Influenza B 32.9%, with A/H1N1 subtype rising. Circulation is mid-level in southern provinces and inter-epidemic in northern provinces; positivity highest in ages 15–59.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1インフルエンザの影響で、上海・杭州の一部学校クラスが自宅隔離を要求
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1亜型）の学校内流行で一部クラスが自宅隔離となっているが、重症例や死亡の報告はなく、通常の季節性流行の範囲内とみられるため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 全国サーベイランスでインフルエンザ陽性率が上昇傾向（週35: 17.7%、週36: 18.4%）で、A型が67.1%（うちH1N1亜型増加）。学校再開時期の季節性流行と考えられ、重症化や死亡の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Menjelang World Rabies Day, Mirjawal Minta Masyarakat Waspadai Gigitan Hewan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of World Rabies Day, Mirjawal Urges the Public to Beware of Animal Bites.
article.articleSummary: Ahead of World Rabies Day on 28 September, public awareness in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, urged immediate care after animal bites or scratches that could transmit rabies. Speaking at Vetnovex 2026 (12–13 September 2026) at Gadjah Mada University, drh. Mirjawal, M.M., Chair of PDHI Jawa Barat V and a candidate for PB PDHI, emphasized rapid response as key to preventing fatal outcomes. Wounds should be washed with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes, then treated with antiseptic before seeking medical evaluation and rabies vaccination as indicated at a health facility. Rabies remains nearly always fatal once clinical symptoms appear. At‑risk animals include dogs, cats, monkeys, and others; infected animals may show sudden aggression, excessive drooling, difficulty swallowing, stumbling, paralysis, or may appear quiet or weak. The discussion underlines ongoing education on rabies risk and changes in animal behavior.

triage.headline_ja: 世界狂犬病デーを前に、ミルジャワル氏が市民に動物咬傷への注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 世界狂犬病デーに向けた一般的な啓発活動の記事であり、具体的な発生・アウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は世界狂犬病デーに合わせた啓発・予防教育の内容であり、具体的な感染症例や集団発生の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: На границах России усилили санитарный контроль из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sanitary checks at Russia's borders have been intensified due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to expand, with the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) reporting 6,942 confirmed cases and 3,349 deaths, and the outbreak spreading to a seventh nearby province as of early September. The World Health Organization characterized it as the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic in history, with transmission chains not fully understood. Russia has intensified border sanitary checks to screen travelers returning from epidemiologically high-risk countries; those with fever or other signs of illness are hospitalized. Rospotrebnadzor notes collaboration with Uganda, sharing diagnostic tools, including tests for the rare Bundibugyo strain, with African colleagues. Measures target points such as Moscow's Sheremetyevo International Airport. Officials emphasize rapid reporting and information sharing on all travelers entering the Russian Federation, including transit passengers. Published 14 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の影響でロシア国境の衛生管理が強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行はWHOが「史上最速の拡大」と評価する規模（6942症例、3349死亡）で第7州まで拡大しており、国際的な渡航対策（ロシアの国境検疫強化）も発生しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行拡大。ロシア・ウガンダは対応措置（国境検疫、診断協力）の文脈で言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Special measures to control communicable diseases amid rains
article.articleSummary: Andhra Pradesh stepped up measures to curb malaria, dengue, scrub typhus, typhoid and water- and food-borne diseases amid rains. As of August 30, malaria cases reached 7,895—up 27.9% from 6,172 last year—with rising incidence in Alluri Sitarama Raju, Polavaram and Vizianagaram. Second round of indoor residual spraying (IRS) to be completed in Alluri Sitarama Raju, Polavaram, Parvathipuram Manyam, and Eluru; additional rounds planned in vulnerable areas. Distribution of 599,367 mosquito nets underway. Dengue total 1,475 (up from 1,410); increases in YSR Kadapa (48→128) and Chittoor (73→112); declines in Kurnool (182→106) and Anakapalli (99→64). Scrub typhus 941 cases; Alluri Sitarama Raju (13→44) and Parvathipuram Manyam (15→47). Food-borne disease surges in Srikakulam (34→408); total 930 cases. Typhoid noted in Kurnool; fever testing urged, especially near forest areas. Dry Day Fridays to remove standing water; coordination across departments; app-monitored surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 降雨に伴う感染症対策として特別措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: アンドラプラデーシュ州で季節性のマラリア・デング熱・ツツガムシ病等が増加しているが、既知の風土病による例年の雨季増加であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域内対応が継続中で情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: アンドラプラデーシュ州の複数の媒介性感染症（マラリア、デング熱、ツツガムシ病）および食品・水系感染症の季節的増加に対し、州政府が室内残留噴霧や蚊帳配布などの対策を実施している記事。重症度（死亡数等）の情報がなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には至らない。

article.articleHeadline: Ca mắc tay chân miệng tăng 1,9 lần, lưu ý phòng bệnh khi trẻ trở lại trường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot and mouth disease cases up 1.9 times as children return to school.
article.articleSummary: Hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) in Hue City, Vietnam, has risen to more than 290 cases across 35 of 40 communes, 1.9 times higher than the same period in 2025, with no deaths reported yet. Although not yet a large outbreak, cases are widespread as schools resume. Authorities warn warm weather and crowding in nurseries and schools increase transmission risk, since the virus spreads via saliva, feces, contaminated toys and surfaces; undetected cases can seed further spread. Prevention centers on the '3 clean' approach: clean eating (fully cooked foods and clean drinking water), clean living (no shared towels or utensils), and clean hands (handwashing with soap). Schools should ensure water, soap, and handwashing facilities, daily health monitoring, and prompt reporting of fever or mouth ulcers; children with symptoms should stay home. Lam Dong reports nearly 8,000 dengue and HFMD cases with 3 deaths; urgent response underway.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の症例が1.9倍に増加、子どもの登校再開時の予防に注意
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の手足口病の増加であり死亡例もほぼ報告されていないが、Lam Dongでは死亡例が3件あり、感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: フエ市の手足口病症例増加とラムドン省のデング熱・手足口病症例（死亡3例含む）が報告されているが、大規模流行には至っていない。季節性・学校再開に伴う感染拡大への注意喚起が中心。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: 上海多个班级通知居家隔离 甲流影响学生健康
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Several classes in Shanghai notified to quarantine at home; H1N1 influenza affects students' health.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Shanghai and Hangzhou involves school-class quarantines as Influenza A(H3N2) dominates with Influenza B Victoria lineage co-circulating. Shanghai reports several classes ordered to quarantine at home after school started; Hangzhou’s third-grade class of around 40 students has about 10 fever cases, roughly half confirmed influenza, prompting a four-day pause (Sept 11–14) with return on Sept 15. Hangzhou Children’s Hospital notes rising pediatric influenza visits, with about one-third of pediatric influenza admissions in the current wave. Primary affected groups are kindergarten and lower-primary students. Vaccination is emphasized as the most cost-effective prevention; best timing is September–October, with 2–4 weeks to develop protective antibodies. China CDC’s 2026–2027 guidelines describe trivalent vaccines: inactivated vaccines for ages 6 months+, available in 0.25 mL or 0.5 mL doses; live attenuated vaccine for ages 3–17 at 0.2 mL per dose.

triage.headline_ja: 上海の複数のクラスが自宅隔離を通知、甲型インフルエンザが学生の健康に影響
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H3N2/Bビクトリア系統)による学校での通常の流行事象であり、通常の学級閉鎖・自宅隔離対応の範囲内で、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行パターンであり、重症例や死亡の報告はない。学校での学級閉鎖は季節性インフルエンザ対策としての一般的措置。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴのエボラ感染者7000人突破、ウイルスが新たな州へ拡大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in DR Congo surpass 7,000 as the virus spreads to new provinces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 7,000 cases, with 3,398 deaths, according to government data released on Sept 11. Confirmed infections reached 7,022 across seven provinces as the outbreak expands into new areas, including the northwestern South Ubangi province. On Sept 8, a 23-year-old man who died tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain, and contact tracing is under way. The patient had left eastern Congo’s South Kivu on July 10, spent time abroad, and re-entered the country, arriving in South Ubangi, signaling potential cross-border transmission and importation risks. Authorities had previously announced cases far from the outbreak’s center, indicating a widening geographic footprint. Ongoing surveillance and epidemiological investigations are being conducted to map transmission chains and contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者7000人突破、ウイルスが新たな州へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の感染者が7000人を超え死者3398人に達し、新たな州への拡大や国境を越えた移動による伝播リスクも確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 南キブ州から出国し他国滞在後に南ウバンギ州へ再入国した患者がBundibugyo株陽性と判明しており、国境を越えた伝播・輸入例のリスクが指摘されている。既に7州に拡大しており、致死率も高い深刻な事例。

article.articleHeadline: Попова: Россия усилила санитарный контроль на границе из-за риска Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Popova: Russia Tightens Border Sanitary Controls Over Ebola Risk.
article.articleSummary: Russia tightens border sanitary-quarantine controls over Ebola risk as border services screen arrivals to the country, including transit passengers from risk regions. Those with fever or other symptoms are hospitalized to prevent possible spread of Ebola within Russia. Rospotrebnadzor head Anna Popova noted that Russian specialists have provided early assistance to Uganda, given Uganda’s border with the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an Ebola outbreak has been reported. Russia has also supplied African partners with domestic diagnostic test systems for Ebola, including tests for the rare Bundibugyo strain. Popova said such technologies are provided to interested friendly states. Earlier, Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova stated there have been no Ebola cases among Russians in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ポポワ氏：ロシア、エボラのリスクを受けて国境の衛生管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の発生を受け、ロシアが国境衛生管理を強化するなど国際的な対応が進んでおり、IHR基準の複数（重大性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの国境管理強化に焦点を当てているが、感染源はDRCのエボラ流行であるため、DRCを発生地域として検証。ウガンダはDRCと国境を接するが記事の主題としての感染発生国ではないため対象外。ロシアも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор усилил санитарный контроль на границе из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor stepped up sanitary control at the border due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 September 2026, Russia has intensified border sanitary control due to Ebola risks. Rospotrebnadzor head Anna Popova told RIA Novosti that border screening has been strengthened, with rapid information sharing on all arriving citizens, including transit passengers from epidemiologically risky countries. Individuals with fever or other signs of illness are hospitalized to prevent spread. The measures follow United Nations assessments of a rapidly expanding Ebola outbreak. In early August, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reached 3,748, highlighting ongoing regional transmission risk. The system aims to minimize cross-border transmission by early detection and isolation at entry points.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾール、エボラ出血熱の影響で国境の衛生管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大（症例数3,748）を受け、国際的な対応（ロシアの国境管理強化）が取られており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ拡大とそれに伴うロシアの国境対策強化であり、実際の感染発生国はDRCのみ。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: '김승원 로비 의혹' 코로나19 치료제, 햄스터 사망 숨기고 환자 93명에 투약
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Kim Seung-won's lobbying allegations' COVID-19 treatment concealed hamster deaths and was administered to 93 patients.
article.articleSummary: GenenCell's COVID-19 therapeutic ES16001, originally developed as a herpes zoster candidate, was administered in Korea to 93 patients during a 2022 Phase 2 trial after an Indian Phase 2 with 60 mild-to-moderate cases. Nonclinical hamster studies reportedly showed toxicity: high-dose death (1/5) with reflux and hematemesis, and surviving animals with marked pulmonary hyperplasia; these results were allegedly omitted from the Phase 2 submission to MFDS. Expedited review attempts followed: broker Yang Mo pressed candidate Kim Seung-won for swift approval, and Kim, then Justice Minister nominee, allegedly asked MFDS officials to monitor GenenCell favorably; Phase 2 approval occurred on Oct 26, 2021. A 1st‑court ruling found Professor Kang Mo violated pharmaceutical law by directing deletion of the unfavorable hamster data. Separate allegations included a 32 billion won government grant-skimming and 5 billion won stock manipulation. MFDS notes no SUSAR reported, but whether trial participants were adequately informed remains unclear.

triage.headline_ja: 『キム・スンウォン氏ロビー疑惑』の新型コロナ治療薬、ハムスター死亡データを隠蔽し患者93人に投与
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新型コロナ治療薬の臨床試験データ改ざん・承認プロセスを巡る政治的スキャンダルであり、感染症の発生・拡大に関する内容ではないため。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症アウトブレイクではなく、韓国の製薬会社GenenCellによる新型コロナ治療薬候補ES16001の臨床試験不正・データ隠蔽と規制当局への政治的圧力疑惑に関する報道。インドは初期の第2相試験実施地として言及されているのみで、疾病発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。公衆衛生上のシグナルではなく、医薬品規制・政治スキャンダルとして扱うべき案件。

article.articleHeadline: 共建和谐平安家园 绵阳启动狂犬病防控行动试点工作_绵阳新闻网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jointly Building a Harmonious and Safe Homeland: Mianyang Launches Rabies Prevention and Control Pilot Program
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention and control pilot, 'Dog Wind-Chime – Dog Immunization, Human Safety', launched in Jiangyou, Mianyang, Sichuan. Led by the Mianyang Bureau of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and the Animal Epidemic Prevention and Control Center, and hosted by Jiangyou Agriculture and Rural Affairs Bureau, the event inaugurates a province-wide pilot in Mianyang. The program targets source control and proactive prevention. Jiangyou designated 7 pet clinics as 'Animal Rabies Immunization Points' and established 13 rural 'Immunization Service Teams', forming an urban fixed vaccination and rural mobile immunization network for dogs. A civil dog-ownership pledge was issued; services included vaccination, veterinary exams, provision of dog-raising supplies, rabies prevention education, dog-bite emergency guidance, and related inquiries. In 2026, the provincial center continues the 'Dog Wind-Chime' pilot; Jiangyou is one of three pilot sites. Ongoing work covers dog population surveys, centralized immunization, and routine public awareness to sustain dog vaccination and human–dog harmony.

triage.headline_ja: 共に調和と安全な故郷を築く 綿陽が狂犬病予防対策のパイロットプログラムを開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は狂犬病の発生報告ではなく、犬の予防接種を推進する行政主導の予防対策プログラムの開始を伝える内容であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規感染事例を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の発生・症例報告ではなく、四川省綿陽市江油における犬の予防接種・啓発活動を中心とした行政主導の予防プログラムの紹介記事である。感染症イベントとしてのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: এক ডোজ়েই কাজ, সামনের বছরই বাজারে ডেঙ্গির টিকা?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One dose works; dengue vaccine set to hit the market as early as next year?
article.articleSummary: As of 14 September 2026, in Kolkata, ICAR/ICMR Director General Rajiv Bahl said India’s domestically developed tetravalent dengue vaccine, a single-dose live-attenuated formulation from ICMR and Panacea Biotec, could reach the market by August–September 2027, contingent on Phase III results and regulatory clearance. Phase II showed promising efficacy; Phase III began in 2024 at 19 centers with 10,335 participants and is ongoing. If the Phase III report is favorable and CDSCO approves, a 2027 launch ahead of the dengue season is possible. Separately, Takeda’s Qdenga received CDSCO approval on 21 July 2026 for ages 4–60 with a two-dose, 3-month schedule, but has not yet rolled out in the current season due to licensing, manufacturing, quality checks, and distribution logistics. The piece notes steps for local production of a foreign vaccine amid India’s dengue burden (roughly 200,000–300,000 cases annually, hundreds of deaths) and El Niño-driven risk.

triage.headline_ja: 1回接種で効果あり、来年にはデング熱ワクチンが市場に登場？
triage.triage_reason: デング熱ワクチンの開発・承認状況に関する報道であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発・承認の進捗に関する内容であり、デング熱の流行拡大や異常事態を報じるものではない。インドの年間デング症例数（20-30万件）は既知の風土病負担として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết gia tăng, những lầm tưởng có thể khiến người bệnh trả giá đắt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever on the rise, misconceptions could cost patients dearly.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreaks in Vietnam escalate in 2026’s first eight months, with 78,338 cases and 13 deaths. The south remains hardest hit: Ho Chi Minh City reports 31,032 cases; Dong Nai 11,519 (6 deaths); and Tay Ninh 8,437 (1 death). In the north, Hanoi shows transmission across 117 of 126 wards, totaling 2,382 cases. Dak Lak and Gia Lai recorded the year’s first fatalities—a young adult and an older person with type 2 diabetes—highlighting risk among those with comorbidities. Dengue can progress rapidly to dengue shock syndrome, liver and kidney failure, myocarditis, or encephalitis, especially around days 3–7, and a fever drop is not a safety signal. There is no specific antiviral treatment; prevention relies on mosquito control, elimination of breeding sites, personal protection, and vaccination as a supplemental measure, plus early diagnosis and monitoring. 2025 national cases: over 181,000 with 43 deaths; early 2026 near 60,000 cases, almost triple the prior period.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が増加、誤解が患者に高い代償を払わせる可能性
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで2026年初め8か月に78,338症例・13死亡が報告され、脳炎など重篤合併症も見られるため、公衆衛生上の影響と流行しやすさの観点からフルリスク評価に進める必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで季節的に流行する既知の疾患だが、2026年の症例数は前年同期比で大幅増加し、重症合併症（脳炎、心筋炎、多臓器不全）や死亡例も複数報告されているため、監視強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор усилил контроль на границе РФ из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor tightens border controls at Russia's border due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Russia tightens border controls over Ebola spread in Africa, with border guards relaying passenger data to sanitary services and directing anyone with fever or health deterioration to a hospital. Rospotrebnadzor chief Anna Popova says the system aims to eliminate any risk. The agency also backs infection response in Africa, assisting Uganda near the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola remains most challenging. Russia has supplied African colleagues with diagnostic tests capable of detecting the virus, including the rare Bundibugyo strain. In total, Moscow previously delivered more than 7,500 test systems to the DRC, Republic of Congo, and Uganda, developed in four days, with Russian experts joining the WHO Emergency Committee. The tests can identify infection before symptoms, enabling faster isolation of patients and containment in ongoing outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督局、エボラ流行を受けロシア国境の管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱流行を受け、ロシアが国境管理を強化するなど国際的な懸念・対応が生じており、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの国境管理強化とアフリカ（DRC・ウガンダ）への支援体制に焦点を当てているが、実際の流行地はDRCであり、ウガンダは支援対象国として言及されているのみで対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。ロシア国内での症例発生は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: IOM: Multi-Country Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease Outbreak - Situation Report No. 17 (31 August to 6 September 2026)
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease (BVD) outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is ongoing, with Situation Report No. 17 covering Aug 31–Sept 6, 2026. As of Sept 1, 2026, over 6,200 confirmed BVD cases and more than 3,000 deaths have been reported. Ituri and North Kivu remain heavily affected; ongoing transmission is reported in Haut-Uélé and Bas-Uélé near the CAR border, signaling cross-border risk to Uganda, Tanzania and other countries. The response includes mass health screenings (30,560,048 at points of entry/points of control), support to 230 PoEs/PoCs, and RCCE reach to 26,500,916 individuals. More than 50 IOM-managed IDP sites in Ituri and North Kivu are impacted by the outbreak amid WASH, health, and shelter vulnerabilities. 171 fatalities have been intercepted at PoCs. Preparedness and IPC, border surveillance, and pre-positioning are emphasized for cross-border protection, with Priority 1a (DRC, Uganda) and 1b (Burundi, Rwanda, South Sudan) and Priority 2 (Angola, CAR, Ethiopia, Kenya, Republic of the Congo, Tanzania, Zambia) in focus.

triage.headline_ja: IOM: 多国間ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス病アウトブレイク状況報告書 No.17（2026年8月31日〜9月6日）
triage.triage_reason: DRCで6,200例超・3,000人超の死亡が報告される大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが継続しており、国境地域での伝播により周辺国への越境リスクが指摘されている。IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、オー・ウエレ州、バ・ウエレ州）での実際のアウトブレイクを記述。Zambia等他国はPriority 2として越境予防対応の対象国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: На границах РФ усилили санитарный контроль из-за опасного заболевания: вот о чём речь
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sanitary checks at Russia's borders have been stepped up due to a dangerous disease: here's what it's about.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk prompts intensified sanitary checks at Russia's borders, per Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor. Any traveler entering Russia from epidemiologically high-risk countries undergoes screening; border service personnel relay arrival data, and individuals with fever or health deterioration are hospitalized. The move follows U.S. assessments that the Ebola outbreak could become the deadliest in history. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak is linked to a virus transmitted from animals. Infectious-disease specialist Pozdnyakov notes Ebola is not transmitted via airborne routes. The article emphasizes rapid border screening, including transit travelers, and hospital transfer for symptomatic entrants; no specific case or death counts are provided. The policy aims to curb cross-border spread of Ebola while authorities monitor evolving outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な病気のためロシア国境で衛生検査が強化されている：その内容とは
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が「史上最悪になり得る」とする米国の評価を受け、ロシアが国境検疫を強化しており、IHR基準（深刻性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題であるエボラ流行はコンゴ民主共和国で発生しており、ロシア・米国は対応措置（国境検疫強化・リスク評価）の文脈で言及されているのみのため、verified_locationsからは除外した。具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор усилил санитарный контроль на границах из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor Strengthened Sanitary Control at Borders Due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 14 September 2026, Russia's Rospotrebnadzor tightened sanitary border control amid Ebola spread. Head Anna Popova said border personnel rapidly implemented measures, closely monitoring arrivals and hospitalizing anyone with fever or other symptoms. Specialists from Rospotrebnadzor assist Uganda, which borders the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where Ebola remains most severe, and Russian diagnostic test systems are being provided, including detection of the rare Bundibugyo strain. Russia also shares domestically developed diagnostics with friendly states. The article notes vaccine issues: the German Ervebo vaccine does not protect against Bundibugyo, and a Russian analogue is not used due to policy. UN OCHA representative Julien Harnais reported rapid Ebola growth in the DRC, with about half of roughly 2,500 deaths in the last 20 days, in a region afflicted by a 30-year armed conflict and high humanitarian needs.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁、エボラ出血熱の影響で国境での衛生管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（まれなブンディブギョ株）が急速に拡大し、直近20日で約1250人が死亡するなど深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、周辺国への越境リスクや国際的な対応（ロシアの国境管理強化、UN OCHAの関与）も見られるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの国境管理強化を主題としているが、根本的な感染症イベントはDRCでのエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株、既存ワクチン非対応）。ウガンダ・ロシア・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの急速な感染拡大と高い死亡率、武力紛争下の人道状況から重大なシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Sumsel siapkan langkah antisipasi lonjakan kasus DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Sumatra Health Office prepares anticipatory measures for a surge in dengue fever cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in South Sumatra, Indonesia is forecast to surge during the rainy season October 2026–January 2027. Palembang records the highest cases (744 as of Sep 9, 2026), followed by Muara Enim (533), Ogan Ilir (253), Banyuasin (231), and Musi Banyuasin (215). From January–September 9, 2026, total dengue cases reach 2,841 with 19 deaths (case fatality rate 0.67%), above the target CFR of <0.4%. Authorities will intensify vector control (PSN 3M Plus), distribute larvicides and insecticides, and boost health facility readiness and public education via social media and print. Prevention should start August–September 2026 to reduce Aedes populations before peak transmission, considering warmer temperatures and rainfall that elevate mosquito lifecycles. El Niño-related conditions are linked to the surge; risks include chikungunya and malaria. Early treatment is emphasized to prevent progression to Dengue Shock Syndrome.

triage.headline_ja: 南スマトラ保健局、デング熱症例急増に備え対策を準備
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱の予防的対応に関する記事だが、致死率(0.67%)が目標値(<0.4%)を超過しており、雨季にかけての症例増加が見込まれるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 毎年発生する季節性デング熱の予防態勢に関する記事。エルニーニョの影響で雨季（2026年10月〜2027年1月）に症例増加が予測されており、チクングニアやマラリアのリスクも言及されているが、いずれも既知の季節性パターンの範囲内。現地当局による事前対策（ベクター駆除、教育活動）が主体で外部支援の必要性は示されていない。
