Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Swine flu cases rise to 22 in Bareilly amid intensified health surveillance
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (influenza A H1N1) cases in Bareilly reached 22 after two new positives reported on Saturday, prompting stepped-up surveillance and contact tracing. The 84-year-old Janakpuri, Rajendranagar resident is hospitalized at a private medical college, with officials monitoring his close contacts and providing treatment as needed. The second patient, a 47-year-old Mahanagar resident who has lived in Lucknow since February, appears on Bareilly's portal due to an Aadhaar address; he has been advised to remain in home isolation in Lucknow. None of the 22 patients reported recent travel, complicating source identification. Authorities suspect infections may relate to movement to Delhi and Noida in the National Capital Region, with exposures possible in crowded markets, hospitals, public transport, or other dense settings. Expanded surveillance and public advisory emphasize hand hygiene and avoiding nose/mouth contact.

triage.headline_ja: バレイリーで豚インフルエンザ症例が22人に増加、保健当局が監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州で季節性・地域流行的なH1N1豚インフルエンザの症例増加であり、重症度・異常性ともに低く、国際的拡大リスクも認められないため。
triage.notes: H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）はインドで季節性に発生する既知の疾患であり、地元保健当局によるルーティンなサーベイランスと接触者追跡が行われている。感染源不明の地域内感染が疑われるが、重篤例や死亡例の報告はなく、フルリスク評価の対象とする根拠は乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор усилил санконтроль на границе из-за лихорадки Эболы - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor intensified border sanitary control due to Ebola virus disease - News on Vesti.ru.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-14, Russia's Rospotrebnadzor intensified border sanitary control to mitigate Ebola virus disease (EVD) import risk. Border checkpoints now perform enhanced screening of arrivals and rapidly share data on all travellers, including transit passengers from regions with unfavourable epidemiological situations. Individuals with fever or symptoms are immediately hospitalized, with preventive measures aimed at fully preventing domestic transmission. Russian experts are assisting Uganda amid an Ebola outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo, having developed detection test systems for Ebola, including the Bundibugyo strain, and transferring these capabilities to African partners. Russia continues to provide such technologies to interested friendly countries to bolster regional surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾール、エボラ出血熱を理由に国境衛生管理を強化 - Vesti.ruニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ出血熱がウガンダで発生し、ロシアが国境検疫を強化するなど国際的対応が進行しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアの国境検疫強化だが、根本原因はDRC由来のエボラ出血熱がウガンダに拡大している事案。ウガンダ・ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでの具体的な症例数・致死率等の詳細情報は本記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Chennai Latest News Today on September 14th, 2026: CM Vijay Sworn In, Bypoll Buzz & Dengue Alert
article.articleSummary: Chennai reports a rise in dengue and fever cases as of 14 September 2026, with Adyar, Anna Nagar, and Valasaravakkam identified as hotspots. Health officials caution residents, but the article provides no case counts, fatalities, or laboratory confirmation details. No infection source or imported/exported case information is given. Public advisories urge preventive measures to curb mosquito breeding and transmission amid ongoing urban health management in Tamil Nadu’s capital. The report centers on the dengue uptick within Chennai and its suburbs, without detailing specific outbreak parameters, while other September 14 developments are noted separately.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年9月14日のチェンナイ最新ニュース：新CM就任、補欠選挙の話題、そしてデング熱警報
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の増加とホットスポットが報告されているが、症例数や死亡者数などの詳細情報が欠如しており、季節性流行の範囲内か判断できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はチェンナイ（タミル・ナードゥ州）における季節性の毎年報告される疾患であり、本記事は具体的な症例数や重症度データを提供していない。地元メディアの一般ニュース記事の一部として扱われており、公衆衛生上の危機を示す明確な兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Россия усилила контроль на границах из-за вспышки вируса Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia strengthened border controls due to an Ebola virus outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 September 2026, Russia strengthened sanitary border controls to prevent entry of the Ebola virus from epidemiologically dangerous countries. Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor, said border screening is intensified, with travelers displaying fever or other signs of illness promptly hospitalized. Border guards were commended for rapid response and for transmitting information about all arrivals, including transit from risk countries. Russian specialists have been assisting Uganda, which borders the Democratic Republic of Congo, where an Ebola outbreak is ongoing. The agency has developed diagnostic test systems for Ebola, including the Bundibugyo strain, and shared this capability with African colleagues. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus described the Congo outbreak as the fastest-growing in history.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、エボラウイルスの流行を受けて国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が「史上最速の拡大」と評したコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行を受け、ロシアが国境管理を強化するなど国際的な波及・渡航制限が生じており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRussiaとUgandaが含まれているが、記事の主題となる実際のエボラ出血熱流行地はDRCのみ。Russiaは対応措置を取る側、Ugandaは近隣国として支援を受けている立場であり、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外した。WHO事務局長による『史上最速の流行』との発言は極めて重大な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: 上海杭州開學不久爆流感　多校全班居家隔離
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza outbreak shortly after the school term began in Shanghai and Hangzhou; many schools put entire classes under home quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Influenza outbreak emerges in Shanghai and Hangzhou shortly after the new school term began. As of 2026-09-14, pediatric flu visits have risen, with Shanghai parents reporting immediate full-class home quarantines after early notices. In Hangzhou, a third-grade class with over 10 feverish students among about 40 prompted class suspension from Fri 11 Sept to Mon 14 Sept, with re-opening on Tue 15 Sept. Hangzhou’s Chaohui Campus of the Hangzhou Women and Children’s Medical Group reports a marked rise in pediatric infectious-disease cases and hospitalizations; influenza admissions now occupy about one-third of pediatric beds, with around 10 children hospitalized daily. The dominant circulating strains are influenza A(H3N2) co-circulating with influenza B Victoria lineage; kindergarten and lower-grade primary students are most affected. Vaccination against the season’s flu vaccine is highlighted as the most cost-effective preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: 上海・杭州で新学期開始直後にインフルエンザ流行、複数校で学級ごと自宅隔離
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H3N2/B型ビクトリア系統）による学校での集団感染で、入院増加や学級閉鎖が見られるが、季節性疾患としては通常範囲内であり異常性・国際拡大リスクは低い。地方メディア報道のみで社会的関心の広がりは限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 上海・杭州の小児科でインフルエンザ関連入院が増加し、学級閉鎖措置がとられているが、季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行パターンであり、国レベルでの特別対応や国際的注目の記載はない。地方紙報道のため、続報の有無を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Teh Niraga UNJA: inovasi antioksidan dan antivirus dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNJA Niraga Tea: Antioxidant and Dengue Antiviral Innovation
article.articleSummary: UNJA student team from Universitas Jambi has secured 2026 PKM-RE funding from Dirjen Dikti. The five-member, cross-disciplinary group—led by Muhammad Faris Rizqullah (Medicine, 2023) and including Nurul Fathiah Azzahra (Medicine, 2023), Anjeli Bismi Arsy (Biology, 2024), Kireina Nurfadhillah (Medicine, 2024), and Arum Kinasih Ramadhani (Pharmacy, 2024)—will develop Teh Niraga, a polyherbal tea from corn silk and red onion skin waste, combined with Phyllanthus niruri (meniran) and stevia. It targets antioxidant activity and dengue virus antiviral properties. In vitro assays and in silico simulations will assess molecular interactions with dengue proteins. The team aims to reduce dengue burden in Indonesia, including Jambi, and advance toward data generation for potential participation in PIMNAS in October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: UNJA ニラガ茶：抗酸化・抗デング抗ウイルスのイノベーション
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学生研究プロジェクトの資金獲得に関する紹介であり、実際の感染症発生・流行に関する情報ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は大学生による研究開発（デング熱抗ウイルス茶の開発）に関する内容であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではないため対象国の発生地域には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: На границах России усилили контроль из-за риска завоза смертельного вируса: кого сразу отправляют в больницу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Border controls at Russia's borders have been tightened due to the risk of importing a deadly virus: who is sent to the hospital immediately.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk prompts tightened sanitary controls at Russia's borders, with border guards coordinating with Rospotrebnadzor. Russian authorities screen arriving travelers, including transit passengers from risk countries; anyone with fever or signs of illness is hospitalized as part of enhanced border measures. Ebola is an acute viral disease with mortality estimated at 25%–90%, transmitted via blood and other body fluids and contaminated objects; symptoms appear abruptly—fever, weakness, muscle and joint pains, sore throat—followed by vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding. Russia’s public-health institutes have aided colleagues fighting the fever near Uganda, which borders the DRC, by providing domestic diagnostic tests, including for the rare Bundibugyo strain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus described the Congo outbreak as the fastest in history, with transmission chains still unknown. The DRC’s National Institute of Public Health reported 6,942 confirmed cases and 3,349 deaths across seven of 26 provinces.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア国境で致死性ウイルス侵入リスクによる検疫強化：誰が即座に入院させられるのか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速とされるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（症例6,942件、死亡3,349人）が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの国境管理強化がテーマだが、主要な感染症イベントはDRCで発生しているエボラ流行。ウガンダは国境を接する文脈で言及されているが、症例・死亡数はDRC国立公衆衛生研究所の報告に基づくためDRCのみを発生地域として確定。ロシア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: На границах России усилили контроль из‑за угрозы Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia Tightens Border Controls Over Ebola Threat
article.articleSummary: Russia tightens sanitary border controls amid Ebola risk, with border guards screening all travelers entering Russia (including transit) and hospitalizing anyone with fever or other symptoms to minimize national exposure. Rospotrebnadzor says the system aims to exclude risks and notes its experts have assisted Uganda, a country bordering the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), the outbreak’s hardest-hit area, by providing Ebola diagnostic test systems that include the rare Bundibugyo strain. African colleagues have also received these tools. Separately, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the DRC Ebola outbreak is the fastest-spreading in history, with transmission chains not fully understood. The DRC’s National Institute of Public Health reports 6,942 confirmed cases and 3,349 deaths across seven of 26 provinces as of 2026-09-14.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、エボラ熱の脅威で国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が「史上最速の拡大」と警告するDRCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（7州で確認症例6,942例、死亡3,349例）に関連し、ロシアが国境検疫を強化するなど国際的波及が確認されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ロシアとウガンダは発生地域として記載されているが、記事内容ではDRCが唯一の実際の発生国。ロシアは国境管理強化の実施国、ウガンダは診断キット提供先（隣国支援）として言及されているのみで、両国での症例発生は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt, nôn bé 1 tháng tuổi sốc nhiễm trùng, suy đa tạng nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever and vomiting in a 1-month-old baby; septic shock and multi-organ failure in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: On 14 September 2026, a 50‑day‑old infant from A Dơi commune, Quảng Trị Province, Vietnam, presented with fever, vomiting and frequent diarrhea, progressing to septic shock and multi‑organ failure due to a gastrointestinal infection. Dehydrated and in shock on transfer from Huong Hoa General Hospital to Quang Tri General Hospital, the child developed acute respiratory distress, liver and kidney dysfunction, electrolyte disturbances and coagulopathy. An urgent pediatric intensive care response included endotracheal intubation, mechanical ventilation, fluid resuscitation, vasopressors and early antibiotics, with 24/7 monitoring of vitals, urine output and labs. After aggressive resuscitation, infection was controlled and organ functions gradually recovered; vasopressors were tapered and the infant breathed spontaneously. After two weeks of treatment, the child was fully recovered with no sequelae and discharged. The report urges prompt medical evaluation for febrile, vomiting or diarrheal symptoms in infants under 3 months.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱・嘔吐の生後1か月の乳児、敗血症性ショックと多臓器不全で危篤
triage.triage_reason: 単一の乳児症例で、消化管感染による敗血症性ショックからの回復例であり、公衆衛生上の異常性や集団発生の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 単発の個別症例報告であり、病原体不明かつ集団感染の証拠なし。乳幼児への一般的な受診喚起を目的とした記事と判断。

article.articleHeadline: E. coli pada Ayam Bumbu Kuning MBG Picu Keracunan 161 Siswa di Toraja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: E. coli in MBG's Turmeric-Spiced Chicken Triggers Food Poisoning Among 161 Students in Toraja
article.articleSummary: E. coli contamination in yellow-spiced chicken served under the Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program sparked a food-poisoning outbreak among 161 students in Makale, Tana Toraja, South Sulawesi, Indonesia. The affected pupils attend SMPN 1/2 Makale and SDN 5/9 Tana Toraja, with gastrointestinal symptoms including diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain. BBPOM Makassar laboratory results confirmed Escherichia coli in the yellow chicken samples: 5.7 × 10^3 CFU/g for samples consumed by middle-school students and 5.3 × 10^3 CFU/g for those consumed by elementary students. Other MBG foods (white rice, tempe mendoan, vegetables, tilapia) tested negative for microbiological hazards and chemical contaminants; melon samples were negative for major pathogens but contained trace nitrite, likely naturally occurring. Dinas Kesehatan Toraja cites these findings as part of tracing the outbreak source. The report is dated 14 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: MBGの黄色いスパイスチキンから大腸菌検出、トラジャで生徒161人が食中毒
triage.triage_reason: 単一の給食プログラムに起因する食中毒事案で、原因も特定・対応中であり国際的拡大や渡航制限リスクは低いが、政府プログラムの食品安全問題として今後の展開を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 国家的な無償給食プログラム（MBG）に関連する食中毒事案であり、政府機関（BBPOM、Dinas Kesehatan）が原因究明を実施済み。161名の症例は消化器症状で重篤ではなく、局所的な食品汚染事案として収束している模様。

article.articleHeadline: 【微博精粹】豆包不小心把中国得梅毒大疮人数曝光了
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Weibo Highlights: Doubao accidentally revealed the number of syphilis cases in China.
article.articleSummary: China’s syphilis cases were disclosed as 570,000 in 2024 and 640,000 in 2025 in a Weibo Highlights thread attributed to user Doubao, who leaked national figures to draw attention. Separately, a post notes Japan’s syphilis incidence rising twelvefold, with about 15,000 diagnosed annually. The exchanges underscore rising sexually transmitted infection activity in East Asia, though the posts provide no laboratory data or official verification. No infection sources or vaccination context are given. The content emphasizes rough counts and the leak’s traffic-seeking motive rather than epidemiological analysis. No clinical details or case breakdown are provided. It remains a social-media aggregation rather than a public-health briefing. Keywords: syphilis; China; Japan; outbreak data; social-media disclosure.

triage.headline_ja: 【微博まとめ】Doubaoがうっかり中国の梅毒患者数を暴露
triage.triage_reason: SNS上の噂・非公式リーク情報であり、公式サーベイランスデータや臨床的詳細を欠く。梅毒自体も既知の性感染症で急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態とは言えない。
triage.notes: 本記事はWeiboのSNS投稿を基にした非公式なリーク情報であり、公的機関による確認や検査データが伴わない。日本のデータにも言及があるが日本は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国は対象国だが、情報の信頼性が低くDISMISS判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Hai trẻ em ở Gia Lai tử vong vì bệnh dại trong một tuần
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two children in Gia Lai died of rabies within a week.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 September 2026, Gia Lai Province, Vietnam, has recorded five rabies deaths in 2026. Two children died within a week, both linked to dog or cat exposures and lacking post‑exposure vaccination. A 6‑year‑old boy, K.S. of Doan Ket O-Kly village, Ia Tôr commune, developed rabies symptoms after prior dog bites and died on 7 September. A 4‑year‑old girl, K.P.T. of Ia Kenh village, Gao commune, began fever on 6 September and died on 9 September; she had recently handled three adopted stray kittens, two of which fell ill and died within a week. Twenty people in Gao (19 relatives and one healthcare worker) had direct exposure and were unvaccinated. Authorities urge immediate wound cleansing, vaccination, and rabies immunoglobulin when indicated, and warn against folk remedies. Separately, a man died in June after a stray dog bite despite vaccination, underscoring ongoing risk.

triage.headline_ja: ザ・ライ省で1週間に子ども2人が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ジャライ省で狂犬病により子ども2人を含む死亡例が相次ぎ、曝露後未接種者が多数存在するなど重症度・曝露継続性が高く、当局・報道の関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで既知の風土病だが、今回は子ども2名を含む死亡例の集中発生と、曝露後予防未実施者20名の存在が報告されており、地域の狂犬病対策強化の必要性を示す事例。人-人感染はなく国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Исключить риски: на границах РФ усилили санитарный контроль из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eliminate Risks: Russia Tightens Border Sanitary Controls Due to Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-14, Russia tightens border sanitary controls over Ebola risk. Border screening is intensified for travelers from Ebola-affected regions, with hospitalization for those showing fever or other symptoms. Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor, praised border service staff for rapid action and information sharing on arriving passengers, including transit travellers. Rospotrebnadzor has assisted Africa's Ebola response, aiding Uganda—which borders the Democratic Republic of Congo—and supplying diagnostic tests for the disease, including the rare Bundibugyo strain. The World Health Organization reported 796 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and on May 17 declared the Congo-Uganda outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. The new measures aim to prevent importation and cross-border transmission through enhanced screening and hospital referral for symptomatic travelers.

triage.headline_ja: リスクを排除:ロシア、エボラ出血熱を理由に国境衛生管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC宣言したコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（796人死亡）に関連し、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアの国境管理強化だが、根本的な感染症イベントはDRCで発生しているエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（WHO PHEIC宣言済み）。ウガンダも関連するが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ロシアも対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: На границах России усилили санитарный контроль из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia Tightens Border Health Checks Over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Russia tightened border health checks due to Ebola import risk as of 14 September 2026. Rospotrebnadzor head Anna Popova said border guards will screen arrivals for fever or other illness signs, with hospitalization for suspected cases to prevent transmission. The agency is also aiding Uganda’s Ebola response—Uganda borders the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and has been hard-hit by Ebola—by supplying diagnostic tests, including for the rare Bundibugyo strain. The move follows WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus’ warning in early September that the DRC Ebola outbreak is the fastest-growing in history with unknown transmission chains. The DRC’s National Institute of Public Health reported 6,942 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,349 deaths, with the outbreak now affecting seven of 26 provinces. Emphasis remains on border screening, rapid isolation, and cross-border cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行を受けロシアが国境での衛生検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行はWHO事務局長が「史上最速の拡大」と警告するほど深刻で、確定症例6,942例・死亡3,349例、26州中7州に拡大しており、ロシアが越境リスクを理由に国境検疫を強化するなど国際的な波及・対応が生じている。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの国境対策とウガンダへの支援について述べているが、感染発生の主体はDRCであるため対象国としてはDRCのみを採用。ウガンダ・ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: एंटीजन किट में पॉजिटिव तो एलाइजा में निगेटिव क्यों? भागलपुर JLNMCH व निजी लैब की डेंगू रिपोर्ट में बड़ा अंतर - bhagalpur dengue test discrepancy private vs jlnmch reports
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why is the antigen kit positive but ELISA negative? A big discrepancy in dengue reports between Bhagalpur's JLNMCH and private labs - Bhagalpur dengue test discrepancy: private vs JLNMCH reports.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 September 2026, seven dengue patients in Bhagalpur were admitted to JLNMCH after private labs reported dengue-positive results, but subsequent government ELISA tests at the hospital were negative, and all seven were discharged. The discrepancy arises because private labs commonly use antigen rapid card kits and CBC, which can flag dengue if platelet counts fall—even though CBC is not a definitive confirmatory test. Government standards consider ELISA as the most authentic diagnostic method. Experts note delayed hospital presentation: patients often seek private testing after 3–4 days of illness and reach the hospital after 5–7 days, by which time the virus in blood wanes and antibodies rise, yielding negative ELISA results. Symptoms include high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint pain, vomiting, and poor appetite. Clinicians advise early ELISA testing within 2–3 days of symptom onset for timely, accurate diagnosis and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 抗原キットは陽性なのにELISAは陰性なのはなぜ？バガルプルのJLNMCHと民間検査機関のデング熱検査結果に大きな相違
triage.triage_reason: 検査方法の違いによる診断上の議論であり、デング熱自体の異常な流行や重篤な公衆衛生事象を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は7名の患者が検査結果の相違により退院した事例を報告しており、デング熱の流行拡大や重症化を示すものではない。診断精度に関する啓発的内容。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 多地班级紧急停课、隔离！疾控提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency class suspensions and isolation in many places! CDC reminds.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity rises as schools reopen in Hangzhou and Shanghai. In Hangzhou, one class of 40+ students reported about 10 with fever; roughly half diagnosed influenza, prompting a Sept 11–14 class suspension and return Sept 15. Shanghai also reported near-simultaneous class-wide home isolation and many sick leaves, with parents noting influenza A (H1N1) concerns. National surveillance (Aug 31–Sep 6) shows influenza-like illness at 3.8% of ED visits; among 216 respiratory sentinel hospitals, influenza virus positivity in EDs reached 18.4% (top pathogen); hospitalized influenza positivity 7.5%. Current wave mainly involves influenza B Victoria lineage and influenza A(H3N2), with A(H3N2) rising; southern provinces mid-level, north at seasonal. Vaccination remains the most effective prevention: best window Sep–Oct, 2–4 weeks to protection; children 6 months+ and household contacts of infants should be vaccinated; masking, ventilation, hand hygiene; isolate during illness and delay return until recovered, even if previously infected.

triage.headline_ja: 多地の学級で緊急休校・隔離措置！疾病予防管理センターが注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（A型H3N2上昇、B型Victoria系統）による学級閉鎖等が報告されているが、国家サーベイランスの範囲内の季節変動であり、異常性や重篤性の明確な証拠はない。
triage.notes: 杭州・上海での学級閉鎖・隔離は季節性インフルエンザ流行期の通常対応。国家サーベイランスデータ（ILI 3.8%、インフル陽性率18.4%）は例年の流行水準内であり、重症度・死亡例の情報はなし。続報でH3N2の変異や重症化傾向がないか注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Đầu năm học, cảnh báo gia tăng bệnh ở trẻ nhỏ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Start of the school year: A warning about rising illnesses in young children.
article.articleSummary: Ha Noi's CDC warns that hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) may rise in September as school year begins. At Hanoi Children's Hospital, Dr. Nguyen Thi Lan Anh notes increasing HFMD admissions, including two cases: a 15-month-old boy with fever, oral ulcers and hand-foot blisters who developed tremors and irritability, and a 23-month-old girl with persistent fever and extensive oral lesions who developed neurological signs, requiring hospitalization. HFMD mainly affects children under 5, especially under 3, and spreads in nurseries, kindergartens, playgrounds, and homes via respiratory secretions, saliva, blister fluid, and stool; surfaces and toys can harbor the virus. Caregivers should wash hands, clean surfaces, and bathe children daily; monitor for high fever, tremors, vomiting, or altered consciousness and seek care promptly. RSV is also highlighted: about half of inpatients at Phenikaa University Hospital are RSV-positive, mostly under 1 year; ~20% require oxygen, with HFNC or CPAP needed. Preventive measures include maternal RSV vaccination in late pregnancy and infant monoclonal antibodies.

triage.headline_ja: 新学期の始まり、幼児の疾病増加への警告
triage.triage_reason: ハノイでの季節性の手足口病(HFMD)とRSV感染増加に関する定例的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、重症例の報告はあるが異常な流行や国際的懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: HFMDとRSVはベトナムで毎年季節的に増加する既知の疾患であり、本記事は新学期に伴う注意喚起の性格が強い。一部重症化例（神経症状、酸素投与）が報告されているが、大規模アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はなし。続報で症例数の急増や重症度の変化があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: V klopih odkrili nov virus, ki okuži ljudi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New virus discovered in ticks that infects humans.
article.articleSummary: Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV) is a newly identified human-infecting virus linked to the Asian longhorned tick Haemaphysalis longicornis in China. Researchers screened 3,163 patients with fever, fatigue, and gastrointestinal symptoms after tick bites and found ALTNV in 10.4% overall, rising to 15.1% among those negative for Dabie virus (DBV), the agent of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), which has a 10–30% case fatality in Asia. ALTNV was detected by viral RNA, isolation, and electron microscopy; IgM indicating recent infection were present. Sole ALTNV infections fully recovered; however, 38 patients were co-infected with ALTNV and DBV and had higher rates of respiratory problems and kidney failure, with 7 deaths (18.4%). Surveillance of 47,428 ticks from 15 Chinese provinces found ALTNV RNA in 1.3% of ticks and 1.8% of Haemaphysalis longicornis, with lab-confirmed transmission to mice. The NEJM report calls for improved diagnostics for tickbite-associated fevers.

triage.headline_ja: マダニから人に感染する新種ウイルスを発見
triage.triage_reason: 中国でマダニ媒介の新規ウイルス（ALTNV）がヒト感染例として初めて報告され、SFTS(Dabieウイルス)との重複感染例で18.4%の致死率が確認されるなど、異常性と重症度の観点からIHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価へ進める。
triage.notes: NEJM掲載の学術報告に基づく新規病原体（ALTNV）の発見。単独感染は軽症だがSFTS(Dabieウイルス)との共感染例で重症化・死亡が確認された。ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく、現時点で国際的拡大の兆候はないが、新規病原体としての監視強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 75 Students Fall Ill At Surat Boarding School Over Suspected Food Poisoning
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning at P P Savani School hostel in Surat’s Abrama area affected 75 students with diarrhoea and vomiting from Saturday night; 12 hospitalised, including nine girls aged 15–17; four discharged; remaining patients are stable and out of danger. Surat Municipal Corporation launched an investigation; four food samples collected for testing, and a mobile medical team is checking health of other hostel residents. The boarding school houses about 2,200 students and 300 staff, all reportedly having the same meal on Saturday. Authorities continue monitoring as laboratory results determine the cause of illness.

triage.headline_ja: スーラトの寄宿学校で75人の生徒が食中毒疑いで発病
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設での食中毒疑い事例であり、重症例は少なく感染症のヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大の懸念もないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 食中毒（疑い）であり感染症シグナルではないため、対象国リストに該当してもverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh nhân trẻ tốn gần 1 tỷ đồng điều trị sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A young patient spends nearly 1 billion VND on dengue fever treatment.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever dominates southern Vietnam, with Ho Chi Minh City reporting 31,032 cases through Sep 6. A 16-year-old girl admitted to Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases developed dengue shock syndrome with pneumonia, acute respiratory failure, pneumothorax, subcutaneous emphysema, coagulopathy, and multi-organ failure. She required intubation, VV-ECMO, and prolonged transfusions; the care lasted over a month and approached 1 billion VND in cost, despite insurance. A second patient, a 21-year-old woman, also had dengue shock with liver and kidney injury and multi-organ involvement, requiring ventilation and continuous dialysis, discharged after 45 days. Pediatric cases include other severe dengue admissions to the city's children's hospital. Dengue has four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4); secondary infection risk is higher. Vietnam emphasizes prevention: vector control and vaccination. The dengue vaccine for ages 4+ uses two doses 3 months apart, with reported protection >80% and hospitalization reduction >90% after full vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 若い患者、デング熱治療で約10億ドン（VND）を費やす
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市でのデング熱流行に伴う重症例(ショック症候群・多臓器不全)の報告だが、デング熱はベトナムで毎年発生する風土病であり、IHR基準上の異常性・国際的拡大の根拠は乏しい。重症度は高く経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は個別重症例（多臓器不全・ECMO使用・高額医療費）に焦点を当てた報道であり、ホーチミン市での大規模流行(31,032例)を背景としている。デング熱は同地域で季節性に流行する既知の疾患であり、新規性・国際拡散リスクは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Vacant plots in Rajamahendravaram turn into mosquito breeding grounds
article.articleSummary: Rajamahendravaram Municipal Corporation area faces a mosquito breeding crisis as vacant plots become breeding grounds this monsoon, with thick bushes, stagnant water, and garbage fueling dengue and malaria risk. Revenue Department has identified about 1,500 vacant plots, but enforcement is hindered as owners of more than half cannot be traced—many believed to live in other states or abroad. The Corporation spends between Rs 6 lakh and Rs 10 lakh annually on mosquito-control measures. Officials have proposed drone spraying in vacant plots. Municipal Health Officer Dr A Vinuthna said notices have been issued to identified owners to clear vegetation and prevent water stagnation, with field inspections planned and action to be taken against non-compliant owners. Urban MLA Adireddy Srinivas criticized sanitation lapses, directing officials to intensify anti-mosquito operations, serve notices to plot owners to clear premises, and ensure property tax payments. Residents call for stricter surveillance and cleaning to avert disease outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ラージャムンドリの空き地が蚊の繁殖地に
triage.triage_reason: 特定の症例急増や異常事態ではなく、蚊の繁殖環境に関する行政対応の日常的な報道であり、IHR・WPRO基準への該当は見られない。
triage.notes: デング熱・マラリアの症例数増加や具体的な発生報告はなく、蚊の繁殖対策に関する地方行政記事。今後の症例報告動向を注視する価値はあるが、現時点ではピックアップ基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Maladie à virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus disease
article.articleSummary: Three ebolaviruses cause human disease: Zaire ebolavirus, Sudan ebolavirus, and Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Fruit bats are the likely reservoir; infection follows contact with infected bats or animals, or close contact with an infected person. Ebola virus disease spreads via body fluids or contaminated fomites. The 2026 outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with case fatality estimates of 30–50%. Typical symptoms include fever ≥38°C, fatigue, myalgias, and gastrointestinal symptoms; it can progress to rash, hepatopathy, coagulopathy, and hemorrhage. Incubation is 2–21 days. Diagnosis is by RT-PCR on blood. Risk factors: travel to an affected area during incubation, close contact with infected individuals or wildlife. PPE: fitted N95, eye protection, gloves, and impermeable gown; notify local public health and refer to infectious diseases services. Vaccines exist for Zaire ebolavirus (Ervebo); monoclonal antibodies (Inmazeb, ansuvimab) reduce mortality but are not effective against Bundibugyo; supportive care remains primary for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率30～50%とされるブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる2026年アウトブレイクが報告されており、重篤性・異常性・ヒトーヒト感染リスクの観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事はCMAJ掲載の臨床レビュー記事だが、2026年にコンゴ民主共和国で発生中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクに言及しており、致死率の高さとエボラの過去の国際拡大歴からPICKUPと判断した。詳細な症例数・地理的拡大状況・公衆衛生対応状況については続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kanpur News: बेकाबू हुआ बुखार, एक और मासूम की गई जान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kanpur News: Fever spirals out of control; another innocent child has died.
article.articleSummary: Kanpur Dehat district, Uttar Pradesh, reports a fever outbreak with vomiting, abdominal pain, and skin symptoms in Derapur's Udhanapur area. In 40 days, nine deaths reported due to fever-related illness. Large numbers of patients are arriving at both government and private hospitals; many seek care from private clinics and unlicensed practitioners due to overcrowding. Malaria and dengue are rising, with three dengue cases laboratory-confirmed. A seven-year-old boy from Udhanapur, Kalyaan Singh's son Abhi, died after severe fever; he was brought to Medical College Akbarpur after midnight and declared dead by emergency staff. The outbreak is ongoing, with confirmed dengue cases and a rising toll in Kanpur Dehat.

triage.headline_ja: カーンプル・ニュース: 熱が制御不能に、また一人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州カーンプル・デハト県で40日間に9人が発熱関連疾患で死亡し、デング熱・マラリアの症例が増加、病院が過密状態にあるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、季節性の地域的流行の可能性が高いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は検査で3例確定。マラリアとの混合流行の可能性があるが、原因病原体の特定や地域拡大の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор усилил санитарный контроль на границах из-за рисков Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor has intensified sanitary control at the borders due to Ebola risks.
article.articleSummary: Russia has intensified sanitary border controls over Ebola import risk, according to Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor, speaking to RIA Novosti. Border guards are promptly relaying information on transit passengers from at-risk countries; travelers with fever or malaise are hospitalized. Popova noted that Rospotrebnadzor specialists have been assisting Uganda from the outbreak’s early days, providing domestic diagnostic tests, including for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, and sharing developments with allied states. On 11 September, Vedomosti, citing WHO, reported that since the outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo, 6,757 cases have been confirmed with 3,267 deaths, a 48% fatality rate as of 7 September. The article highlights ongoing international collaboration and border vigilance amid Ebola concerns.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁（ロスポトレブナゾール）、エボラ出血熱のリスクを受け国境での衛生管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（6,757例、致死率48%）は重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的な対応（ロシアの国境管理強化、ウガンダへの支援）も見られるためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの国境管理強化を主題とするが、感染症イベントの実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）。ウガンダは支援対象として言及されるが対象国リストに含まれず、ロシアも対象国外のため除外。致死率48%は極めて高く、症例数6,757例も過去のエボラ流行と比較して大規模であり、続報の精査が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Thanh niên bị chó cắn rồi rời đi, dân mạng ráo riết tìm để nhắc tiêm phòng dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young man bitten by a dog leaves the scene; netizens frantically search for him to remind him to get the rabies vaccine.
article.articleSummary: On 11 September in Hội Phú ward, Gia Lai province, a young man was bitten on the leg by a stray dog inside a plant-waste shop. After reports the dog later died and was suspected of rabies, the shop owner posted online to locate the bitten man so he could receive rabies vaccination. He was found hours later and reportedly vaccinated, with the shop owner contributing funds to help cover the cost. Health authorities urge prompt vaccination after dog or cat bites or scratches, especially when the animal dies, to prevent rabies. Gia Lai has recorded numerous rabies deaths in recent years following canine or feline bites, including a 4-year-old child in Xã Gào who died with suspected rabies after a cat scratch.

triage.headline_ja: 犬に噛まれた青年が立ち去り、ネットユーザーが狂犬病ワクチン接種を呼びかけるため必死に捜索
triage.triage_reason: 個別の犬咬傷事例であり、公衆衛生上の重大な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない散発的な国内事案。
triage.notes: SNS上での話題性はあるが、狂犬病自体はベトナム地方部で既知の風土病であり、個別事例のため公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Les décès communautaires compliquent encore la riposte contre Ebola à
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Community deaths further complicate the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Community deaths remain a major challenge in the Ebola response in rural Ituri, notably in Bule in Fataki health zone, Djugu territory. As of Sept 13, 2026, several community deaths are recorded daily. Health teams struggle to secure corpses, collect samples, and arrange dignified, safe burials. Management of suspected cases is constrained: only one ambulance; security issues restrict movement to daytime, causing evening arrivals to wait until the next day for transfer to the Fataki care site. This fuels community tensions; health staff report accusations and some response teams have been attacked. Health officials are urging the setup of a transit or treatment site in Bule to stabilize patients before transfer to Fataki.

triage.headline_ja: コミュニティでの死亡がブレにおけるエボラ対応をさらに複雑化させている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱の対応が継続中であり、コミュニティでの死亡増加、対応チームへの攻撃、医療体制の逼迫など公衆衛生上深刻な事態が確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: スイス（Fribourg州）は発生地域に含まれるが記事の主題ではないため除外。既存のエボラ流行の継続的悪化を示すもので、地域住民の安全確保・埋葬対応・治療拠点整備が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор усилил контроль на границах РФ из-за риска завоза Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor Intensifies Border Controls at Russia's Borders Due to the Risk of Ebola Importation
article.articleSummary: as of 14 September 2026, Russia's Rospotrebnadzor tightens sanitary-quarantine border controls amid Ebola importation risk. Passengers with fever or malaise are directed to medical facilities; border services share information on arrivals from risk countries to enable early detection and prevent spread. Official checkpoints and airports implement medical screening and epidemiological surveillance, though movements via unofficial border routes keep cross-border transmission risk alive. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). In May, WHO declared a PHEIC for the DRC and Uganda. DRC reports 7,022 confirmed cases and 3,267 deaths; ongoing geographic spread and sustained transmission noted. There is no vaccine or specifically registered treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; prevention and therapy options are under study. Transmission occurs via close contact with blood and bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include high fever, weakness, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and in severe cases organ failure and hemorrhage.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁、エボラ出血熱の国内流入リスクを受け国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行は既にWHOによりPHEICが宣言されており、感染者数・死者数が甚大かつ地理的拡大や持続的伝播が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの国境管理強化を主題としているが、実際の感染発生地はDRC（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス、7,022例確定、3,267死亡、WHO PHEIC宣言済）。ウガンダも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ロシア・ウガンダは検証対象外。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Bhopal news: 'स्वाइन फ्लू' को लेकर स्वास्थ विभाग की चिंता बढ़ी, इन 6 लक्षणों को बिल्कुल न करें इग्नोर | Do Not Ignore These 6 Symptoms Of Swine Flu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bhopal News: Health Department's Concern Over Swine Flu Grows; Do Not Ignore These 6 Symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Swine Flu (H1N1) outbreak in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, with 70 confirmed cases, including 48 in September, and 17 patients hospitalised at Hamidia Hospital. After Indore, Bhopal reports rising transmission as humidity and cooler nights are linked to increased H1N1 activity. An 80-year-old, Ram Singh, died from H1N1-related Respiratory Distress Syndrome and Acute Respiratory Failure; he had pre-existing heart disease, hypertension, and type-2 diabetes. Testing capacity is strained: only AIIMS Bhopal is conducting Swine Flu tests; Gandhi Medical College has not started testing despite directives, due to kit shortages, leading to 3–4 day result delays and more private testing. Key symptoms to watch include sudden high fever, chills, persistent dry cough, sore throat, headache, muscle/joint pains, extreme weakness, and breathlessness. Preventive measures: masking in crowds, covering mouth/nose when coughing, frequent hand washing, and seeking medical advice rather than self-medicating.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールニュース: 「豚インフルエンザ」への保健当局の懸念高まる、これら6つの症状を絶対に見逃さないで
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）のインド国内地域的流行で死亡例・入院例があるが、既知の疾患であり国際的拡大の兆候はなく、検査体制逼迫という管理面の懸念があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザ株であり、地域的流行だが検査キャパシティ不足による診断遅延が報告されている。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事象には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 'TB हो गया है', पत्नी बोली-इलाज के लिए गांव जा रही हूं, स्पा सेंटर के बाहर बवाल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'I've got tuberculosis,' wife said—I'm going to the village for treatment, uproar outside the spa center.
article.articleSummary: Outside a well-known shopping mall in Gurugram, Haryana, a public confrontation occurred between a husband and wife. The husband confronted his wife as she exited a spa center after she claimed she had tuberculosis and planned to travel to her village for treatment. The wife reportedly resisted, while the husband pressed for details about their child, asking where their child is. A crowd gathered and bystanders attempted to mediate as police were alerted. The incident was captured on video and circulated on X/Twitter. Police have launched an investigation. The article does not provide laboratory confirmation of TB, case counts, infection source, or information about an ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 「TBになった」と妻が発言、治療のため村へ行くと主張―スパセンター前で騒動
triage.triage_reason: これは夫婦間の個人的な口論に関する報道であり、結核の実際の発生・感染拡大を示す公衆衛生上の情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の検査確認や症例数、感染源などの疫学的情報を一切含まず、単なる私的な夫婦間トラブルの報道である。公衆衛生イベントとしての実体はない。

article.articleHeadline: Văn Bàn tăng cường phòng, chống dịch bệnh trên đàn gia súc, gia cầm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Văn Bàn strengthens disease prevention and control in cattle and poultry herds.
article.articleSummary: On September 13, in Nam Bó hamlet, Văn Bàn Commune's Center for General Services distributed disinfectants and lime powder to support over 90 farming households to disinfect and sanitize cattle and poultry facilities amid ongoing African swine fever (ASF) cases and emerging bovine lumpy skin disease (LSD). A total of 32 liters of disinfectants and 390 kg of lime powder were allocated; each household received 4 kg of lime powder and chemicals to mix per instructions. Households promptly spread lime and spray disinfectants at barns, entrances, and high-risk areas. In addition to sanitation, authorities intensified outreach, urging farmers to monitor livestock health and report unusual signs to authorities. For LSD in cattle, farmers were advised to boost barn hygiene, control insect vectors, and follow expert guidelines. These measures aim to curb spread, protect livestock, minimize losses, and stabilize production in Văn Bàn.

triage.headline_ja: バンバン、家畜・家禽の疾病予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（アフリカ豚熱・ランピースキン病）のみで人への健康影響は報告されておらず、IHR・WPRO基準への該当は見られない。
triage.notes: 本記事はアフリカ豚熱およびランピースキン病という動物感染症に関するもので、ヒトへの健康影響は言及されていない。地方自治体レベルの防疫活動（消毒剤配布等）であり、人獣共通感染症としてのヒトリスクは記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Bengal Identifies 29 Municipalities, 278 Panchayats as Dengue Hotspots
article.articleSummary: West Bengal reports 5,002 dengue cases till Sept 11, 2026, with hotspots in 29 municipalities, 85 blocks, and 278 panchayats. The health department identifies hotspots using: panchayat with 10+ dengue patients; block with more than 30; municipality where a majority of wards have 5+ cases. Intensified testing, door-to-door surveillance, and larvicides are underway in these areas. Residents with fever lasting two days or more are urged to get blood tests rather than self-medicate. Household water tanks and cisterns should be covered, and efforts target preventing water accumulation in flowerpots and containers; surveillance extends to ponds, drains, pools, dry canals, wells, and factories. Since the start of the year, total cases exceed 5,000, with 2,500 new cases in the last month. Murshidabad leads with 1,072 cases, followed by Kolkata (500) and North 24 Parganas (450).

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州、29の自治体・278のパンチャーヤトをデング熱ホットスポットに指定
triage.triage_reason: インドの季節性デング熱の増加事例であり、地元保健当局が通常の対応（サーベイランス強化・殺虫剤散布）を実施中。重症度や異常性を示す情報がなく、フルRRAへ進める根拠は乏しいが、症例数増加傾向のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 西ベンガル州（ムルシダバード、コルカタ、北24パルガナ地区）でデング熱症例が季節的に増加。地元保健当局によるホットスポット特定と対策（幼虫駆除剤散布、戸別調査等）が既に進行中であり、死亡例や重症例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 剛開學就爆發甲流 上海杭州多校要求居家隔離(圖) - 新聞 上海 - 看中國新聞網 - 海外華人 歷史秘聞 大陸時政 -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 influenza outbreak as soon as the new term begins; many schools in Shanghai and Hangzhou require home quarantine (Photos)
article.articleSummary: Influenza outbreaks are reported in Shanghai and Hangzhou schools, dominated by influenza A(H3N2) with influenza B/Victoria lineages co-circulating. In Shanghai, multiple kindergartens and primary/secondary schools experienced clustered cases as the new term began, with widespread class-wide home-quarantine notices and half of some classes on sick leave. In Hangzhou, a class of about 40 students saw around 10 feverish absences; the class was halted from September 11–14 and resumed September 15. Pediatric influenza activity has risen, with influenza comprising about one-third of hospital beds among affected patients. National sentinel surveillance (Aug 31–Sep 6) shows influenza-like illness at 3.8% of outpatient visits; influenza positivity in 216 sentinel hospitals is 18.4% (outpatients) and 7.5% (hospitalized SARI). Southern provinces show higher activity than northern regions, indicating ongoing transmission among children. The situation underscores early-season flu circulation and school-based transmission dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: 新学期早々にA型インフルエンザが流行、上海・杭州の複数校で自宅隔離を要請（写真）
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(A/H3N2、B/Victoria)による学校内クラスター発生であり、中国国内で例年見られる新学期の流行パターンに合致し、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの学校内流行であり、サーベイランスデータ（ILI 3.8%、陽性率18.4%）は例年の早期流行パターンと整合的。学級閉鎖・自宅隔離は行われているが重症例や医療逼迫の報告はなく、外部支援の必要性も認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 刚开学就爆发甲流 上海杭州多校要求居家隔离(图) - 新闻 上海 - 看中国新闻网 - 海外华人 历史秘闻 大陆时政 -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A outbreak erupts as schools reopen; many schools in Shanghai and Hangzhou require home isolation (Photo)
article.articleSummary: Influenza A outbreaks in Shanghai and Hangzhou amid school reopenings, dominated by A(H3N2) with co-circulating B/Victoria lineage. In Shanghai, multiple primary and secondary schools report cluster infections; class-wide home isolation notices and about half of students taking sick leave. In Hangzhou, a third-grade class of about 40 students had around 10 with fever; the class was suspended September 11–14 with return on September 15. Shanghai Children's Hospital notes rising influenza visits; influenza accounts for roughly one-third of pediatric beds among hospitalizations. Zhejiang’s Hangzhou infection department reports increased pediatric influenza admissions. Nationally, China CDC data (Aug 31–Sep 6) show influenza-like illness at 3.8% of outpatient visits; 18.4% of tests positive for influenza among 216 sentinel hospitals; 7.5% positivity among hospitalized SARI cases; southern provinces higher, H3N2 rising. Social media discussions reflect alarm and calls for protective measures.

triage.headline_ja: 新学期早々にインフルエンザA流行、上海・杭州の多数の学校で自宅隔離要請(写真)
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(A/H3N2)の学校クラスター発生であり、重症度や異常性を示す情報はないが、社会的関心（SNS上の不安）がみられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの学校集団発生であり、中国CDCのサーベイランスデータでも例年の流行パターンと大きく異ならない。重症例・死亡例の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор усилил санитарный контроль на границе РФ из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor strengthened sanitary controls at the Russian border due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Russia tightened sanitary controls at its borders due to Ebola risk, announced by Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor. Border guards now screen travelers arriving in transit from high‑risk countries, closely monitor for fever or other health signs, and hospitalize those with elevated temperature or deteriorating condition. Measures aim to eliminate any risk of Ebola importation into Russia. Rospotrebnadzor laboratories have aided neighboring African efforts since the outbreak near the DRC–Uganda border, sharing domestic diagnostic tests, including for the rare Bundibugyo strain. The Ugandan–DRC border region is cited as particularly affected. Ebola is described as endemic to Congo and some surrounding countries; bats, feeding on bananas and mangoes, are cited as reservoirs at around +30°C. Human transmission is not airborne but occurs via very close contact. WHO’s Abdirahman Mahamud notes the DRC outbreak is the largest by early spread, with WHO seeking $115 million for Africa response.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア連邦消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁(ロスポトレブナゾール)、エボラ出血熱を理由にロシア国境での防疫管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダ国境地域で大規模なエボラ流行が発生し、WHOが1億1500万ドルの支援を要請するなど国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高まっており、ロシアが渡航制限的措置（国境検疫強化）を講じている点でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダ国境地域でのエボラ流行を主題としているが、ウガンダおよびロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを対象国として記載。WHOのAbdirahman Mahamud氏はこの流行を『初期拡大が最大規模』と評しており、深刻度・異常性ともに高い。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор: на границе РФ усилили санитарный контроль из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor: Sanitary control strengthened at the Russian border due to Ebola
article.articleSummary: On 14 September 2026, Russia strengthens sanitary border controls due to Ebola virus disease entry risk. Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor, said the Border Service promptly responded, with guards screening all arriving passengers, including transit travelers from regions with unfavourable epidemiological situations, and reporting data to authorities. Suspected symptomatic individuals are transported to hospitals. Popova stressed the system is designed to minimize any risk. Rospotrebnadzor researchers have been actively involved since the outset in Ebola response in Uganda, which borders the Democratic Republic of Congo, the country most affected by the outbreak. On 18 August, WHO emergency response coordinator Thierno Balde indicated the outbreak in DRC could be brought under control within three months with adequate resources.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾール:エボラ出血熱を受けロシア国境で衛生管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがWHO緊急対応の対象となっており、国境を越えた影響（ウガンダへの拡大、ロシアの検疫強化）が既に確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアの国境管理強化だが、実際の感染症発生地はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）であり、ウガンダも影響を受けているとされるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ロシアも対象国リスト外のため除外。WHOはDRCでのアウトブレイクを3か月以内に制御可能と述べており、既に国際的な対応が進行中の既知の事案である。

article.articleHeadline: রাজ্যে ডেঙ্গুর বাড়বাড়ন্ত, কবে মিলবে ভ্যাকসিন? জানিয়ে দিল আইসিএমআর
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue on the rise in the state; when will the vaccine be available? ICMR has informed.
article.articleSummary: West Bengal dengue cases are rising, with Kolkata highlighted as a hotspot. Health authorities have intensified surveillance ahead of Puja, marking 85 blocks, 278 gram panchayats, and 29 municipalities as hotspots and increasing dengue testing. The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) Director-General announced that a domestically developed dengue vaccine, named Dengial, could reach the market before the 2027 dengue season, likely by August–September 2027, contingent on completing Phase III trials and regulatory approvals. The vaccine is a single-dose, live attenuated formulation targeting all four dengue serotypes (DEN-1 to DEN-4), developed by ICMR in collaboration with Panacea Biotec. Phase II results reportedly show favorable performance; Phase III is ongoing. Trials began in 2024 at 19 centers with 10,335 participants.

triage.headline_ja: 州でデング熱が増加、ワクチンはいつ入手可能に？ICMRが発表
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州でデング熱症例が季節的に増加しているが、既知の流行病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。ワクチン開発進捗が主な内容で、社会的関心はあるものの緊急のRRA移行基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: デング熱は西ベンガル州（インド）における季節性の増加であり、毎年発生する既知の流行。記事の主眼は国産ワクチン(Dengial)の開発進捗報告であり、危機的な公衆衛生イベントとしての性質は薄い。

article.articleHeadline: وكالة سرايا : إيبولا يصبح "أسوأ وباء" مسجل على الإطلاق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saraya Agency: Ebola becomes the 'worst epidemic' on record.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached a turning point, described as the worst outbreak on record. As of September 1, there are more than 6,186 lab-confirmed cases and 3,007 deaths since May, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC. The outbreak began in the mining area of Mongbalu in Ituri Province in late April, spreading through connected communities and health networks to Rwampara and Bunia, and crossing into Uganda. The government, with support from Africa CDC and WHO, expanded surveillance, laboratory capacity (22 labs across five provinces), treatment centers, vaccination, infection prevention, and logistics; safe burials improved to mostly within 24 hours. The reproduction number declined from around four to over one. About $1.72 billion has been pledged, roughly $867 million spent, and African nations pledged $118.5 million. A June continental plan emphasizes unity of plan, budget, team, and monitoring, with communities at the center.

triage.headline_ja: サラヤ通信：エボラ出血熱、史上「最悪の流行」に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で6,186例・3,007人死亡という史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が確認され、国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダ）も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ルワンダへの越境が報告されているが、対象国リストにこれらは含まれないため除外。DRCが主たる発生国として唯一該当。国際支援（Africa CDC、WHO、総額約17.2億ドルの拠出表明）が既に大規模に行われている点も特筆。

article.articleHeadline: Приезжающих в Россию проверяют из-за риска завоза вируса Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Those arriving in Russia are being screened due to the risk of importing the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Russia tightened border controls against Ebola import risk, with border guards relaying arrival data to surveillance agencies. Anyone entering from Ebola-affected countries showing fever or other symptoms is hospitalized immediately. The outbreak began in May in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and the WHO in early September called it the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic in history, with transmission chains still not fully understood. The Congolese National Institute of Public Health reports about 7,000 cases and more than 3,300 deaths. Ebola symptoms start with high fever, weakness, headache, muscle and joint pains, sore throat, then vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, red eyes, and dehydration; severe cases progress to bleeding and organ failure. In September 2026, Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola subtype, had a global case-fatality rate around 48.3% (without treatment up to 90%). Russia has provided diagnostic tests for Uganda and other partners, including Bundibugyo detection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス侵入リスクのため、ロシア入国者に検疫スクリーニングが実施されている
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で発生したエボラ流行は史上最速の拡大速度とされ、約7000症例・3300人超の死亡を記録しており、国際的な渡航スクリーニング強化を招くなど深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの水際対策を主題としているが、感染症事象そのものはDRC・イトゥリ州で発生。ウガンダは診断キット提供先として言及されているのみで、当該国内での発生は本文中に明記されていないため verified_locations には含めていない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれない。
